en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Leg Warmers
features: Delivering warmth and exceptional breathability for comfort during transitional rides
Delivering effective water repellency in wet conditions
Delivering a precise, anatomical fit that follows the natural contours of the legs
Keeping the leg warmers securely in place
Adding a touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Leg Warmers are tailored for cyclists who demand comfort and performance during transitional season rides. Featuring light insulation, they deliver warmth and exceptional breathability, ensuring comfort in variable conditions. A DWR coating adds reliable water repellency, keeping you protected during wet rides.

The pre-shaped, anatomical fit follows the natural contours of your legs for optimal freedom of movement, while elasticated grippers provide a secure hold throughout intense efforts. Reflective branding adds a touch of visibility, making these leg warmers a sleek, functional choice for high-paced riding in spring and autumn.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Windproof Winter Jacket
features: A three-layer waterproof and windproof softshell fabric on the front, lower back and sleeves protects against rain and windchill
The underside of the sleeves, side panels and back panel use a brushed fleece fabric for enhanced stretch and breathability
Three rear top entry pockets and one zipped pocket, to house all your ride essentials
A high cut collar and high-stretch raw cut sleeve cuffs help to seal out the elements and seal in valuable body heat
Enhance your visibility to other road users in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
When the temperature drops, reach for the GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket. This softshell winter jacket will keep you comfortable during your cold bike rides.

The front facing torso, lower back and sleeves of the jacket use a three-layer softshell fabric with an integrated 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane. This is your shield against cold weather and spray. The protective three-layer fabric has a high-stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, while the raglan sleeves of the jacket allow freedom of movement and the raw cut sleeve cuffs give an effective seal around your wrists.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the sleeves and upper back, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to provide added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the softshell fabric, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

A YKK® Vislon two-way zip, with extra-long zip pulls, is used on the jacket to allow you to regulate airflow through your layers with ease and avoid over-heating when you are working hard. Or, when conditions deteriorate, you can zip the jacket right up to the high cut collar and seal out the elements. A silicone gripper on the rear hem ensures the jacket stays firmly in place, no matter how hard you are working.

On the rear of the jacket there are three large open top pockets for all those long ride essentials, plus a single zipped pocket for small valuables. Reflective detailing on the rear helps to enhance your road presence in low light conditions.

The PACR Windproof Winter Jacket will keep you warm and comfortable no matter how tough the riding gets.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Expert RC Max Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves
features: Features Ride Comfort Max padding, a combination of high-density padding and memory foam padding offering superior comfort and crash protection.
Built with perforated high-end synthetic microsuede in the palm, for optimal comfort, breathability and resistance to abrasion
Equipped with silicon print in the palm to optimize grip in all conditions.
Achieve the perfect fit adjustment with the durable hook and loop closure.
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Expert RC Max Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves combine maximum comfort with exceptional durability.

These gloves feature Ride Comfort Max padding to maximise comfort in multiple handlebar positions. The unique padding blend includes strategically positioned high-density foam in combination with memory foam, ensuring superior cushioning on long rides. The high-end microsuede palm is perforated to enhance breathability and offers exceptional abrasion resistance. Grip is enhanced with a silicone pattern for a secure handlebar hold. The back of the gloves uses elastic mesh, providing great comfort and optimised ventilation. The thumb is constructed from a thin microsuede layer, perfect for wiping sweat away from your skin or cleaning your glasses.

Drawing from two decades of experience in crafting cycling gloves, the GripGrab Expert RC Max Padded Short Finger Gloves mark the next level in glove design, succeeding the renowned GripGrab SuperGel gloves. These gloves excel in every aspect expected of summer cycling gloves, providing enduring comfort and superior protection while enhancing durability. Crafted with a focus on quality and durability, these gloves are designed to be your enduring cycling companion.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Rouleur Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves
features: High-density padding protects your hands from vibrations and enhances your comfort
Lightweight stretch back panel lets your hands breathe as you perspire in hot conditions
Supple and durable palm provides maximum control on the handlebars
Low-profile adjustable cuff and in-between finger pull-off tabs for easy fitting and removal
Reflective detailing helps to enhance your hand signals in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Rouleur Gloves are made with a high-density padding to absorb the shocks of the road and trail – protecting your hands against vibrations to enhance your comfort.

As the Rouleur name suggests, these gloves are much like the cyclists described: they are consistent all-rounders – providing a degree of padding and comfort for your hands, while excelling at allowing control of the handlebars.

The lightweight breathable fabric on the stretch back panel on these cycling gloves lets your hands breathe as you perspire in hot conditions; this helps with temperature regulation and reduces sweat build-up inside the gloves. When you do break a sweat, use the sweat wiper on the gloves to wipe away perspiration and keep your vision clear for the road ahead.

A supple and durable palm provides maximum control on the handlebars, brake levers and gear shifters. The low-profile adjustable cuffs allows you to adjust the fit as you go; while in-between finger pull-off tabs make for easy removal at the end of your ride. These short finger cycling gloves also feature reflective detailing to help increase your visibility and enhance your hand signals in low light conditions.

Available in a range of colours – there is a choice that will allow everyone to match the GripGrab Rouleur Gloves to their cycling kit, for the ultimate summer style.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceAqua Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
features: Waterproof fabric with taped seams offers a fully waterproof and windproof shield against rain and road spray
Close-fitting profile with stretch fabric and elasticated cuff provides a smooth covering with optimised fit
Wear reinforcements on the sole of these road shoe covers help to reduce wear and extend product life
Rear zip allows for easy fitting and removal despite the close-fitting cut
Reflective detailing on the rear of the shoe cover helps to enhance visibility in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RaceAqua Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are lightweight, waterproof and aerodynamic overshoes, which protect your feet and road cycling shoes against rain, spray and dirt.

The waterproof high-stretch material gives a second-skin fit, and the rear zip design makes it easy to put them on and take them off. Keep racing, whatever the weather.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband
features: Flexible windproof fabric protects your head from windchill in cool conditions
Warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining offers insulation in cold weather
Low-bulk fleece fabric is highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio
Stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching allow for a comfortable close fit under a cycling helmet
Reflective logos and detailing on front and rear help to improve visibility in low light winter conditions
en-GB.description_html:
Keeping the wind off your head without making your head too hot is a difficult balance when cycling in the winter months, but this is where the GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband is the ideal choice for winter cycling headwear.

This headband protects your forehead from windchill in cool conditions — the flexible windproof fabric sits against the skin but leaves the top of your head uncovered to allow excess heat to escape when you are working hard on a climb or pushing to keep up with you cycling friends.

The warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining to the fabric offers insulation and comfort in colder weather – to keep your head and ears warm and allow you to concentrate on the road ahead rather than the windchill.

The headband is lightweight thanks to its low-bulk fleece fabric; it is also highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio, ideal for those cooler rides.

The comfortable under-helmet fit comes thanks to the stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching, which together allow a close fit under a cycling helmet.

Reflective logos and detailing on the front and rear help to improve your presence in low light winter conditions, when indeed you are most likely to be wearing the GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband.

For anyone who likes to run and hike in the winter, as well as cycle, this headband has wide multi-sport appeal as it keeps the windchill at bay regardless of the activity you choose.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer
features: Protect your neck and head from sun, wind, dust, dirt and cold weather conditions during multi-sport activities
Premium stretch fabric allows a close and comfortable fit in a multitude of wear configurations
Lightweight highly breathable fabric is moisture wicking and fast drying to keep you comfortable
Can be worn as a neck warmer, bandana, scarf, snood, headband, wristband or face mask
Highly visible bright colour choices can help to enhance your road presence in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer is one of the most versatile pieces of cycling kit you can own. Wear it to protect your neck and head from sun, wind, dust, dirt and cold weather conditions during multi-sport activities, and keep it in your pocket or pannier to keep the chill off your neck on long descents.

The neck warmer is made from a premium stretch fabric that allows a close and comfortable fit in a multitude of wear configurations: such as a bandana, scarf, snood, headband, wristband or face mask. You might even employ a combination of a few wear-options during the same ride.

Sat next to your skin, a neck warmer could cause sweat to build up when you work hard on a climb, but this lightweight fabric is highly breathable and fast drying – wicking moisture away from your skin to keep you comfortable in a wide range of conditions.

Winter is the time you are most likely to need the GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer – it is also the time of year with the fewest hours of daylight – and this neck warmer can offer enhanced visibility with the brighter colour choices in the range.

Find a colour to suit your kit and style, and this neck warmer will keep you comfortable in a wide range of riding conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaRepel 2 Water-Resistant Leg Warmers
features: Front facing thigh and complete lower leg use a three-layer fabric construction with a fully waterproof and breathable membrane
Rather than a stitched seam, the lower leg is welded to create a fully waterproof join
The four-way stretch fabric and pre-contoured seams around the knee ensure a close and comfortable fit
A soft brushed fabric backing adds insulation for comfort in cool weather conditions
Elasticated silicone grippers on the upper hem of the leg warmers keeps everything securely in place
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab AquaRepel 2 Water-Resistant Leg Warmers provide next-level weather protection. Featuring a three-layer construction: with a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane integrated into the fabric – they offer a complete shield for your lower legs in cold and wet weather.

The three-layer softshell fabric, with integrated waterproof and windproof membrane, is used on the complete lower portion of the leg warmers. This protective four-way stretch fabric creates a wrap-around armour against rain and road spray; a welded seam is used rather than a traditional stitched seam, as it allows for a 100% waterproof join in the material – completing the protection.

A raw cut hem on the bottom of the warmers completes the new Version 2.0 ‘high-stretch’ design – it means the fabric here also has greater stretch than a stitched cuff – making it easier to fit and remove the warmers, and to wear them over the top of waterproof shoe cover cuffs to reduce water ingress.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the back of the upper leg, a soft brushed fabric is used to offer added insulation and further body-mapping stretch. A Durable Water Repellent (DWR) coating has been applied to all fabrics, so they effectively shrug off light rain and spray.

Elasticated silicone grippers on the upper hem of the leg warmers keep everything securely in place, no matter how hard you are working.

Protective, flexible and made to fit like a second skin. Version 2.0 of the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers has been fully optimised to provide exceptional comfort even in the worst weather conditions. Combine these weatherproof warmers with the GripGrab AquaRepel Bib Shorts for a versatile all-season wear package – you will be kept warm and comfortable as you ride through the wettest conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: Two-layer insulating and breathable thermal fabric traps heat within to keep you warm
Premium wicking material moves sweat and moisture away from your body to help to keep you dry
High-stretch fabric and low-profile seams ensure a close low-bulk form-fitting cut
Polygiene® fabric treatment keeps you and your clothing smelling fresh for longer
Ideal for cycling, running, skiing, hiking and other winter sports in varied weather conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer is your go-to option for all winter activities; from cycling to running and even skiing. It uses a two-layer blended fabric mix, to provide outstanding thermal regulation, a super soft next-to-skin feel and fantastic wicking capabilities and breathability.

  To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment (biocide: silver chloride). Its 'Wear More. Wash Less®' technology uses silver ions to reduce the build-up of odour-inducing bacteria. The treatment is entirely safe to wear against the skin and doesn’t wash out. Reduced bacteria build-up leads to reduced odour and therefore reduced washing frequency, meaning that Polygiene® can also significantly extend the life of a base layer.

Look to the RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer for day after day warmth as you ride through the winter.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Original Stripes Crew Summer Socks
features: COOLMAX® fabric is highly breathable and allows heat and perspiration to escape from within
Stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics create a light compression feel for a superb close-fitting cut
For maximum comfort in hot riding conditions and for minimal bulk within your summer cycling shoes
Find a sock colour that will match your favourite cycling kit to create that ultimate summer look
Perfect for cycling, running, walking or casual wear in hot summer weather conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Original Stripes Crew Summer Socks are the perfect accompaniment to any cycling outfit. Made from COOLMAX® fabric, they are lightweight, highly breathable and allow heat and perspiration to escape from within – keeping you cool and comfortable on hot summer days.

Designed with stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics to create a light compression feel and a superb close-fitting cut; these socks feel like a second skin within your cycling shoes, while delivering a classic timeless style.

Although designed for cycling, these socks are also well suited to off-the-bike activities and casual wear – offering that classic 80's style on any occasion.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Classic Thermal Leg Warmers
features: Soft brushed thermal fabric offers insulation and protection from wind chill for cool spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural leg bend which reduces material bunching around your knees
Silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevents slippage down your legs
Easily stored in a cycling jersey pocket or pannier, making them ideal for changeable weather conditions
en-GB.description_html:
With the GripGrab Classic Thermal Leg Warmers, you can keep riding with warm and comfortable legs as the temperature drops in autumn and winter. Combine them with your favourite bib shorts to extend the useful temperature range of the shorts and keep your legs and knees at the optimum temperature.

With a wind resistant outer and a soft brushed inner fabric, the Classic Leg Warmers offer protection from wind chill and insulation from cool temperatures. If the temperature does rise during your ride, or you put in an effort on a climb, the lightweight fabric is highly breathable and moisture wicking so it will move perspiration away from your skin as you push hard on the pedals.

A contoured fit behind your knees eliminates uncomfortable bunching of the fabric, while strong grippers at the top of the warmers holds them in place. You will barely know you’ve got them on as you tick off the kilometres on the colder days of the year.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Waterproof Helmet Cover
features: 100% waterproof and windproof ripstop fabric with taped seams offers complete weather protection
for visibility in the traffic
Pull cord elastic hemline securely tightens around all normal sized bicycle helmets
Premium performance fabrics are built to last even with daily use in all weather conditions
Folds up small so it can be easily tucked into your pocket or pannier ready for when you need it next
en-GB.description_html:
Suited to all riders who want to keep the rain and wind out of the vents on their cycle helmet, the Waterproof Helmet Cover is especially suited to anyone who commutes by bike all year round.

The 100% waterproof and windproof fabric with taped seams offers complete weather protection, while the bright high visibility colour options and reflective detailing enhance your presence on the road.

The one-size-fits-all approach works thanks to the pull cord elastic hemline, which securely tightens around all normal sized bicycle helmets to keep the rain out when the conditions turn against you.

With performance fabrics that are built to last – even with daily use in all weather conditions – the cover is able to fold up small so it can be easily tucked into your pocket or pannier for when you need it next. This helmet cover is a recommended addition to any cycle commuter's kit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Bidon 600ml Drinking Bottle Small
feature_titles: BPA free & EU Food Safety Compliant
features: It's easy to grip and squeeze thanks to the grip collar and ergonomic shape
The wide screw-top opening allows for easy cleaning and refilling of the bottle
600ml fill, this bottle fits in most bicycle bottle cages
The screw-top lid comes in multiple colours to match your bike, kit and style
en-GB.description_html:
These squeezable ergonomically shaped drinking bottles will ensure you never have an excuse for not having fluids with you on the bike. They are BPA free and EU food-safe: so they're ready to fill with your favourite energy drink, or from that ice cold mountain stream.

Sensible advice:

(1) Wash it before you use it for the first time

(2) It is for cold drinks (<40°C) not for coffee or tea

(3) Don't put oil in it - it is a drinks bottle

(4) Don't leave liquids in it for more than 24 hours

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Thermal Bib Shorts
feature_titles: High stretch and anatomically optimised fit
features: Keeping legs and body warm during cold weather rides, enhancing comfort and allowing for better performance in cooler temperatures
Providing effective water repellency
Enhancing performance by allowing for efficient movement
Constructed from durable woven fabric
Designed with advanced padding technology
For visibility in traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The W's PACR Thermal Bib Shorts provide targeted warmth for cold-weather rides with Miti Superroubaix thermal fabric, ensuring insulation and comfort.

A DWR treatment offers effective water repellency, while the high-stretch, anatomically optimized fit supports efficient movement. Features include a practical, durable leg pocket and the advanced Elastic Interface chamois (PARIS HCS) for extended ride comfort.

Reflective details enhance visibility in traffic, making these bib shorts ideal for flexible, cold-weather cycling when paired with PACR Thermal Leg Warmers.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Arctic Hi-Vis Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers
features: Durable 4mm thermal neoprene with an impermeable coating protects your feet from road spray and winter downpours
Premium fleece-lined neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and protection against sub-zero temperatures and windchill
Unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoes
The Zipperless Cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to zippered designs
Reflective details and integrated safety light loop improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life
en-GB.description_html:
Cold and wet conditions shouldn’t stop you cycling in the winter – that’s where the GripGrab Arctic Hi-Vis Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers come in.

With the right kit and accessories, you can take on the conditions. These deep winter cycling shoe covers are made from durable 4mm thermal neoprene, with an impermeable coating to stop road spray and winter downpours from reaching your feet.

The premium fleece-lined neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and a shield against sub-zero temperatures and wind chill. This protection is further boosted by GripGrab’s unique IntelliSeal™ hem, which eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal around your cycling shoes.

The zipperless cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to overshoes with traditional zip designs.

Reflective details and an integrated safety light loop (light not included) can help to improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life and will keep you riding for longer.

The Arctic Hi-Vis Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers are the ultimate barrier against the worst winter conditions: keeping your feet warm and dry, so you can keep riding in comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Bandana
features: Protect your head from harmful UV rays thanks to UPF 40+ UV protection
The lightweight fabric offers maximum breathability along with a quick drying time
High-wicking material moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool and keep sweat out of your eyes
Low-profile and low bulk seams and material allow you to wear it underneath a cycling helmet
Machine washable and fast drying. A lot easier than washing your helmet pads after a sweltering ride
en-GB.description_html:
Do you want to emulate a bygone era of cycling headwear that will draw the attention of your cycling friends? With the GripGrab Bandana under your helmet you’ll certainly catch their eye.

How it looks might split opinion, but how it works cannot be disputed. This cycling bandana has UPF 40+ UV protection to protect your head from harmful UV rays. Keeping the sun at bay is good for your long-term skin health but will also help with temperature regulation during your bike ride.

The lightweight fabric of this summer cycling headwear offers maximum breathability along with a quick drying time, so when you do work up a sweat on a warm day or when pushing hard on a climb, the perspiration will soon evaporate away. The high-wicking material moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool, with the added benefit of keeping sweat out of your eyes so you can focus on the road ahead.

The GripGrab Bandana is low-profile and low bulk to allow you to wear it under a cycling helmet, and when you do break a sweat it is machine washable and fast drying — a lot easier than washing your helmet padding after each sweltering ride.

Be fashion brave but product sensible, with the GripGrab Bandana.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Freedom Thermal Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer
feature_titles: Seamless comfort – Seamless warp knit fabric offers a superb next-to-skin fit and feel
features: Warp knit fabric traps insulating air within to keep you warm in cool conditions
Breathable fabric and vented zones allow perspiration to escape from within
Fabric moves moisture away from the skin to keep you feeling dry and comfortable
Ideal for cool days in winter as well as milder days in the spring and autumn seasons
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Freedom Seamless Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer is a state of the art long sleeve cycling base layer that provides insulation and perspiration management with a unique adaptable fit.

The seamless high-tech knit construction eliminates bulky and irritating stitches, and aids freedom of movement; so you can concentrate on your performance feeling dry, warm and comfortable in changing winter conditions.

Whether pushing hard for those winter base miles, or relaxing in the café – the Freedom winter base layer will keep you warm, dry, and looking great. The ultimate cycling base layer for cool winter and transition season rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling Socks
features: The sock is designed to apply compression to your leg, shaping it into an oval form to enhance aerodynamics
Taking inspiration from golf balls, the sock's pattern creates a smoother air stream around the leg
The foot section of the sock, crafted from Coolmax® yarn, offers great breathability
The sock seamlessly integrates a highly comfortable foot section with an aerodynamic leg, eliminating cutlines between the two parts
en-GB.description_html:
Meticulously crafted through rigorous testing and expert consultation with aero engineers at Flanders Bike Valley, the GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling socks are engineered for optimal aerodynamic performance. These fully knitted aero socks represent the pinnacle of innovation, ensuring you experience an unmatched combination of speed and comfort on every ride.

Wind resistance is reduced with a selective compression of the leg muscles into a more oval shape, while the hexagonal knitted pattern, inspired by golf ball surfaces, promotes smoother airflow around the leg. The sock's foot section is crafted from Coolmax® yarn, ensuring maximum breathability and comfort. Pro tip: A simple wash after use will tighten the knit and restore the optimal level of compression before your next race day.

These aero cycling socks are seamless and uphold their commitment to function, comfort, and style.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Lightweight Vest
features: Lightweight Japanese windproof fabric (42g/m²) with water-repellent (DWR) coating on the front facing profile shields your torso from windchill
A breathable mesh back panel allows heat and perspiration to escape from within to keep you dry and comfortable
Allows you to regulate airflow and access jersey pockets beneath, without needing to take off the gilet
Zip up the vest to seal in the heat and keep the elements out when on long descents or during chilly starts
Enhance your visibility to other road users in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
A lightweight packable shield against windchill – the GripGrab PACR Windproof Lightweight Vest is a versatile and minimalist addition to your kit, which could make all the difference to your comfort on cool windy days and long descents.

Featuring a windproof front panel made from premium Japanese windproof fabric, this vest will help shield your torso from oncoming air particles that induce windchill on cool windy days. The fabric is also treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it will shrug off light showers and front wheel spray.

The open mesh back panel on the gilet allows moisture and heat to escape from within – so even as you work hard, you don’t build up a chill-inducing sweat. An elasticated lower hem with silicone gripper dots on the back of the gilet keeps everything securely in place as you battle into those headwinds.

A two-way YKK® Vislon zip on the front of the gilet allows you to unzip from the top and allow airflow through your layers, or unzip from the bottom to allow for easier access to your jersey pockets beneath. Reflective details on the rear help to improve your presence on the road in low light conditions.

Reach the top of that climb. Pull this gilet from your jersey pocket. Zip up the high-cut collar and shield your torso from that uncomfortable windchill on a long descent that follows. This gilet is your packable windchill protection.

en-GB.name: GripGrab UPF 50+ UV Protect Leg Sleeves
features: Offering lightweight comfort and sun protection for the legs
Ensuring sleeves stay comfortably in place during activity
Easily stows away in your jersey back pocket
Adding a touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab UPF 50+ UV Protect Leg Sleeves provide essential sun protection and comfort for riders in warm, sunny conditions. With highly breathable UPF 50+ fabric, these lightweight sleeves shield your legs from harmful UV rays while maintaining optimal airflow. Elastic silicone grippers ensure a secure, slip-free fit throughout your ride.

Compact and lightweight, they can be easily stowed in your jersey pocket when not in use. Reflective branding adds a touch of visibility. Ideal for any cyclist seeking practical sun protection and versatility.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Rebel Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: Offering high dexterity and a comfortable fit
Enhancing grip and control
Delivering a minimalistic fit and a clean, streamlined design
Allowing easy, on-the-move device control
Adding extra durability and wear resistance
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Rebel Full Finger Summer Gloves are built for trail shredders and park laps, combining rugged durability with standout style. Designed for riders who like to push the limits, the gloves feature a microsuede palm for a solid grip and excellent bar feel when carving lines, hitting jumps, or flowing through technical sections. Silicone print details add a touch of extra traction where it matters most.

Ready for whatever the trail dishes out, the gloves include reinforced fingertips for added durability while keeping things flexible. A low-profile slip-in cuff ensures a snug fit without the fuss, staying secure through every jump and turn. With breathable mesh construction to help keep things cool, these gloves are all about comfort and confidence on the ride. For those looking to bring a blend of style and function to their summer trail sessions, the Rebel Gloves have you covered.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PrimaLoft® Windproof Deep Winter Lobster Gloves
feature_titles: Deep-winter warmth that leaves your fingers free to brake and shift
PrimaLoft® Gold, 260 g/m² on the back of the hand
Five fingers inside a lobster outer
Windproof, water-repellent shell, no waterproof liner
features: Below freezing, cold fingers soon struggle to brake and shift. Dense insulation over the back of the hand keeps them warm, and separate fingers inside the lobster shell leave them free to work the levers. You stay on pace
Most of the insulation sits on the back of your hand, which faces the wind, with 100 g/m² in the palm for a direct grip
The warmth of a lobster glove, with each finger free to move
Use your bike computer or phone without taking the glove off
It breathes on hard efforts, so sweat is less likely to chill your hands

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey 2
feature_titles: Race-fit warmth that lets heat out when the effort rises
Breathable back panel that releases moisture
Bonded sleeve hems and pocket edges
features: Winter training at pace swings between hard efforts and easier spells, and a thermal jersey soon feels too warm, then too cold. This PACR jersey holds warmth with a brushed fabric and releases moisture through its back panel, so you stay steady through every interval
Heat and moisture escape on hard efforts, while the brushed fabric on the front and sleeves holds your warmth
A shorter body and sleeves keep the jersey close at speed, and a gripper hem holds it in place
Flat, clean edges lie close against your arms and back, for comfort in a low riding position
It holds your essentials at the back, zipped in, so they stay put through hard efforts

en-GB.name: GripGrab ProRide RC Max Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves
features: Features Ride Comfort Max, a combination of high-density padding and memory foam padding offering superior comfort and crash protection
Made of microsuede fabric, the palm provides comfort, protection and grip
Equipped with silicone print in the palm to optimise grip in all conditions, ensuring superior control and confidence
Achieve the perfect fit adjustment with the durable hook and loop closure
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab ProRide RC Max Padded Short Finger Gloves are designed to offer lasting hand comfort during long days in the saddle.

These gloves incorporate strategically placed padding designed for optimal comfort in various hand positions on the handlebars. The unique padding blend includes high-density foam in combination with memory foam, designed to reduce hand fatigue on long rides. The durable microsuede palm enhanced by silicone print, ensures a secure grip and protection in case of a crash, offering confidence and comfort during your rides.

Fans of the legendary GripGrab ProGel short finger gloves will appreciate this next generation model, drawing from two decades of expertise in designing cycling gloves. Designed with innovative patterns and materials, these gloves will enhance the comfort and protection of your hands during long rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Skull Cap
features: Flexible windproof fabric protects your head from windchill in cold winter conditions
Warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining offers insulation and comfort in cold weather

The Windproof Lightweight Thermal Skull Cap is a soft, lightweight and insulating cap with a windproof front. It offers a barrier against the wind for your ears and forehead, plus it will fit under your cycling helmet.

As well as cycling, the skullcap is also a great choice for running and other activities in cold conditions.

Made with a soft, brushed techno-fleece fabric inner, the skullcap has excellent insulating properties and a high degree of breathability.

The Windproof Lightweight Thermal Skull Cap can help you ride through the coldest months in comfort, ready to tick off those long winter kilometres.

en-GB.name: GripGrab ProGel Hi-Vis Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves

They are also easy to remove thanks to the in-between finger pull-off tabs. Once you have removed the gloves you can snap together the gMagnets™ for easy storage – keeping the gloves paired and easy to find the next time you need them – so you can get out the door sooner and ride for longer.

Whatever kind of cyclist you are, these gloves are good for adventures far from home, winning local races, smoothing out road vibrations on your commute or just for that added comfort while enjoying a bike ride.

The GripGrab Women's PACR Bib Shorts are designed for high performance and long days in the saddle. They are crafted from a robust stretch polyamide fabric featuring UPF50+ sun protection – a warp-knitted fabric offering significantly higher compression and power compared to other traditional cycling wear fabrics.

The bibs integrate the anatomically shaped Paris HCS pad from Elastic Interface to provide exceptional comfort during extended rides: an ultra high-density foam pad topped by a fabric including carbon thread with antistatic and bacteriostatic properties.

Designed with extra elastic straps configured so that you can pull down the shorts without needing to remove your jersey and bib straps, they make pee stops a lot easier to handle on the go. The elastic hems with an inner silicone gripper around the thighs ensure a secure fit in all riding conditions.

Created specifically for female cyclists, these high-performance cycling bib shorts are an ideal choice for your epic summer ride projects.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer 3-Pack

This three-pack offers exceptional value so you have a base layer for every day and every sport

The GripGrab RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer is your go-to option for all winter activities, from cycling to running and even skiing. The garment has special Polygiene® treatment applied to make it more resistant to odour build-up – meaning that you can wash it less and wear it more – including back-to-back rides on bikepacking trips (biocide: silver chloride).

Look to the RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer for day after day warmth as you ride through the winter; especially with this exceptional value three-pack; providing comfort and performance wear after wear.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Women's ProGel Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves

Experience the ideal combination of warmth and comfort with the interior waffle-knit pattern, providing enhanced insulation to keep you cozy during cold rides. The ultra-soft thermal fabric ensures superior comfort, making this base layer essential for chilly cycling adventures.

Embrace the balance of affordability and quality with the RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer, where comfort and durability come together to enhance your cycling experience without breaking the bank.

Look pro and keep your lower legs and feet warmer with the Alpine Merino High Cut Winter Socks – longer socks for cold weather rides.

Keep riding, no matter how cold the conditions get outside. The GripGrab Alpine Merino High Cut Winter Socks are your solution to preventing cold winter toes.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaShield Neoprene Raceday Gloves

The AquaShield Neoprene Raceday Gloves are built for performance road and gravel riders who need warmth, flexibility, and secure grip in cool, wet conditions. High-stretch neoprene provides a close, flexible fit that supports handlebar control when the weather turns wet.

Rather than aiming to keep the hand completely dry, the glove is designed to help the hand stay warmer in wet conditions. This makes it well suited to cool, wet race days and high-intensity training, where wet-condition warmth, dexterity, and control matter more than heavy insulation.

The extended cuff is designed to fit closely over the sleeve of a rain jacket, helping create a more secure transition between glove and jacket in wet conditions. A touchscreen-compatible thumb allows use of cycling computers and smartphones without removing the gloves.

en-GB.name: GripGrab R.A.Y. Musette Bag
features: Fully adjustable shoulder and cross-straps provide a stable, personalized fit to keep the bag securely in place
A spacious inner pocket offers quick access to essentials like keys and phone
Crafted from durable cotton, offering a classic look and long-lasting quality

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab R.A.Y. Musette Bag seamlessly combines practicality, durability, and style, drawing inspiration from the classic musette bags traditionally used in cycling races to provide riders with essential supplies. Crafted from heavy-duty cotton, it delivers a timeless aesthetic and robust, long-lasting quality. Unlike traditional musettes, we've added a cross-strap to keep the bag securely in place while riding, preventing it from sliding to the side and ensuring a more stable fit.

Highly versatile, this musette excels on race days, offering a convenient way to carry spare clothes and essentials before you hit the start line. It’s equally handy for bikepacking, providing a quick solution for grabbing supplies at shops or supermarkets. When riding into town, it serves as the perfect spot to stash your helmet, so you don’t have to leave it on your bike. With an internal pocket for easy access to keys, phones, and other must-haves, and subtle reflective details for added visibility, the R.A.Y. Musette Bag is designed for those seeking a functional and stylish solution for life on and off the bike.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Blend Half-Zip Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: Soft and comfortable merino and viscose fabrics for long cold days of outdoor activity
Use this as the base for your layering and stay warm on the coldest days of winter
Merino wool and viscose blend is naturally breathable to allow perspiration to escape
High cut collar offers increased insulation for your neck
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Blend Half-Zip Long Sleeve Base Layer is the height of luxury winter layering. The unique two-layer fabric combines a merino wool outer with a viscose blend inner, to create a super soft, incredibly breathable and highly insulating base layer.

The two natural fabrics are known for their outstanding temperature regulation and wicking performance; so they will keep you comfortable even when you are working hard in the winter months.

The turtle neck collar provides extra warmth and an extended barrier against the wind; but when you do need to allow heat to escape, the half-length zip makes it easy to encourage airflow through the layers.

Thumb holes are great for keeping the base layer in place when putting on your other layers.

This is your secret weapon for those deep winter bike rides and all kinds of other winter outdoor activities.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Women's ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights
features: Front, side and back panels use a three-layer softshell fabric construction with a fully waterproof and breathable membrane for maximum protection
The four-way stretch softshell fabric ensures a close and comfortable fit with maximum freedom of movement
Flatlock seams are pre-shaped and contoured to provide an optimised fit around the knees and through the leg motion
Removable padded liner shorts to wear beneath these unpadded bib tights, an Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP pad offers comfort for long distance rides
The underside of the thighs, back of the knees and the waist use a high-stretch fleece fabric for added insulation, breathability and comfort
en-GB.description_html:
To keep riding through autumn and winter you need apparel that will shield you from the elements and make you feel comfortable heading out in all conditions. The GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights are your leg wear solution – a versatile construction offering waterproof and windproof protection with great insulation against rough riding weather.

These bib tights utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your entire legs and lower back from the worst winter weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

In areas without the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the thighs, back of the knees and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added insulation and body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, like the other fabric panels, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs off rain showers and rear wheel spray.

The padding in the ThermaShell Bib Tights is unique – it comes in the form of a superior level seatpad fitted within removable GripGrab Ventilite Padded Liner Shorts – to wear underneath the unpadded outer bib tights.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The liner shorts themselves are made from a mix of high-stretch fabric and exceptionally breathable mesh, with a wide elastic waistband to minimise pressure points. Elastic grippers with silicone gripper dots on the hems keep the shorts firmly in place, even when worn underneath the tights.

When getting home, brush off the dirt off your tights while cleaning your bike – and they’re ready for the next ride. Meanwhile, you can keep the liner shorts on to complete your training with some core and stretch exercises indoor. The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the shorts without needing to wash the complete set of bib tights after each ride: this is better for the tights as they retain their waterproofing and performance for longer. This product construction will also allow you to ride during consecutive days without having to worry about washing and drying your bib tights, by simply rotating the inner shorts or Summer bibs that you wear under the long tights.

Further details include reflective elements that will help to enhance your road presence in low light conditions, as well as contoured flatlock seams that ensure a close comfortable fit, no matter how hard you are pedalling.

Designed in Denmark for the Scandinavian winters – these bib tights will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those long cold rides.

With the GripGrab Regular Cut Summer Socks you look and feel great, while riding in comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab SuperGel Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves

Those constant road vibrations and trail rumblings can jar even the supplest of joints – leaving your hands uncomfortably numb and affecting your handling on technical trails. Nobody likes to feel numb, and you need your hands to maintain control of the handlebars, hold onto the brake levers and shift through the gears.

The GripGrab SuperGel Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves are designed to offer maximum comfort, protection and control for your hands on summer bike rides.

The lightweight back panel of the gloves allows your hands to breathe, and if you do work up a sweat the SuperGel gloves have a sweat wiper on the thumb to brush away perspiration. When you finish riding you can easily take them off thanks to the pull-off tabs and click them together with the gMagnets™ for easy storage.

For those riders whose front door doesn’t open right onto the trails or for others who like to take to the road before sunrise and after sunset, the reflective details on these gloves will help to boost your visibility to other road users as you clock up the kilometres on the tarmac.

Whatever you do, from road cycling on the smoothest tarmac to gravel riding on the lumpiest trails, do it in comfort and style with the GripGrab SuperGel Short Finger Gloves.

Thanks to their pre-contoured shape, material bunching around your elbows won’t be a problem and the gripper at the top will hold them in place so you can avoid the dreaded upper arm skin gap.

The Classic Hi-Vis Thermal Arm Warmers are a useful addition to any cyclist’s kit drawer, ready to keep the chill off on cold mornings before folding up small into a jersey pocket when no longer needed.

Enhancing ventilation and boosting cooling comfort

These socks carry minimal branding and are available in a range of colours, so the GripGrab Airflow Lightweight Summer Socks are easy to match with any cycling kit and other accessories in the GripGrab range.

Experience the perfect blend of performance, protection, and style with the PACR Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers, designed to elevate your winter cycling experience with functionality and uncompromising performance for the dedicated rider.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves

Easily stored in a pocket or pannier, making them ideal for changeable weather and bikepacking tours
en-GB.description_html:
Sunscreen is a must on hot sunny rides, but if you intend to spend hours in the saddle on a summer’s day and don’t want to reapply every time you break a sweat on a climb, then you need another way to keep the sun at bay. The GripGrab UPF 50+ UV Protect Arm Sleeves have a high-UV protection of UPF 50+, which helps to block harmful sun rays from causing skin damage when cycling in hot summer weather – these are a shield against the sun that won’t get sweated away.

If you do break a sweat, the highly breathable lightweight stretch fabric is moisture wicking, so perspiration is transported away from the skin to assist with temperature regulation and rider comfort.

Getting the right size and fit isn’t a problem thanks to the pre-contoured shape of the GripGrab UPF 50+ UV Protect Arm Sleeves. Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural elbow bend and reduce material bunching that can lead to sweat build up and discomfort.

The anatomical shape also contributes to a secure fit, and along with the strong silicone elasticated grippers on the top of the UV sleeves it helps to prevent slippage down the arm – something no rider wants to have to put up with.

If the weather changes, these are easily packable and can be stored in a pocket or pannier – making them ideal for changeable weather and bikepacking tours. You won’t be able to tell they’re in your pocket, but you’ll be glad of them if the sun comes out again after a cloudy start to your ride.

Lightweight, breathable, sun-blocking and easily stowed, the GripGrab UPF 50+ UV Protect Arm Sleeves are a good choice for any summer cycling kit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE 2 Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves
features: for effective climate control
providing effective water repellency
promoting better hygiene
with high-grip surface
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE 2 Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves are designed for cyclists who value performance, comfort, and protection during the transitional seasons.

Featuring a windproof and breathable design, these gloves ensure your hands remain comfortably warm and shielded from the biting wind. The durable water repellent (DWR) treatment on the outer fabric helps repel light rain and road spray.

These gloves are ideal for cool weather conditions, offering essential insulation without bulk. The ergonomically padded palms with a high-grip surface provide optimal comfort and control, allowing for a secure hold on the handlebars. Additionally, the advanced odor-resistant lining promotes better hygiene, reducing the need for frequent washing.

Elevate your cycling experience during the spring and autumn seasons with the RIDE 2 Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves, where affordability meets quality and functionality, perfect for those cool, windy days on the bike.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Kids' Thermal Winter Balaclava
features: Stay warm and comfortable cycling in the most extreme winter conditions
High-wicking insulating fleece moves moisture away from your face to keep you dry
Anatomically shaped flat-lock seams and thin elastic fabric easily adapts to all face shapes
Convert from full face mask and neck warmer to hood by pulling down the elastic pre-shaped front breathing panel
Versatile design means it can be worn for cycling, skiing, hiking, climbing and trekking
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Kids’ Thermal Winter Balaclava is a piece of deep winter kit for those young riders who don’t know the term ‘off-season’.

The balaclava provides insulation for the head and neck on the coldest days of winter, with the option of pulling up the front panel for greater coverage of the mouth and nose – a highly effective way of reducing how much skin is exposed to the harsh windchill of deep winter.

Low profile and lightweight, the thermal balaclava will fit comfortably under a child’s cycling helmet for winter riding, but it is also suited to other outdoor activities such as hiking and running in the coldest conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves
features: Delivering superior cushioning for extended rides
Offering high dexterity and a comfortable fit
Providing a secure, adjustable fit
Blending flexibility, breathability, and comfort
Enhancing grip and control
Adding a minimalistic touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RIDE Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves deliver exceptional value without compromising on comfort or performance. Building on the trusted heritage of the ProGel series, these gloves offer superior cushioning through a fully padded palm, reducing fatigue and ensuring all-day riding comfort. Drawing on extensive expertise, each piece of padding is carefully shaped and precisely placed for optimal support. The microsuede palm provides a soft, dexterous fit, enhancing bar feel and grip.

Designed with a flexible, breathable back panel, these gloves keep your hands cool and comfortable on warm days, while silicone-enhanced palm sections offer dependable grip and control. A simple and secure hook-and-loop closure allows for easy adjustment and a personalized fit, with reflective accents adding a touch of visibility in low-light conditions. For cyclists seeking a practical, reliable, and affordable option, the RIDE Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves combine proven comfort with outstanding value for every ride.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Primavera 2 Merino Spring-Autumn Gloves
features: A merino wool/synthetic blend for super soft, high stretch and exceptionally breathable gloves
Silicone grip print on the outside and InsideGrip™ on the inside of the palm offers unparalleled grip and control
Reinforced thumb joint and durable silicone grip help to extend the lifespan of these gloves even with everyday use
Reflective detailing helps to improve your road presence and hand signalling visibility in low light conditions
Forefinger and thumb use durable interwoven conductive copper threads to allow use of touchscreens on the go
en-GB.description_html:
Lightweight gloves are what cyclists need on spring and autumn rides. The GripGrab Primavera 2 Merino Spring-Autumn Gloves are a highly breathable second skin for use on cool spring and autumn days.

These cycling gloves are made from a high-performance blended fabric: the merino wool/synthetic blend provides you with the super soft and naturally insulating properties of merino wool, enhanced by the wicking capabilities and durability of the interwoven synthetic fibres. The result is great comfort and performance.

These wool cycling gloves include GripGrab’s award winning InsideGrip™: the silicone print on the outside coupled with InsideGrip™ on the inside of the palm offers unparalleled grip on the handlebars and levers. The durability of the high stretch fabric is enhanced by the reinforced thumb joint and silicone palm grip. These features help to extend the lifespan of these lightweight gloves, even with regular use.

The GripGrab Primavera 2 Merino Spring-Autumn Gloves include reflective detailing to help improve your road presence and hand signalling visibility in low light conditions. Durable interwoven conductive copper threads on the forefinger and thumb mean there is no need to remove the gloves if you need to answer a call or take a photo. This functionality does not fade or wash out with use.

These lightweight gloves are a snug fit, so we suggest ordering a size up if you are on the borderline between two sizes. The fingers are a slender fit for that second skin feel, so some riders will need to size up for the best comfort.

As well as cycling, these gloves are suitable for other activities such as running and hiking. The GripGrab Primavera 2 Merino Spring-Autumn Gloves are lightweight, breathable cycling gloves for cooler days in the transitional seasons.

en-GB.name: GripGrab UPF 50+ Lightweight Summer Skull Cap
features: Offering lightweight sun protection for the head
Effectively wicking moisture and drying quickly for lasting comfort
Ensuring a comfortable fit under the helmet
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab UPF 50+ Lightweight Summer Skull Cap provides essential sun protection and comfort for warm-weather rides. Made with highly breathable UPF 50+ fabric, it shields your head from harmful UV rays while effectively managing sweat and drying quickly to keep you comfortable.

Compact and lightweight, it fits comfortably under a helmet without adding bulk. This versatile skull cap is a practical accessory for any cyclist seeking protection and comfort during summer rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey
features: Soft and breathable microfleece fabric with a brushed inner provides insulation and effective moisture management
Allows you to regulate airflow and temperature as you ride
Three rear top entry pockets and one zipped pocket, to house all your ride essentials
Enhance your visibility to other road users in low light conditions
A close-fitting cut and raglan sleeves provide a sleek silhouette with freedom of movement: optimised for performance
en-GB.description_html:
High-stretch, close-fitting and lightly insulating – the GripGrab PACR Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey is designed with performance in mind.

The stretchy microfleece fabric will trap a layer of insulating air within – to keep the cool air of spring and autumn from chilling you. With a high breathability rating and soft brushed inner, this jersey leaves you dry and comfortable.

The PACR Long Sleeve Jersey has a ‘close’ fit — offering a more performance orientated cut that avoids excess material and remains comfortable in a more aggressive racing position. Raglan sleeves have been used to allow for maximum freedom of movement, while still retaining a sleek silhouette.

With a full length YKK® zip for easy airflow regulation and layering, silicone hem grippers to keep things in place and reflective detailing, this jersey has everything you need for the variable temperatures and light conditions of the transition seasons. Three rear pockets and one smaller zipped pocket can house all your long ride essentials.

Soft, warm and with a performance edge: the GripGrab PACR Long Sleeve Jersey will let you race along the road or gravel tracks in comfort and style, as you rack up those winter riding hours.

en-GB.name: GripGrab CyclinGaiter Shoe Cover Cuffs
features: The CyclinGaiter ankle cuff uses waterproof coated neoprene to create a more water-tight seal between shoe cover cuff and leg
The addition of the CyclinGaiter extends the height of your shoe covers up your legs to offer greater coverage against front wheel spray
The 2.5mm neoprene is windproof, waterproof and insulating, helping to keep your ankles and lower legs dry and warm
For optimum performance wear the CyclinGaiter next to your skin with your leg warmers or tights over the top. Invisible protection!
Use with MTB waterproof winter boots to enhance the seal around your lower leg and improve their wet weather performance
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab CyclinGaiter Shoe Cover Cuffs are ingenious products from GripGrab – waterproof coated neoprene cuffs to create a more watertight seal between the top cuff of your cycling shoes covers and your legs.

The addition of the CyclinGaiter extends the height of your shoe covers or winter MTB boots up your legs to offer greater coverage against front wheel spray.

The 2.5mm neoprene is windproof, waterproof and insulating. This helps to keep your ankles and lower legs drier and warmer on damp rides on wet roads and trails.

For optimum performance we suggest that you wear the CyclinGaiters next to your skin with your leg warmers or tights over the top. This provides a hidden barrier against spray and puddles, and improves the ‘seal’.

Use the CyclinGaiters with shoe covers or MTB waterproof winter boots to enhance the seal around your lower leg and improve their wet weather performance. Keep riding in comfort, in all weather conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Winter Socks
feature_titles: Stretch arch support for superior fit
features: Merino wool blend fabric creates a beautifully soft feel and insulating layer for your feet
Merino wool and synthetic fibres combine to create a highly breathable and moisture wicking layer
Additional padding on the underside of the socks creates cushioning and extra insulation
Elasticated arch and cuffs ensure that the socks remain firmly in place and there is no bunching
Merino wool blend delivers a practical and long-lasting garment with no need for special treatments
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Winter Socks bring together the best of natural merino wool and combine it with the benefits of synthetic fibres – making these the socks to keep you riding in comfort throughout the winter months.

Merino wool is a wonder material for thermal regulation: it will keep can help to keep you cooler in hot summer conditions and insulate your feet in cold winter conditions. Merino wool fibres are exceptionally fine – which means they create a beautifully soft, non-itchy fabric. In these socks, merino wool is interwoven with synthetic fibres to a create a blend fabric that is significantly stronger and more durable.

This combination of fibres also assists moisture management. While merino wool can absorb up to 35% of its own weight in water without feeling wet to the touch, the synthetic fibres help moisture to quickly evaporate away.

Additional padding on the underside of the socks creates cushioning and extra insulation, adding to the overall superior comfort of these winter cycling socks.

For warm, comfortable feet on cold winter rides, the naturally soft and insulating Merino Winter Socks should be in every rider’s kit selection.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Regular Cut Socks
features: Merino wool blend provides comfort and light warmth
Keeps feet dry and fresh in all conditions
Ensures a snug, secure fit with no bunching
Long-lasting fabric with no special treatment needed
Ideal for cycling in all seasons
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Regular Cut Socks are made from 50% merino wool, to create a luxurious active sports sock.

The summer weight fabric provides exceptional breathability, temperature regulation and has that well known super-soft merino wool feel.

The perfect socks for riding in spring, summer, autumn and winter (combined with overshoes on the coldest days). Thanks to their lighter weight construction, you can comfortably wear these socks in your summer cycling shoes.

Merino wool has insulating and cooling properties – keeping your feet warm in winter.

No matter what type of cycling you do – road, gravel or MTB – the GripGrab Merino Regular Cut socks fit any occasion.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Hi-Vis Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves
features: Windproof stretch fabric with soft fleece lining for insulation on spring and autumn days
DoctorGel® padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve to avoid numbness and discomfort in your hands
Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control
Microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to swipe sweat and nose drips away on those chilly autumn days
Enhances your visibility in low light conditions and helps make hand gestures more prominent in urban traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Hi-Vis Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves are for riders who relish the windswept conditions of spring and autumn.

On dry windy days these gloves will keep your hands warm and comfortable. The premium windproof fabric shields you against windchill, so you can keep your focus on the road.

The silicone print gripper palms and fingertips offer a secure hold on the handlebars and levers, for enhanced control.

These gloves provide riders with the comfort and control needed to keep riding through the changeable transition seasons.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Lightweight Summer Cycling Cap
features: Protect your head from harmful UV rays with UPF40+ UV protection
High-wicking material moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool and keep sweat out of your eyes
The lightweight fabric offers maximum breathability along with a quick drying time
Low-profile and low bulk seams and material allow you to wear it comfortably underneath a cycling helmet
Machine washable and fast drying. A lot easier than washing your helmet padding after a sweltering ride
en-GB.description_html:
The cycling cap – casquette – is a timeless piece of cycling kit. As jersey and shorts have changed over the decades, the cycling cap has stayed consistent in style and functionality, as well as in their appeal to the fashion-conscious rider.

But cycling caps are not fashion without function; the GripGrab Lightweight Summer Cycling Cap offers sun protection and sweat management when you are working hard in the summer heat.

The GripGrab Lightweight Summer Cycling Cap has UPF40+ UV protection to help protect your head from harmful UV rays. Meanwhile the high-wicking material moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool and keep sweat out of your eyes on warm summer days – so you can concentrate the road ahead.

While this cycling cap will absorb perspiration, the lightweight fabrics are also fast drying and offer maximum breathability – so moisture build-up soon evaporates away.

With a low-profile design and low bulk seams, you can easily wear this cap under a cycling helmet with comfort.

Once your ride is finished, the cap is machine washable – which is a lot easier than washing your helmet padding after a sweltering ride. A great piece of headwear for your summer ride adventures.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer 3-Pack
features: Ultralight open mesh fabric allows heat and moisture to escape from within, keeping you cool in hot summer conditions
Premium moisture wicking material transports sweat away from your body to keep you dry and comfortable
Polygiene® fabric treatment keeps you and your clothing smelling fresh for longer by reducing bacteria build-up
Superlight mesh fabric and low profile seams create a featherweight feel and a form-fitting cut
Better per unit price to keep you riding in comfort on consecutive warm days
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer is your go-to short sleeve base layer for summer cycling in sweltering heat. The featherweight open-weave mesh material allows your skin to breathe while quickly moving sweat away from your body to leave you dry and comfortable.

To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment (biocide: silver chloride). Its 'Wear More. Wash Less®' technology uses silver ions to reduce the build-up of odour-inducing bacteria. The treatment is entirely safe to wear against the skin and doesn’t wash out. Reduced bacteria build-up leads to reduced odour and therefore reduced washing frequency, meaning that Polygiene® can also significantly extend the life of a base layer.

The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer offers you the comfort to keep riding in the hottest conditions. With minimum weight but maximum breathability, it has all the performance and functionality you need when working hard in the summer heat.

Great value in this pack of three.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Waterproof Shell Lobster Gloves
feature_titles: Keep your gloves, and add a waterproof shell when it rains
Made to go over any glove
Lobster shape with a closing cuff
features: Multi-day rain and wet commutes soak ordinary winter gloves, and carrying a waterproof glove for every temperature is impractical. This seam-taped lobster shell pulls over the gloves you already wear when it rains, so your warmth goes further and your hands stay protected
Taped seams help keep rain out where the shell is joined

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Short Sleeve Jersey

The GripGrab PACR Short Sleeve Jersey is designed for high-performance rides, offering a tight yet comfortable fit. Constructed using lightweight, breathable, and durable fabrics, it provides an outstanding riding experience.

The jersey features raglan sleeves, no underarm seam, a lower collar, and silicone grippers at the sleeve hem and bottom hem, ensuring great freedom of movement and ergonomic comfort. Additionally, the jersey includes three top-entry pockets and a secured zip pocket, allowing for convenient storage. For enhanced visibility, all logos are reflective.

This is a jersey that you can pick for race days or whenever you feel ready to turn up the pace during epic summer rides!

en-GB.name: GripGrab Airflow Lightweight Short Summer Socks
features: Highly breathable Airflow open-mesh zones allow your feet to breathe and perspire
COOLMAX® fibre technology wicks sweat and moisture away from your skin
Ultralight fabric for a minimalist feel and super low bulk inside your cycling shoes
Stretch arch support and elasticated cuffs create a close-fitting profile
Subtle branding and a choice of colours for all summer cycling outfits
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Airflow Lightweight Short Summer Socks are ideal for summer cycling  – these are the cycling socks you need for the hottest rides and when taking on the hardest climbs.

The highly breathable Airflow open-mesh zones ensure exceptional breathability while the COOLMAX® fibre technology moves moisture away from your skin for excellent temperature regulation.

These cycling socks are manufactured to have a performance fit as the stretch arch support produces a close-fitting profile.

Their lightweight construction means they have a featherlight feel and you will barely know you are wearing them.

These socks carry minimal branding and are available in a range of colours, so the GripGrab Airflow Lightweight Short Summer Socks are easy to match with any cycling kit and other accessories in the GripGrab range.

en-GB.name: GripGrab EXPLR Padded Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: Delivering superior cushioning for extended rides
Offering superior durability and enhanced airflow
Enhancing ventilation and boosting cooling comfort
Enhancing grip and control
Allowing easy, on-the-move device control
Providing a secure, adjustable fit
Delivering effective sweat removal and gentle eyewear cleaning
Adding a minimalistic touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab EXPLR Padded Full Finger Summer Gloves are designed for riders who thrive on adventure, tackling rugged terrain and extended journeys. With a fully padded palm, these gloves offer superior cushioning to reduce fatigue during long days in the saddle, while the perforated microsuede ensures durability and optimal airflow for lasting comfort, even on the toughest rides.

Crafted for those who explore off the beaten path, the gloves feature airflow mesh to keep hands cool in changing conditions, while silicone-enhanced palm sections provide reliable grip and control across varied surfaces. The touchscreen-compatible design lets you stay connected on the go, and an adjustable hook-and-loop closure offers a secure, tailored fit for all-day support. A built-in sweat wiper ensures you stay focused, managing moisture with ease, making these gloves an essential companion for riders who crave adventure and exploration.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Grinta Short Sleeve Jersey
features: Features a high but comfortable level of compression
Crafted from cutting-edge thermoregulating fabrics with outstanding sweat-wicking capabilities
The high end woven fabrics provide enhanced durability and 2nd skin feel
Features reflective logos to enhance visibility in low-light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
"Grinta" refers to the mental and physical toughness, resilience, and strong-willed attitude that cyclists exhibit, especially when facing challenging conditions, difficult terrain, or intense racing situations. The Grinta Short Sleeve Jersey is designed precisely for this type of ride. It is aerodynamic and achieves a best-in-class combination of enduring comfort and performance. Its snug sleeves and compressive body offer a streamlined fit. The high-end woven fabrics guarantee exceptional durability while providing an impressive second-skin feel.

The innovative textured fabric with micro-channels on the front and back panels enables thermo-regulation and moisture management, eliminating the need to wear a base layer underneath it. With premium details like raglan sleeves, no underarm seam, a low collar, and a bonded bottom hem, this jersey seamlessly blends performance and comfort for an unparalleled cycling experience.

The GripGrab Grinta Short Sleeve Jersey is made to help you push your limits during a race, a long ride or any other ambitious personal cycling challenge.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts
features: Front, side and back panels use a three-layer softshell fabric construction with a fully waterproof and breathable membrane for maximum protection
The stretch softshell fabric with flatlock seams ensures a close and comfortable fit, while silicone grippers on the bottom hem ensure a secure hold
Offers superior comfort during long distance rides with its high-density foam in an anatomically contoured design
The underside of the leg and waist use a high-stretch fleece fabric for added breathability and comfort
A Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment adds extra water-resistance to the fabrics
en-GB.description_html:
As summer fades, your summer cycling bib shorts become less optimal legwear: designed to offer maximum breathability, they will do little to shield your leg muscles and lower body from the arrival of cold and wet conditions. The GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts are your solution – a pair of comfortable padded bib shorts that offer waterproof and windproof protection, to keep you riding in comfort through the transition seasons and into winter.

These bib shorts utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your legs from cold weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the legs and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the other fabrics on the shorts, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it too effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

The seatpad used in the AquaRepel Bib Shorts is from Italian market-leader Elastic Interface. The LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees superior comfort during long distance rides thanks to the very high-density foam inserts. These are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

Reflective details have been added to the bib shorts to help enhance your road presence in low light conditions, while silicone grippers on the leg hems and flatlock seams ensure the bib shorts stay firmly and comfortably in place, worn with or without leg warmers.

Designed in Denmark for the unpredictable Scandinavian autumn and winter, these bib shorts will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those winter rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey
features: Soft and breathable fleece fabric with a brushed inner provides insulation and effective moisture management
Allows you to regulate airflow and temperature as you ride
Three rear top entry pockets and one zipped pocket, to house all your ride essentials
Enhance your visibility to other road users in low light conditions
Ideal for those seeking an athletic cut with comfort in mind
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey is crafted from thermal fleece fabric with a soft, brushed inner layer, providing insulation and effective moisture management for cool-weather rides.

Equipped with a full-length YKK zip, it allows easy temperature regulation. The jersey includes three rear top-entry pockets and one zipped pocket for secure storage of ride essentials.

Reflective details enhance visibility in low-light conditions, while the active fit delivers an athletic yet comfortable cut, making it an ideal choice for riders seeking warmth and functionality.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Spring-Autumn High Cut Socks

Arch support, terry only where needed

Nylon reinforcements on the sole, heel and toe, where long days wear a sock first
Merino absorbs moisture vapour into the fibre, so odour builds more slowly and you can wear the pair again the next day
