en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceThermo X Waterproof Winter MTB/CX Shoe Covers
features: Durable 4mm waterproof neoprene protects your feet from spray, mud and wind chill in wet off-road conditions
Premium neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and protection from cold temperatures and windchill
Unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoe
The Zipperless Cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to zippered designs
Reflective details and integrated safety light loop improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RaceThermo X Waterproof Winter Shoe Covers are cycling overshoes to keep you riding on the trails even in the wet and cold of winter. The durable 4mm neoprene effectively shields your feet against spray, mud and windchill in wet off-road conditions.

The premium neoprene offers insulation and protection against cold temperatures and windchill. The zipperless cuff design further helps with warmth retention by creating a better seal around your legs, while also reducing irritation, increasing flexibility and extending the product life compared to standard zip designs. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements help to protect the neoprene material and further boost product life.

GripGrab’s unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoe. Meanwhile reflective details and an integrated safety light loop (light not included) can help to improve visibility.

The RaceThermo X Waterproof Winter Shoe Covers will keep your feet warm, dry and comfortable as you head out on the tracks and trails during winter.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey
features: Crafted from breathable, stretchy materials offering comfort and performance
Includes 3 top-entry pockets and 1 zippered pocket on the back
Equipped with a full-length YKK zipper allowing you to regulate airflow
Stays securely in place thanks to the silicone grippers integrated into the bottom hem
Features reflective logos to enhance visibility in low-light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
Truly essential, this sharp-looking jersey ensures a perfect cycling fit while encompassing all the features one would expect from a top-tier garment.

Crafted from breathable material offering a balanced amount of stretch, the GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey is designed to deliver on comfort and performance. The full-length zipper allows you to regulate airflow according to the riding conditions. Equipped with three top-entry back pockets and a small zippered pocket, it securely accommodates the fuel and tools you'll need to bring on a ride. The silicone gripper at the bottom hem guarantees a secure fit, and the reflective logos enhance visibility in low-light settings.

For a matching look and optimal comfort, we suggest pairing it with the GripGrab RIDE Bib Shorts.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Winter Road Shoe Covers
features: Waterproof 4mm neoprene protects your road cycling shoes from spray and dirt
The shoe cover traps heat to keep your feet warm and comfortable in cold weather conditions
Simple hook-and-loop closure on the rear of the shoe covers allows for easy fitting and removal
To help enhance your presence to other road users in low light conditions
High quality at a more affordable price point
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RIDE Winter Road Shoe Covers will keep your feet comfortable in cold and wet winter conditions.

Made from waterproof high-stretch neoprene with waterproof seams – they provide good protection against spray and dirt.

The hook-and-loop closure on the rear of the overshoes makes them super easy to take on and off.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Visibility Vest
features: Help increase rider visibility in low-light conditions
Supports breathability and low-bulk comfort over cycling apparel
Creates a close fit that follows the body in a riding position
Sits above jersey and jacket rear pockets for easier access while riding
Adds reflective visibility without windproof, waterproof, or insulating protection
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Visibility Vest is built for performance road and gravel riders who want to add a lightweight visibility layer over their existing cycling kit in low-light conditions. It is made for early starts, grey training days, commutes, and rides where reflective visibility is useful without adding windproof, waterproof, or insulating protection.

Ultra-light airflow mesh helps reduce bulk and allows heat and moisture to escape, so the vest can sit comfortably over a jersey, gilet, or jacket. The super-stretch material creates a close fit in a riding position and helps reduce excess fabric while riding.

The short fit is designed to sit above jersey and jacket rear pockets, keeping ride essentials easy to reach. Reflective elements help increase rider visibility in low-light conditions.

Built as a dedicated visibility layer, this vest adds reflective visibility with minimal disruption to fit, breathability, or pocket access. It is not designed as a windproof vest, rain shell, or insulating layer, and it does not replace legally required bike lights where those are needed.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
features: Helps protect road cycling shoes from rain and road spray
Forms closely around road cycling shoes for a secure, stable fit
Makes the shoe covers easy to put on and take off

en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are built for road cyclists who need simple, reliable rain protection for wet rides, commutes, and training in road spray. A waterproof construction helps shield road cycling shoes from rain and spray, while the stretch material forms closely over the shoe for a secure road-specific fit. The rear hook-and-loop closure makes the shoe covers easy to put on and take off.

The road-specific cut helps reduce excess material around road shoes for a clean, stable fit. Anti-abrasion tread pads add a tough, wear-resistant layer under the shoe cover to help protect high-wear sole areas during walking and repeated ground contact. Reflective detailing helps increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built for dependable wet-weather road riding without unnecessary complexity, these shoe covers provide practical protection against rain and road spray. Like all cycling shoe covers, water may still enter through unavoidable openings such as the cleat/sole area or from the top cuff during prolonged or heavy rain.

en-GB.name: GripGrab EXPLR Insulated Jacket

For visibility in traffic

Equipped with PrimaLoft® Gold insulation, it provides an excellent warmth-to-weight ratio. The DWR treatment offers effective water repellency against light rain, while breathable construction ensures comfort during active wear.

Practical pockets support multifunctional use, and reflective details enhance visibility in low-light conditions. With a minimalist design, this jacket is a versatile addition to the EXPLR line.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Running Expert Hi-Vis Touchscreen Winter Gloves

en-GB.name: GripGrab Expert 2 Thermal Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer

This unique fabric treatment is perfectly safe to wear next-to-skin, and helps to keep your base layer and you smelling fresher for longer.

The Expert 2 is a seamless and flawless base to any winter cycling outfit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceThermo Hi-Vis Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Regular Cut Socks

features: Front, side and back panels use a three-layer softshell fabric construction with a fully waterproof and breathable membrane for maximum protection

Offers superior comfort during long distance rides with its high-density foam in an anatomically contoured design
The underside of the leg and waist use a high-stretch fleece fabric for added breathability and comfort
A Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment adds extra water-resistance to the fabrics
en-GB.description_html:
As summer fades, your summer cycling bib shorts become less optimal legwear: designed to offer maximum breathability, they will do little to shield your leg muscles and lower body from the arrival of cold and wet conditions. The GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts are your solution – a pair of comfortable padded bib shorts that offer waterproof and windproof protection, to keep you riding in comfort through the transition seasons and into winter.

These bib shorts utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your legs from cold weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the legs and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the other fabrics on the shorts, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it too effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

The seatpad used in the AquaRepel Bib Shorts is from Italian market-leader Elastic Interface. The LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees superior comfort during long distance rides thanks to the very high-density foam inserts. These are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

Reflective details have been added to the bib shorts to help enhance your road presence in low light conditions, while silicone grippers on the leg hems and flatlock seams ensure the bib shorts stay firmly and comfortably in place, worn with or without leg warmers.

Designed in Denmark for the unpredictable Scandinavian autumn and winter, these bib shorts will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those winter rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Flow 2in1 Technical Cycling Shorts
features: Includes separate padded underwear shorts to wear for cycling
The outer shorts are crafted from reinforced 4-way stretch woven fabric and reinforced stitching
Define your most comfortable fit with the adjustment clips placed on the hips
Repels light rain and road spray with durable DWR treatment
Stores small items or phone securely and comfortably in a zipped leg pocket while cycling
en-GB.description_html:
The versatile GripGrab Flow 2in1 Technical Cycling Shorts come with separate padded underwear shorts, allowing you to use them for cycling but also off the bike. The outer shorts are constructed with reinforced 4-way stretch woven fabric and stitching, ensuring comfort, durability and resilience on rugged terrains.

Featuring waist adjustments, these shorts can easily be customised to find a secure and comfortable fit. The DWR treatment adds water repellency if meeting unstable weather conditions.

The padded underwear shorts are lightweight and stretch. Equipped with a quality cycling pad, they ensure a smooth and comfortable experience in the saddle.

While these 2in1 shorts offer a stylish and casual look, their high-quality fabric and stretch make them extremely versatile: hiking, urban exploring, off-road riding, these shorts perform impressively well in a multitude of terrains and situations.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Kids' X-Trainer Short Finger Summer Gloves
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Kids' X-trainer Short Finger Summer Gloves offer great hand protection, bike control and comfort for active children.

 Made from high quality materials, and featuring padded palms, they offer an excellent fit and great durability for young cycling enthusiasts in the summer months.

en-GB.name: GripGrab 3-Season Short Sleeve Base Layer
features: Open mesh fabric on the front of the torso allows heat to escape from within, keeping you cool
Moisture-wicking solid back panel transports sweat away from your body to keep you dry and comfortable
Lightly insulating fabric keeps you comfortable in a wide range of temperature conditions
High-stretch mesh fabric and low-profile seams create a low-bulk feel and form-fitting cut
Ideal for road cycling, gravel biking and mountain biking in mild and warm conditions
en-GB.description_html:
A three-season base layer could be one of the most versatile pieces of kit you ever buy. Indeed, for many people, a product such as the GripGrab 3-Season Base Layer could be the first thing you reach for before every ride – the foundation of a riding outfit, almost all year round.

A three-season base layer is designed and made to keep you dry and comfortable in a range of varying weather conditions. The GripGrab 3-Season Base Layer is made from a four-way stretch fabric so that it fits like a second skin; it features an open mesh weave on the front of the base layer and a solid fabric panel on the rear of the torso.

The unique design is focussed on maximum versatility. The open weave front allows maximum ventilation with a jersey unzipped on a sweltering summer climb, while the solid high-wicking material back panel draws moisture away from your skin to keep you dry and comfortable – even in the chillier transitional seasons.

The highly breathable and lightly insulating fabric keeps you comfortable in a wide range of temperature conditions.

Ideal for road cycling, gravel biking and mountain biking in mild and warm conditions, this is a versatile piece of kit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Short Sleeve Base Layer 2-Pack
features: Ultralight open mesh fabric allows heat and moisture to escape from within, keeping you cool in hot summer conditions
Premium moisture wicking material transports sweat away from your body to keep you dry and comfortable
Polygiene® fabric treatment keeps you and your clothing smelling fresh for longer by reducing bacteria build-up
Superlight mesh fabric and low profile seams create a featherweight feel and a form-fitting cut
Better per unit price to keep you riding in comfort on consecutive warm days
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Short Sleeve Base Layer is your go-to short sleeve base layer for summer cycling in sweltering heat. The featherweight open-weave mesh material allows your skin to breathe while quickly moving sweat away from your body to leave you dry and comfortable.

To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment. Its 'Wear More. Wash Less®' technology uses silver ions to reduce the build-up of odour-inducing bacteria. The treatment is entirely safe to wear against the skin and doesn’t wash out (biocide: silver chloride). Reduced bacteria build-up leads to reduced odour and therefore reduced washing frequency, meaning that Polygiene® can also significantly extend the life of a base layer.

The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Short Sleeve Base Layer offers you the comfort to keep riding in the hottest conditions. With minimum weight but maximum breathability, it has all the performance and functionality you need when working hard in the summer heat.

Now it a great value two-pack.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Arctic Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers
features: Durable 4mm thermal neoprene with an impermeable coating protects your feet from road spray and winter downpours
Premium fleece-lined neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and protection against sub-zero temperatures and wind chill
Unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoe
The Zipperless Cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to zippered designs
Reflective details and integrated safety light loop help to improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life
en-GB.description_html:
Cold and wet conditions shouldn’t stop you cycling in the winter – that’s where the GripGrab Arctic Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers come in.

With the right kit and accessories, you can take on the conditions. These deep winter cycling shoe covers are made from durable 4mm thermal neoprene, with an impermeable coating to stop road spray and winter downpours from reaching your feet.

The premium fleece-lined neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and a shield against sub-zero temperatures and wind chill. This protection is further boosted by GripGrab’s unique IntelliSeal™ hem, which eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal around your cycling shoes.

The zipperless cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to overshoes with traditional zip designs.

Reflective details and an integrated safety light loop (light not included) can help to improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life and will keep you riding for longer.

The Arctic Deep Winter Shoe Covers are the ultimate barrier against the worst winter conditions: keeping your feet warm and dry, so you can keep riding in comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceThermo Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers
features: Durable 4mm waterproof neoprene with an impermeable coating protects your feet against road spray and winter downpours
Premium neoprene offers supreme warmth retention and protection from cold temperatures and windchill
Unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoe
The Zipperless Cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to traditional zip designs

en-GB.description_html:
Available in black and hi-vis yellow, the GripGrab RaceThermo Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers are the cycling overshoes you need to keep riding in the wet and cold conditions of the winter months.

Durable 4mm waterproof neoprene, with an impermeable coating, will keep out road spray and winter downpours. The neoprene material also offers supreme warmth retention and insulation against cold temperatures and windchill on colder days.

GripGrab’s unique IntelliSeal™ hem eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your shoes. This is combined with the zipperless cuff design, which reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to traditional zip designs.

Reflective detailing and an integrated safety light loop (light not included) can help to improve your visibility, while aramid fibre wear reinforcements will boost the product lifespan.

Keep riding through winter with warm, dry feet thanks to the RaceThermo’s insulation and wet weather protection.

Find a sock colour that will match your favourite cycling kit to create that ultimate summer look

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Classic High Cut Summer Socks will keep your feet cool and comfortable on warm summer rides. The CoolMax® Mesh fabric is highly breathable and allows heat and perspiration to escape, so your feet stay dry when you are pushing hard on the pedals.

The lightweight fabric has minimal bulk – optimised to fit inside cycling shoes; while the stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics create a light compression feel for a superb close-fitting cut.

With the GripGrab Classic High Cut Summer Socks you look and feel great while riding in comfort.

Truly essential, this sharp-looking jersey ensures a perfect cycling fit while encompassing all the features one would expect from a top-tier garment.

Crafted from breathable material offering a balanced amount of stretch, the GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey is designed to deliver on comfort and performance. The full-length zipper allows you to regulate airflow according to the riding conditions. Equipped with three top-entry back pockets and a small zippered pocket, it securely accommodates the fuel and tools you'll need to bring on a ride. The silicone gripper at the bottom hem guarantees a secure fit, and the reflective logos enhance visibility in low-light settings.

For a matching look and optimal comfort, we suggest pairing it with the GripGrab RIDE Bib Shorts.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Solara Mesh Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves
features: Breathable and sun-permeable mesh back panel allows tanning through the material to avoid tan lines
DoctorGel® padding on the palms provides comfort on long summer rides
For easy removal of the gloves at a cafe stop and the end of your ride
Easy to put the gloves on and nothing to get caught on the cuffs of jackets or jerseys
To help enhance your presence to other road users in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Solara Mesh Padded Short Finger Summer Gloves are the perfect all-day summer cycling gloves; providing comfort and grip, but without those annoying tan lines.

The hot weather cycling gloves feature a DoctorGel® pad to give comfort on long summer rides. The lightweight suede palms are breathable and soft, to help keep a firm grip on the handlebars.

Meanwhile the highly breathable and fast drying mesh backing, with no straps or hook-and-loop closure, allows your hands to breathe and even tan as you ride. The perfect gloves for hot summer adventures.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Icon Organic Cotton Hoodie
en-GB.description_html: Everybody needs a comfortable hoodie, and this GripGrab hoodie made from cotton is a real classic. With a slim fitting profile and a full length zip, it provides you with a flattering fit and the flexibility to wear it as you wish. The super soft brushed cotton blend and double thickness hood will keep you warm on those chilly mornings and evenings, while the zipped pockets are ideal for keeping your valuables safe. Subtly branded with the GripGrab logo.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Neoprene Wet Weather Gloves
features: Works like a wetsuit to trap a layer of insulating water between the glove and hand
Silicone gripper pattern on the palms enhances your hold on the handlebars and levers even in torrential rain
Neoprene has a rubber-like texture so it absorbs vibrations and shocks from the road or trail
Answer calls and take photos without removing the gloves thanks to the touchscreen compatible thumb tip
Help to enhance your presence to other road users
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Neoprene Wet Weather Gloves are designed to be worn in the wettest riding conditions.

Neoprene gloves give great warmth and insulation even when wet; like in a wetsuit, the material traps a thin layer of water between the neoprene and the skin – so your hands will be wet, but they stay warm as your body heat warms that layer of trapped water. So, even when the rain is at a monsoon level, you can still have warm and comfortable hands.

The robust neoprene material also has a natural rubber-like texture that helps to absorb shocks and vibrations; so you can get on and ride in comfort, even on rough roads and trails. A touchscreen compatible thumb tip has been added to the gloves to avoid the need to take them off to answer calls or use your touchscreen bicycle computer. Subtle reflective details will help to keep your hand signals visible, even as the weather deteriorates.

Keep riding, no matter how bad the rain gets.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
features: Three layer construction with fully waterproof membrane protects your feet from road spray and winter downpours
Premium soft knitted fabric offers supreme warmth retention and insulation from cool temperatures and wind chill
Elasticated soft knit material ensures a close comfortable fit around your road cycling shoes with minimal fabric bulk
The Zipperless Cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to standard zip designs
Wear reinforcements on high abrasion areas and stitching reinforcements help reduce wear
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers were inspired by the classic “Belgian Bootie” – used by Flandrien riders for decades. This modern take on the knitted cover sock keeps all the attributes of its historic predecessor: the soft fabric, stretch and close-fitting cut; but propels it into the modern age through water-resistant membrane technology.

These cycling shoe covers will shrug off showers, keep your feet dry and let you glide through puddles without concern. The three-layer construction with a fully waterproof membrane protects your feet from road spray and winter downpours. They are luxuriously soft and comfortable, but also feature reinforcement to the hems on the underside of each shoe cover to reduce wear.

The Flandrien Knitted Road Shoe Covers are minimalist in style and subtly branded, yet they deliver the height of modern technology. They will keep you comfortable in all weather, while preserving that true Classics style. The premium soft knitted fabric offers supreme warmth retention and protection from cool temperatures and wind chill, so these will keep you warm on winter rides as well as repelling road spray on wetter rides.

Thanks to the elasticated soft knit material, there is a close and comfortable fit around your cycling shoes with minimal fabric bulk. Comfort is furthered by the zipperless cuff design which reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to standard zip designs.

FAQ: Will the GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers keep my feet dry? The membrane in these cycling shoe covers is waterproof, so assuming you don’t drag them over cobbles and put holes in them, then they will keep your feet dry. There are limits however… hosepipes and knee-deep puddles, for example, will likely find a way inside.

GripGrab Pro Tip: To help reduce water seeping in through the top of these shoe covers we recommend you wear your water-resistant leg warmers or cycling bib tights over the top of the shoe cover cuff. We also recommend you seal vents and holes in the soles of your shoes to limit water ingress from below.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap
features: Warm and soft inner with a high warmth-to-weight ratio offers insulation in cool weather
Lightweight breathable fabric allows perspiration to escape from within
Material wicks moisture away from your skull for a comfortable feel
Stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching allows a comfortable close fit under a cycling helmet
en-GB.description_html:
It may be a myth that you lose heat more quickly from your head than from other body parts; but it is undoubtedly true that when cycling in cooler conditions any unprotected part of your body will quickly dissipate valuable body heat.

Your head has a large surface area, so the GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap is designed to offer under-helmet insulation and keep you warm and comfortable on cooler bike rides.

The GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap is the lightest weight winter cycling skull cap in the GripGrab accessories range. With an insulating and soft inner fabric, and a high warmth-to-weight ratio, it provides protection and comfort in cool weather conditions, without the bulk of a traditional woolly beanie. When the temperature rises or you work up a sweat, the under helmet cycling cap remains comfortable thanks to the lightweight breathable fabric.

For comfort and protection on cool winter days, this is the perfect piece of cycling headwear. Pro tip: Combine with a thermal neck warmer for full coverage of your ears and neck in colder conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Expert Seamless Short Sleeve Base Layer
features: High stretch soft fabrics allow for a comfortable second-skin feel
Fabric moves perspiration away from your skin for a dry and comfortable feeling
Allows for moisture build-up to escape from within when you work up a sweat
Under arm ventilation zones help dissipate heat and moisture
For all day comfort and maximum freedom of movement even underneath your cycling jersey
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Expert Seamless Short Sleeve Base Layer is a high performing base to any outfit; with a seamless construction that will provide you with all-day comfort and freedom of movement.

Made from breathable high-stretch fabric, this base layer fits like a soft second skin, but allows for great ventilation through the fabric and the strategically placed under-arm ventilation zones.

For optimal wicking performance, the Expert base layer is made from 100% polypropylene – known for its fast-drying and hydrophobic characteristics; so it will leave you feeling fresh and dry no matter how hard you work.

Soft against the skin and effective in a range of spring and summer temperatures, this will become the base of your riding kit on all your best rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Long Sleeve Jersey
features: Tailored to contour the body for optimal aerodynamics
Softly brushed interior delivers light insulation and a sleek, comfortable feel
Delivering effective water repellency in wet conditions
Ensuring a smooth, aerodynamic fit that lays flat against the wrist
Including reflective logos to aid visibility in low-light settings
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Long Sleeve Jersey embodies aerodynamic performance and refined comfort for cyclists seeking the perfect blend of style and function. Crafted with a precise race fit that contours the body, it optimizes aerodynamics while maintaining a sleek silhouette. The lightweight, brushed fabric offers gentle insulation and a luxuriously soft touch, ideal for transitional seasons. Treated with a DWR finish, it delivers dependable water resistance, keeping you prepared for damp conditions while preserving exceptional breathability.

Subtle laser-cut cuffs ensure a seamless, aerodynamic fit at the wrists, elevating both performance and aesthetics. Reflective details discreetly enhance low-light visibility without detracting from the jersey's clean lines. Designed for high-intensity efforts and transitional conditions, this jersey embodies performance-driven elegance and enduring comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceAero TT 2 Time Trial Road Shoe Covers
features: Engineered with an aerodynamic cut, our shoe covers are crafted to slice through the wind, delivering unmatched speed and efficiency
Designed in collaboration with leading aerodynamic experts, these shoe covers have undergone rigorous wind-tunnel testing.
Featuring a high elastic cuff, our shoe covers not only provide a secure fit but also optimize airflow by optimizing the passage of air over your legs and cycling shoes.
Crafted from a specialized lightweight and compressive material, these shoe covers maintain their aerodynamic shape while offering a barely-there feel over your summer road cycling shoes.
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RaceAero TT 2 Race Day Shoe Covers are what you need when every second counts.

Aerodynamic efficiency is paramount in time trials, and these aero shoe covers are designed to save you those vital seconds – smoothing turbulent air flow over the straps and buckles of your cycling shoes, and so reducing drag.

Use these aero shoe covers for those special occasions when saving seconds makes all the difference.

en-GB.name: GripGrab DryFoot 2 Waterproof Everyday Shoe Covers
features: Fully waterproof fabric with taped seams protects your everyday shoes and trousers from spray and road grime
Extended cuff provides coverage high up your leg to keep your trousers clean and dry on your cycle commute
Wear reinforcement patches on high-abrasion areas allow the shoe covers to deal with the rigours of everyday use
Reflective detailing on the rear of the shoe covers helps to enhance your visibility in low light conditions and on dark city commutes
Easy to put on thanks to the simple hook-and-loop closure tabs on the rear of each shoe cover
en-GB.description_html:
Such a good solution to an all-too-common and annoying problem, we are surprised we did not come up with this product sooner – but now we have, many more feet can be kept dry on commutes and errands.

Nobody wants to turn up to their board meeting or evening date with soggy feet and a tide mark on their trousers, and now you can avoid wet feet when cycling in your everyday clothes and everyday shoes.

The GripGrab Dryfoot 2 Waterproof Everyday Shoe Covers are designed to protect your casual everyday shoes and trouser cuffs against road spray and grime.

With wear reinforcements and a quick closure, they are perfect for using on your daily commute, bike-based errands and even cycle touring. No longer do you need to change to your cycling shoes for short journeys, nor end up with wet feet when travelling between meetings during changeable weather.

Easy on and easy off, the GripGrab DryFoot 2 Waterproof Everyday Shoe Covers are also light enough to be stowed in a bag when not needed, without adding much to its overall weight.

Available in both a discreet black colourway and high-visibility yellow; choose which best suits you depending on whether you want to blend into the city crowd or stand out in traffic.

These shoe covers are for everyday shoes from smart workwear to trainers, keeping your feet dry on commutes and errands rather than on long weekend road rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Light Spring-Autumn Arm Warmers
features: Lightweight fabric offers insulation to take the edge off those cooler spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from your skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural elbow bend which reduces material bunching
Strong silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevent slippage down your arms
Easily stored in a pocket or pannier making them ideal for changeable weather and bikepacking tours
en-GB.description_html:
These lightweight arm warmers are for riders who like early starts in the spring and autumn – they will keep the chill off your arms until the temperature rises; then you can stow them away in your jersey pocket for the rest of the ride.

When the temperature does rise, the lightweight fabric is highly breathable and moisture wicking so it will help to move perspiration away from your skin as you push on the pedals, this is also beneficial when you break a sweat putting in an effort on a climb.

The lightweight arm warmers are shaped to avoid bunching and have a strong silicone gripper at the top of each warmer to keep them in place during your ride.

Grab a pair of these lightweight arm warmers to keep the chill off your lower arms on early morning rides and carry them with you in a jersey pocket or pannier for when you might encounter windchill on long descents.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Vertical 2 InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: Enhancing grip and maximizing bike control
Offering superior durability and enhanced airflow
Designed for durability and rugged use
Enhancing lever control for precise braking and shifting
Allowing easy, on-the-move device control
Providing a snug, comfortable fit
Delivering effective sweat removal and gentle eyewear cleaning
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Vertical 2 InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves are engineered for gravity riders who like to push the limits. Designed to meet the demands of elite-level downhill, freeride, and enduro disciplines, these gloves provide the grip, control, and durability essential for dominating technical descents and high-consequence terrain. InsideGrip™ technology delivers a secure, locked-in grip for precise handling on rock gardens, berms, and rapid drops, while the premium perforated microsuede palm ensures resilience and breathability for all-day performance.

The gloves feature a rugged mesh back that stands up to heavy use without compromising flexibility. Silicone-enhanced fingertips offer precise braking and shifting control, keeping you ready for split-second maneuvers. The elasticated cuff guarantees a snug fit that stays put through every jump, drop, and hard landing. Built to withstand the intensity of gravity-fueled riding, these gloves are ready to elevate your performance.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Winter Jacket
features: Block cold wind while providing flexible weather protection for cold rides
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Add soft insulation and comfort with a warm inner surface
Helps release excess heat and moisture as effort levels change
Provides an athletic but comfortable cut shaped for cycling movement and easy layering
Allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding
Reflective elements help increase visibility in low-light riding conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The W’s RIDE Winter Jacket is built for women riding road and gravel who want dependable warmth and wind protection for cold-weather rides without making layering complicated. Windproof softshell 3-layer panels block cold wind, while a water-repellent outer finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric.

Brushed fleece inserts add soft insulation and comfort where extra warmth is needed, while the breathable construction helps release excess heat and moisture as effort levels change. The women-specific active fit provides an athletic but comfortable cut shaped for cycling movement, making the jacket easy to wear over thermal base layers.

A YKK 2-way zipper allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding. Reflective details help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Wear it over the W’s RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer in cool conditions or the W’s RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer when extra warmth is needed. Built as a straightforward winter riding jacket, it is suited to cold, windy, and changeable rides, but it is not designed as a fully waterproof rain jacket or a heavily insulated deep-winter jacket.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Road Toe Covers
features: Flexible, insulating construction protects against wind and cold
Smooth surface reduces drag over dials and laces
Coated exterior repels light rain and road spray
Makes it fast to pull on and off over road shoes
Enhances durability and walking grip
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for performance-oriented road riding in cool and cold conditions, the PACR Windproof Road Toe Covers deliver targeted protection where it matters most. By shielding the toe and forefoot from cold airflow, they help maintain warmth and comfort during high-intensity efforts when full shoe coverage is not required.

The PU-coated neoprene construction forms an effective insulating barrier against wind, while the splash-resistant surface repels rain and road spray on the covered areas without adding unnecessary bulk. This focused protection makes the toe covers a practical solution for variable conditions and transitional seasons.

A streamlined slip-on construction extends from the toe to the instep. The smooth exterior surface sits cleanly over laces and dials, minimising surface disruption and maintaining a clean profile.

An integrated under-toe tread pad reinforces high-wear contact areas and provides added grip when walking. The snug, low-profile fit is optimised for road cycling shoes and allows the toe covers to be worn on their own or layered under full PACR shoe covers for additional insulation in colder conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer

Premium moisture wicking material transports sweat away from your body to keep you dry and comfortable
Polygiene® fabric treatment keeps you and your clothing smelling fresh for longer by reducing bacteria build-up

The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer is your go-to base layer for summer cycling in sweltering heat. The featherweight open-weave mesh material allows your skin to breathe while quickly moving sweat away from your body to leave you dry and comfortable.

Reflective details help increase visibility in low-light winter conditions.

A PU-coated stretch fabric is used to focus coverage on the fastening dial area, creating a continuous surface where airflow disruption is typically highest. A close-fitting slip-on construction delivers a streamlined profile while allowing airflow to uncovered areas of the shoe.

With a weight of just 18 grams per pair, the FastStream Aero Dial Covers add negligible mass to the rider’s setup while delivering targeted aerodynamic benefit.

Developed and tested in collaboration with professional road cycling teams, the FastStream Aero Dial Covers are positioned as a focused aerodynamic alternative to full shoe covers. They are compatible with road and gravel cycling shoes but are not reinforced for off-road or heavy gravel use.

The dial covers are designed to pair with the GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling Socks to create a clean aerodynamic interface around the ankle and lower leg.

  To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment (biocide: silver chloride). Its 'Wear More. Wash Less®' technology uses silver ions to reduce the build-up of odour-inducing bacteria. The treatment is entirely safe to wear against the skin and doesn’t wash out. The zipperless cuff design and soft knit fabric ensures a close fit around your gravel cycling shoes, with minimal fabric bulk and maximum flexibility.

Ride further and enjoy the adventure. Be a GripGrab Explorer…

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Lightweight SL Summer Socks

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Lightweight SL Summer Socks are lightweight and stylish summer cycling socks with a 50% merino wool blend – for the best of natural and synthetic fibres.

Merino wool is a wonder material for thermal regulation: it will keep you cooler in hot summer conditions and insulate your feet in cooler conditions. Merino wool fibres are exceptionally fine – which means they create a beautifully soft, non-itchy fabric. 

In these socks, merino wool is interwoven with synthetic fibres to a create a blend fabric that is significantly stronger and more durable. The combination of fibres also assists moisture management; because while merino wool can absorb up to 35% of its own weight in water without feeling wet to the touch, the synthetic fibres help moisture to be wicked away and then to quickly evaporate.

Soft, lightweight, breathable and versatile – these are the perfect socks for all-day spring and summer adventures on your bike.

The GripGrab Grinta Bib Shorts represent the pinnacle of performance for discerning cyclists who demand unmatched durability, support, and comfort on every ride. Precision-engineered from advanced woven fabric, these bib shorts strike the perfect balance between lightweight feel and robust resilience, with exceptional stretch and abrasion resistance for long-lasting performance mile after mile. The carefully calibrated compressive weave supports muscles, boosting endurance and reducing fatigue during even the most intense efforts.

At the core, premium Elastic Interface EXPLORER HCS padding delivers a transformative ride experience, with high-density foam engineered for unparalleled comfort and support on extended journeys. Laser-cut leg openings ensure an impeccably sleek, aerodynamic profile, while an integrated, silicone-free gripper system provides a secure fit that maintains absolute comfort without sacrificing a clean, sophisticated finish. For those who demand the very best in cycling refinement and uncompromising functionality, the Grinta Bib Shorts redefine what is possible in every pedal stroke.

en-GB.name: GripGrab WindBreaking Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer

en-GB.description_html:
True to its name, a WindBreaking base layer keeps the chill off your chest on those long descents or blustery days, without the need for a gilet for extra protection.

The GripGrab WindBreaking Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer uses Arrowind™ fabric technology to protect you from windchill by creating a flexible protective barrier on the front torso and arms of the base layer. This unique warp knit construction blocks 80% of windchill-inducing air particles, while remaining as breathable as any other warp knitted base layer.

The WindBreaking fabric offers far better breathability and temperature regulation than two-layer windproof fabrics; while most air is stopped from reaching your skin, the little that is allowed through will carry away perspiration to keep you dry and comfortable.

A WindBreaking base layer is an excellent choice for anyone who often wears a gilet on their rides; to protect them from windchill on long descents or blustery exposed roads. The wind-resistant base layer allows you to leave your gilet at home, and adopt a sleeker and lighter weight clothing set-up.

This base layer utilises Polygiene® fabric treatment (biocide: silver chloride) to reduce the growth of odour-causing bacteria; this unique fabric treatment is completely safe for next-to-skin wear, but should mean your base layer needs less frequent washing, which is better for the product.

Leave your gilet at home, and adopt a sleeker and lighter weight clothing set-up with this WindBreaking shield.

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Insulated Mid-Layer Vest is designed to insulate your torso, ensuring your core is kept at the optimal temperature so you keep functioning at your best.

This unique Mid-Layer vest is designed to be worn underneath your cycling jacket or jersey, adding an additional layer of insulation where you need it most. If the need arises, it can also be worn over the top of a jersey for added insulation and windchill protection.

The Teijin Octa Airmesh fabric on the front and back panels has an exceptional warmth-to-weight ratio – to offer maximum insulation with minimal bulk. For added protection from windchill and light spray, a Windproof Lightweight fabric with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment is used on the front facing panels of the vest.

To ensure a close-fitting cut that offers the best insulation, the PACR bodywarmer uses fleece stretch panels on the sides of the vest to pull in the fabric and provide a form-fitting profile. These lightweight waterproof off-road cycling shoe covers are made from a fully waterproof fabric with taped seams – to offer a waterproof and windproof shield against wet weather and trail conditions.

Designed for damp and drizzly rides in spring and autumn, the waterproof non-insulated stretch fabric creates a close-fitting profile around off-road cycling shoes. Meanwhile, the open sole design has also been optimised to fit around the treads and lugs of MTB SPD shoes. The off-road specific design, coupled with durable wear resistant fabric reinforcements, makes it possible to walk short distances in these shoe covers without causing excessive wear. The rear zip allows for easy fitting and removal – time and time again.

The GripGrab RaceAqua X Waterproof MTB/CX Shoe Covers provide lightweight wet weather protection for off-road cycling shoes – allowing you to keep riding in comfort, even when the trails and tracks become wet and muddy.

Pro tip: Pull your water-resistant leg warmers over the top of the shoe covers to keep the rain out of the top cuff

The zipperless design and anatomic cut offer a high level of comfort and waterproofing. The fabric's stretch allows you to adjust the shoe cover on your leg before putting on your shoes. The cuff should sit just underneath the calf muscle for optimal leg and sock protection. You can then put your shoes on and stretch the cover over them, securing them with the hook and loop closure under the sole.

This Gravel version of the AquaShield 2 combines PU-coated polyester with neoprene and Kevlar. The toe area is protected with a rubber insert to prevent damage when stopping and walking, while Kevlar is used underneath the forefoot for extra durability. These two elements help protect the PU body of the shoe cover from damage caused by tires, pedals, and vegetation. The opening in the base is specifically designed for gravel shoes with small cleats such as SPD and rubber sole lugs.

The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Gravel Shoe Covers are high-performance, close-fitting cycling shoe covers optimised for waterproofness and durability while remaining easy to use and comfortable. Don't let the weather stop you from cycling!

Fully bonded seams and a YKK 2-way Vislon AquaGuard zipper provide complete protection against downpours and windchill. The active fit delivers a comfortable, athletic cut, while reflective details improve visibility in low-light conditions, making this jacket ideal for riders needing dependable, lightweight weather protection.

feature_titles: Warm for the whole ride, not just the first hour
PrimaLoft® Evolve under a windproof face
features: Long winter rides start cold, warm up on the climbs and cool down again as the day fades. This EXPLR jacket puts a windproof face over PrimaLoft® insulation and lets heat out through fleece where it builds, so you stay warm from start to finish
Breathable insulation holds your warmth, while the windproof ripstop keeps the wind off

en-GB.name: GripGrab Classic Cotton Summer Cycling Cap
features: UPF50+ UV protection and the stiff brim help to shade you from the sun in hot summer conditions

en-GB.description_html:
The cycling cap – casquette – is a timeless piece of cycling kit. As jersey and shorts have changed in design and material over the decades, the cycling cap has stayed consistent in style and functionality, as well as in their appeal to the fashion-conscious rider.

When worn nowadays, cycling caps are often covered by a helmet; but their style and practicality has not been diminished as a result.

The GripGrab Classic Cotton Summer Cycling Cap offers UPF50+ UV protection to keep the sun off your head on those high summer days. The stiff brim helps to shade you from the sun in hot summer conditions and then acts to protect you from the rain should the weather become unsettled.

Cycling caps are also a good addition under your helmet in the spring and autumn, as they keep the early morning chill from your head before keeping the sun off your head later in the day. The cap also provides effective protection from insects, and the absorbent cotton fabric stops sweat from running down into your eyes.

Available in a selection of classic colours, find a GripGrab Classic Cotton Cycling Cap to suit all your favourite outfits.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Regular Cut Socks 3-Pack

The GripGrab RIDE Regular Cut Socks are lightweight cycling socks for warm-weather riding, designed to deliver breathability, moisture control, and reliable comfort for everyday use.

Open mesh zones promote airflow to help manage temperature during rides, while COOLMAX® yarns efficiently wick moisture away from the skin to support a dry, comfortable feel in warm conditions.

A stretch arch support across the midfoot helps stabilise the sock on the foot and maintain a consistent fit while pedalling. Seamless toe construction reduces the risk of irritation, supporting comfort on longer rides.

The socks feature a standard close fit with a supportive, non-compressive cuff and a regular-cut shaft (15 cm, size M), keeping them securely and comfortably in place.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Arctic X Waterproof Deep Winter MTB/CX Shoe Covers

Reflective details and integrated safety light loop improve visibility. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost product life
en-GB.description_html:
For off-road deep winter rides on wet trails and tracks – these are the shoe covers that will keep your feet warm and dry. The durable 4mm thermal neoprene protects your feet from snow, mud and spray in sub-zero winter conditions – as you hit the trails regardless of the conditions.

The premium fleece-lined neoprene used in the Arctic X Shoe Covers offers supreme warmth retention and comfort in sub-zero temperatures. The deep winter performance is boosted by the unique IntelliSeal™ hem, which eliminates stitching fray, reduces fabric water uptake and enhances the seal against your cycling shoes.

A zipperless cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to overshoes with traditional zip designs. While aramid fibre wear reinforcements on the toe cap boost product life by reducing wear of the neoprene material. Finally, reflective detailing and an integrated safety light loop (light not included) can help to improve visibility in low light conditions.

The Arctic X Deep Winter Shoe Covers are your solution for comfort and warmth on the coldest off-road rides of winter.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Freedom Warp Knitted Seamless Headband

Cycling headbands have come a long way over the decades: this innovative warp knitted headband is lightweight, super-stretchy and highly breathable. It creates an insulating and sweat wicking layer for your forehead and ears, keeping them warm and comfortable when cycling or running in cold weather conditions.

Warp knitted fabrics use a state-of-the-art production process that creates a wonderfully soft and elastic fabric that is also impressively durable and breathable. The material will stretch perfectly to suit a wide range of head sizes and shapes.

Team this headband up with GripGrab's other warp knitted accessories and base layers for the ultimate multisport and multifunctional kit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Thermal Bib Tights

en-GB.description_html:
Gear up for serious winter riding with the W's PACR Thermal Bib Tights, meticulously crafted for passionate female cyclists who demand peak performance.

The W's PACR Thermal Bib Tights offer exceptional warmth and comfort thanks to the Miti Superroubaix high-performance thermal fabric. This brushed nylon fleece fabric enhances warmth by trapping air, creating an insulating layer to keep you warm during cold weather rides. The high stretch and anatomically optimized fit provide a snug and tailored feel, promoting efficient movement.

Focused on the details, the W's PACR Thermal Bib Tights feature a practical leg pocket made from durable woven fabric, offering secure storage for your essentials. Strategically placed reflective details help you stand out in low-light conditions.

Elevate your winter cycling experience with the W's PACR Thermal Bib Tights, where premium materials, comfort, and performance come together to deliver the ultimate riding gear.

en-GB.name: GripGrab FastStream Aero Short Finger Gloves

The GripGrab FastStream Aero Short Finger Gloves are designed for riders who prioritise direct bar feel combined with a clean, low-drag glove surface. Every detail is intentionally simplified to support efficiency and an uncompromising connection to the bike.

A close-fitting profile and long slip-in cuff sit cleanly against the wrist, supporting a smooth, uninterrupted interface. Minimal seam placement helps reduce pressure points, keeping the gloves light and barely noticeable during hard efforts.

The unpadded palm construction preserves direct contact with the handlebars. InsideGrip™ technology positions silicone elements on the inside of the glove to deliver a secure, tactile grip, while the perforated microsuede material promotes airflow to help manage heat and keep the palm dry.

Designed to work alongside other FastStream products, including the FastStream Aero Shoe Covers and FastStream Aero Cycling Socks, the gloves form part of an integrated setup focused on clean surfaces and minimal construction.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves

Delivering a minimalistic fit and a clean, streamlined design
Allowing easy, on-the-move device control
Adding a minimalistic touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves are built for XC and gravel racers who demand unmatched grip and precise control in a minimalist package. Designed to perform at World Cup intensity, these gloves feature InsideGrip™ technology, offering a direct, locked-in feel for maximum bar control during high-speed sprints, technical climbs, and relentless descents. The perforated microsuede palm delivers exceptional dexterity and breathability, ensuring seamless handling and responsive feedback mile after mile.

Ultra-lightweight and streamlined, the gloves' breathable mesh construction optimizes airflow, keeping hands cool under the pressure of race conditions. Silicone-detailed fingertips enhance braking and shifting precision when every second counts. The low-profile, slip-in cuff ensures a secure, distraction-free fit, letting you focus solely on the race. Whether it’s tackling a punchy climb, navigating tight gravel turns, or chasing podiums, these gloves deliver uncompromising grip and performance for racers who leave nothing to chance.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Hurricane 2 Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves

en-GB.description_html:
The new Hurricane 2 Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves are an evolution on their predecessors, which were GripGrab classics. The new gloves improve on high quality, longstanding products from the GripGrab range. These windproof gloves are best suited to spring and autumn conditions, but are also suitable for milder winter days.

The premium windproof stretch fabric on the back of the gloves is highly breathable, with a 15K (15,000 g/m²/24h) rating; this windproof material will shield your hands from wind chill on cool days. The fabric is also treated with a DWR (durable water repellent) treatment to shrug off light showers and road spray.

The gloves have padded palms for comfort and silicone gripper prints for control. Flexible, breathable and lightly insulating, the Hurricane 2 gloves will keep your hands comfortable and functioning at their best on those cool transition season bike rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Hi-Vis Running Essentials Gift Box

Insulating inner fabric on the gloves and skull cap offers winter running comfort and allows perspiration to escape from within
The thumb tips of the running gloves are touchscreen friendly, while the forefinger and thumb tips can be flipped down to allow use of your phone
Reflective logo and accents on the gloves and skull cap help to increase your visibility when running in low light conditions
Save money and create a great gift pack for any runner with this 3-in-1 multipack of essential running accessories
en-GB.description_html:
Three products in one package, this is the ideal gift for the runner in your life – or a treat for yourself. With the GripGrab Hi-Vis Running Essentials Gift Box you get touchscreen compatible running gloves, a hi-vis running skull cap and a hi-vis neck warmer – setting you up for a successful off-season of run training, especially in dark and cold conditions.

The trio includes the GripGrab Running Expert Hi-Vis Winter Touchscreen Gloves, a GripGrab Lightweight Thermal Hi-Vis Skull Cap and a GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer.

The insulating soft-brushed inner on the gloves and skull cap offers winter running comfort but will also allow perspiration to escape from within as you put in the effort on winter intervals and sprint finishes. In addition to the breathable fabric, another key strength of the winter running gloves is their touchscreen compatibility: the thumb tips are touchscreen friendly, while the forefinger and thumb tips can be flipped down to allow you to type on a phone without taking them off.

Reflective logo and accents on the running gloves and skull cap, as well as the high-visibility colours, help to increase your visibility when running in low light conditions.

This running gift pack is a value for money way of getting kitted out for winter running. Save money compared to buying the individual component parts, and you'll also benefit from the great gift pack presentation box – the multipack of essential running accessories is perfect for any dedicated runner.

The glove size determines the size of the bundle. Please consult the size guide for additional information. The Multifunctional Neck Warmer comes in one size, while the Lightweight Thermal Hi-Vis Skull Cap comes in the standard size of 57-60cm head circumference.

The GripGrab Hi-Vis Running Essentials is the bundle of kit you – or a friend – need for running all winter. Beautifully presented in a smart gift box, this is a great gift idea for runners.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket
features: A three-layer waterproof and windproof softshell fabric on the front, lower back and sleeves protects against rain and windchill

en-GB.description_html:
When the temperature drops, reach for the GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket. This softshell winter jacket will keep you comfortable during your cold bike rides.

The front facing torso, lower back and sleeves of the jacket use a three-layer softshell fabric with an integrated 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane. This is your shield against cold weather and spray. The protective three-layer fabric has a high-stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, while the raglan sleeves of the jacket allow freedom of movement and the raw cut sleeve cuffs give an effective seal around your wrists.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the sleeves and upper back, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to provide added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the softshell fabric, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

A YKK® Vislon two-way zip, with extra-long zip pulls, is used on the jacket to allow you to regulate airflow through your layers with ease and avoid over-heating when you are working hard. Or, when conditions deteriorate, you can zip the jacket right up to the high cut collar and seal out the elements. A silicone gripper on the rear hem ensures the jacket stays firmly in place, no matter how hard you are working.

On the rear of the jacket there are three large open top pockets for all those long ride essentials, plus a single zipped pocket for small valuables. Reflective detailing on the rear helps to enhance your road presence in low light conditions.

The PACR Windproof Winter Jacket will keep you warm and comfortable no matter how tough the riding gets.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PrimaLoft® Windproof Winter Gloves

The GripGrab Thermo SL Winter Socks are high cuff insulating cycling socks, designed to keep you comfortable in cold conditions.

Featuring Thermolite® fabric, a padded sole and stretch arch support – these are the ideal cycling socks for long rides in chilly conditions.

No matter what kind of bicycle you ride – road, mountain, CX or gravel – these highly functional socks ensure you're comfortable.

The insulating fabric, with its hollow fibres, makes these socks super cosy to wear. Their high cut provides additional insulation against the cold and wind – keeping warm blood flowing down into your feet. In the depths of winter, pair these socks with warm overshoes and you can keep riding through the coldest months.

With a simple design, they provide a great combination of insulation and breathability to keep the hands comfortable in cold temperatures. The Running Basic can also be used as an everyday glove for other outside activities. Reflective details help to increase your visibility in traffic for those night-time runs, while high breathability materials will allow perspiration to escape when you are working hard training for your next marathon. An essential running accessory for the winter months.

en-GB.name: GripGrab UPF 50+ Lightweight Summer Skull Cap

en-GB.description_html:
For many cyclists, the thought of adding another layer under their helmet during a hot ride is unthinkable; but the right headwear can boost comfort on warm rides and protect your skin from the sun. The GripGrab UPF50+ Lightweight Summer Skull Cap protects your head from harmful UV rays thanks its high level of UV protection – blocking much of the sun from reaching your head and reducing the chance of sunburn.

The sun isn’t the only thing that can get in through the vents in your helmet, and this summer cycling skullcap also keeps any adventurous insects off your head. The moisture wicking highly breathable material will help move perspiration away from your brow to keep you cool and reduce the chance of sweat hindering your vision. The super lightweight fabric weighs just 25 grams, and the low-profile design and low bulk seams allow you to wear it comfortably underneath a cycling helmet.

Machine washable and fast drying, it is a lot easier to wash this summer skullcap than it is to wash your helmet pads after a sweaty ride; so it will help keep the inside of your helmet cleaner for longer.

Go against what you think you know, and add an extra layer for those warm summer rides – the GripGrab UPF50+ Lightweight Summer Skull Cap will make those sweltering hot days far more comfortable.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Running Thermo Windproof Winter Gloves

A lightweight windproof cover can quickly be pulled out from the pocket on the back of each glove, and pulled over your fingers to give extra protection in windy cold weather.

The Running Thermo Gloves also feature a sweat wiper, silicone grip palms and touchscreen compatible thumbs – to allow you to answer a call on your smartphone or take a quick picture without taking the gloves off. These insulating yet breathable sports gloves will be a reliable companion as you put in the winter miles training for the next marathon.

The Women's Rouleur Gloves are made with a high-density padding to absorb the shocks of the road and trail – protecting your hands against vibrations to enhance your comfort.

As the Rouleur name suggests, these gloves are much like the cyclists described: they are consistent all-rounders – providing a degree of padding and comfort for your hands, while excelling at allowing control of the handlebars.

The lightweight breathable fabric on the stretch back panel on these cycling gloves lets your hands breathe as you perspire in hot conditions; this helps with temperature regulation and reduces sweat build-up inside the gloves. When you do break a sweat, use the sweat wiper on the gloves to wipe away perspiration and keep your vision clear for the road ahead.

A supple and durable palm provides maximum control on the handlebars, brake levers and gear shifters. The low-profile adjustable cuffs allows you to adjust the fit as you go; while in-between finger pull-off tabs make for easy removal at the end of your ride. These short finger cycling gloves also feature reflective detailing to help increase your visibility and enhance your hand signals in low light conditions.

Optimised with a female specific fit, these gloves are your solution to summer ride comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Aviator Windproof Deep Winter Skull Cap

When the coldest conditions of deep winter arrive, the Aviator Windproof Deep Winter Skull Cap is the essential cycling accessory you need to prevent the loss of valuable heat through your head. It is made from highly insulating fleece with a windproof front.

It may be a myth that you lose more heat from your head than anywhere else, but the proportionate heat loss and discomfort of an exposed head and ears on a winter bike ride could see you heading home much earlier than planned. The Aviator will keep your head and ears warm. Thanks to its lightweight construction and low-profile seams, it sits comfortably underneath your cycling helmet.

The exceptional warmth-to-weight ratio makes it the best possible insulation for your head in cold winter conditions — it is lightweight and low bulk, but exceptionally good at insulating you against the cold. Then, when you do put in an effort and break a sweat, the highly breathable moisture wicking fabric will ensure there isn’t a build-up of moisture within.

With a contoured low cut back and ears for added coverage and insulation against the cold, this winter cycling skull cap is the ultimate deep winter companion.

Elevate your winter cycling experience and embrace cutting-edge technology and uncompromising performance with the Arctic 2 Waterproof Deep Winter Road Shoe Covers.

Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips then enable a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control when you need to change gear and brake.

Windproof and insulating, the RIDE Hi-Vis Windproof Winter Gloves will keep your hands warm and comfortable on chilly winter days.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Descent InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: Providing light impact protection
Enhancing confidence and maximizing bike control
Offering superior durability and enhanced airflow
Designed for durability and rugged use
Enhancing lever control for precise braking and shifting

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Descent InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves are engineered for blistering descents and technical terrain, delivering exceptional durability and precise control. Reinforced knuckle guards offer lightweight impact protection, while the InsideGrip™ tech ensures unwavering grip for navigating rocky trails and tight switchbacks. A perforated microsuede palm adds durability, dexterity, and breathability for all-day comfort.

Crafted with a hard-wearing mesh back that withstands rugged conditions, these gloves maintain flexibility without sacrificing protection. Silicone-detailed fingertips offer precise braking and shifting control, keeping you in command even in high-stakes moments. With touchscreen compatibility, you can stay connected mid-ride, while a sweat wipe on the thumb handles quick eyewear or face swipes. The hook-and-loop closure provides a customizable, secure fit, making these gloves your go-to for aggressive, demanding rides.

Celebrating 'Ride All Year' with a distinctive accent

The GripGrab EXPLR Merinotech T-shirt is designed for cyclists who seek uncompromising comfort and performance on multi-day rides and bikepacking adventures. Crafted from a premium blend of merino wool and moisture-wicking synthetic fibers, it offers exceptional softness, insulation, and breathability.

Highly breathable fabric efficiently wicks away moisture, keeping your body dry and comfortable during changing conditions. Whether tackling rugged trails, exploring new routes, or stopping for a break in town, this T-shirt combines versatility, durability, and the ‘Ride All Year’ ethos, complete with distinctive R.A.Y. branding. Built for cyclists who demand reliable performance on and off the bike.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Padded Liner Shorts
features: Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP pad offers superior comfort during long distance rides
The high-stretch material, stitched with flatlock seams, allows for a close and comfortable fit with maximum freedom of movement
Mesh inserts ensure maximum breathability and minimal added insulation from the liner shorts
A wide elastic waistband and silicone gripper hems keep the shorts firmly in place even when worn beneath bib tights or baggy shorts
Ideal for wearing underneath the GripGrab ThermaShell unpadded bib tights, but also under baggy MTB shorts or on the indoor trainer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for versatility the GripGrab PACR Padded Liner Shorts are made to be worn underneath unpadded bib tights, such as the GripGrab ThermaShell Bib Tights; these liner shorts feature an Elastic Interface seatpad for pressure relief, and highly breathable fabrics for the best temperature regulation. The padded waist shorts are also perfect for your indoor training sessions or even underneath baggy shorts.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The fabric of these liner shorts is a mix of high-stretch material and an open mesh material that provides maximum breathability. This combination means the shorts fit like a second skin and allow heat and perspiration to easily escape from within.

A wide elastic waistband and silicone leg grippers keep the liner shorts firmly in place, even when they are worn underneath close-fitting bib tights or baggy shorts.

The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the liner shorts without needing to wash your bib tights after each ride: this is better for the bib tights. These liner shorts are also perfect for use with baggy shorts or for indoor trainer use – they offer the same functionality as a normal pair of cycling shorts, but with enhanced breathability.

Versatile padded liner shorts that will offer you the comfort you need for long distance rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Leg Warmers

en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers feature windproof front panels to reduce windchill in cold conditions, and they have a durable water-repellent coating to shrug off light rain and front wheel spray.

The inner fabric of the leg warmers is a soft brushed material, which is soft against the skin and also provides valuable insulation on cool winter days. Anatomically contoured seams and secure silicone grippers on the upper hem mean that these warmers stay in place, however hard you are working on your winter ride.

Combine these weatherproof leg warmers with winter bib shorts for a versatile all-season wear package – you will be kept warm and comfortable as you ride through inclement weather.

en-GB.name: GripGrab CyclinGaiter Hi-Vis Shoe Cover Cuffs
features: The CyclinGaiter ankle cuff uses waterproof coated neoprene to create a more watertight seal between the shoe cover cuff and your leg
The addition of the CyclinGaiter extends the height of each shoe cover up your leg to offer greater coverage against front wheel spray
The 2.5mm neoprene is windproof, waterproof and insulating helping to keep your ankles and lower legs dry and warm
For optimum performance wear the CyclinGaiters next to your skin with your leg warmers or tights over the top. Invisible protection!
Use with MTB waterproof winter boots to enhance the seal around your lower leg and improve their wet weather performance
en-GB.description_html:
The CyclinGaiter Hi-Vis Shoe Cover Cuffs are ingenious products from GripGrab – waterproof coated neoprene cuffs to create a more watertight seal between the top cuff of your cycling shoes covers and your legs.

The addition of the CyclinGaiter extends the height of your shoe covers or winter MTB boots up your legs to offer greater coverage against front wheel spray.

The 2.5mm neoprene is windproof, waterproof and insulating. This helps to keep your ankles and lower legs drier and warmer on damp rides on wet roads and trails.

For optimum performance we suggest that you wear the CyclinGaiters next to your skin with your leg warmers or tights over the top. This provides a hidden barrier against spray and puddles, and improves the ‘seal’.

Use the CyclinGaiter with shoe covers or MTB waterproof winter boots to enhance the seal around your lower leg and improve their wet weather performance. Keep riding in comfort, in all weather conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Multifunctional Fleece Thermal Neck Warmer
features: Premium polar fleece fabric protects your neck from wind chill in the coldest winter conditions
Neck warmer is made of super breathable and moisture wicking material to reduce condensation build-up
Highly elastic fabric allows for a close and comfortable fit in a multitude of wear configurations
Versatile neck warmer can be worn as a bandana, scarf, snood, headband, wristband or face mask
Perfect for all winter sports including snow cycling, skiing, hiking, trekking, mountaineering and much more
en-GB.description_html:
If you are serious about cycling all year round – whether that’s winter training on the road, hitting the winter trails or cycle commuting in all conditions – you need a Multifunctional Fleece Thermal Neck Warmer. This will keep the wind off your throat as you push on through the cold air to hit your training goals or reach your destination.

This neck warmer has a two-part fabric design, with an extra insulating fleece lower and a lighter weight and highly breathable upper. This design makes it particularly effective at sealing in the warmth around the collar of your winter jacket, while being flexible to pull up and cover your upper neck or mouth.

However, and the clue is in the name, this is a multifunctional and highly versatile bit of cycling kit and it can be worn in a number of ways: such as a bandana, scarf, snood, headband, wristband or face mask.

What’s more, it is perfect for all winter sports: cycling, skiing, hiking, trekking, mountaineering and much more.

A fantastic multi-sport and multifunctional accessory to provided added warmth during cold weather activities.

en-GB.description_html:
The W's PACR Water-Resistant Bib Tights No Pad are your ultimate companion for battling wet and cold conditions.

Engineered for serious cyclists who brave the elements, these bib tights provide exceptional protection and comfort. Crafted with a 8K waterproof triple-layer fabric on the front, they offer comprehensive coverage that shields your legs from rain and road spray while maintaining excellent breathability (15K) to prevent overheating.

Designed for custom comfort, these bib tights are unpadded, allowing you to pair them with your preferred padded shorts. The anatomically optimized fit, tailored specifically for women, ensures that every pedal stroke is efficient and powerful.

The rear of the legs features stretchable fleece inserts that adapt to your movements, providing increased flexibility and a snug fit. Strategically placed reflective details enhance your visibility in low-light conditions.

Embrace the elements with the W's PACR Water-Resistant Bib Tights No Pad, and experience the perfect blend of style, functionality, and performance. Whether you're training for your next race or embarking on a long-distance ride, these bib tights will keep you comfortable and protected in foul weather conditions.
