en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Classic No Show Summer Socks are where it all started... simple, comfortable and long lasting summer cycling socks.

Made from breathable Coolmax® they are ideal for hot summer rides, runs and gym workouts. This 'No Show' version is cut as a trainer liner, so that you can avoid those sock tan lines and let your lower legs breathe.

With a three-pack, you'll always have a clean pair ready for your next bike ride.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Winter Jacket
feature_titles: Bonded cuffs, hems, and high collar
Three rear pockets plus zipped pocket
features: Blocks cold wind while supporting breathability and comfort during fast winter rides
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Helps trap warm air close to the body and supports moisture management during changing intensity
Improves comfort, breathability, and freedom of movement on the bike
Creates a close, performance-focused fit for fast road and gravel riding in cold conditions
Support natural movement and comfort in a forward-leaning cycling position
Improves coverage in a forward-leaning cycling position
Help create a close, protective fit with reduced bulk
Allows ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding
Provide practical storage for ride essentials
Reflective elements on the cuffs and back help increase visibility in low-light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Winter Jacket is built for performance road and gravel riders who need windproof protection, breathable warmth, and a close fit for fast riding in cold conditions. The Windtex Softshell 3-layer fabric blocks cold wind, while a water-repellent outer finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric. This makes the jacket well suited to cold, dry, and changeable winter rides where wind protection, temperature regulation, and fit precision matter.

The waffled inner surface supports insulation and moisture management as effort levels change, while thermal stretch fabric improves comfort and freedom of movement on the bike. The race fit is shaped for a forward-leaning cycling position, with raglan sleeves and articulated arms supporting natural movement during fast winter riding.

Bonded hems, bonded cuffs, a high collar, and extended back length help create a close, protective fit with minimal excess material. A 2-way YKK front zipper allows ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding. Three rear pockets and a smaller zipped rear pocket provide space for ride essentials, while reflective details on the cuffs and back help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built as part of the PACR winter riding system, this jacket is designed to be worn over the PACR Winter Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer. In very cold conditions, it can be combined with the PACR Insulated Mid-Layer Vest for additional warmth. It is not intended as a fully waterproof rain jacket or as a heavily insulated deep-winter jacket.

en-GB.description_html:
When budget, storage space or luggage capacity are considerations, you need kit that can justify its place in your kit drawer and on your bikepacking kit list.

The Merino Blend Lightweight Beanie justifies its presence due to its versatility: it will fit comfortably under your helmet as you ride along, will keep your head warm off the bike once you reach your destination and it folds down small when stored in a pannier or jersey pocket.

With a subtle design and a blend of soft natural merino and high wicking synthetic fibres, the Merino Blend Lightweight Beanie is super breathable, comfortable and versatile.

The inner fabric of the arm warmers is a soft brushed material, which is soft against the skin and also provides valuable insulation on cool winter days. Anatomically contoured seams and secure silicone grippers on the upper hem mean that these warmers stay in place, however hard you are working on your winter ride.

Combine these weatherproof arm warmers with a windproof jersey or gilet for a versatile all-season wear package – you will be kept warm and comfortable as you ride through inclement weather.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Bib Shorts
features: Crafted from high-quality fabrics, the shorts offer a comfortable balance of stretch and compression for enhanced comfort
Includes lightweight mesh in the upper body for improved airflow and sweat management
Integrates a high-quality cycling pad from Elastic Interface (LIEGE HP) to deliver outstanding comfort during long rides
Features a convenient stretchy pocket, lying flat against the leg for easy access to your phone or snacks throughout your ride
Ensure a secure fit on the legs with wide elastic hems and silicone grippers
en-GB.description_html:
Crafted from high-quality stretch polyamide fabric boasting UPF50+ sun protection, the GripGrab RIDE Bib Shorts stand as an essential piece for riders, providing an accommodating fit for optimal comfort.

The upper body incorporates wicking mesh, assuring excellent breathability and moisture management. Equipped with an Elastic Interface seatpad (LIEGE HP), it delivers remarkable cushioning for long rides. For easy access to your essentials, a convenient top-entry leg pocket is included. The wide elastic bottom leg, coupled with an inner silicone gripper, ensures a secure fit throughout your rides. Reflective details enhance visibility and safety in low-light conditions.

We recommend pairing these bibs with a GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey for a fully cohesive style and enhanced riding comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab EXPLR Cargo Bib Shorts
features: Crafted from high-end fabrics selected for their robustness
Built with two stretch leg cargo pockets and one back pocket made of strong woven fabric
Equipped with a gravel specific pad by Elastic Interface that is denser, smaller and quick drying (GRAVEL PERFORMANCE HCS)
Ensure a secure fit on the legs with wide elastic hems and silicone grippers
en-GB.description_html:
Crafted from high-end durable stretch polyamide fabric, the GripGrab EXPLR Cargo Bib Shorts offer long-lasting performance and a comfortable fit. With two top-entry cargo pockets laying flat against the legs and one back pocket, they provide ample storage space for snacks, tools and other essentials.

The long-distance gravel-specific pad from Elastic Interface is designed to be denser and smaller, ensuring quick drying and providing specific support for extended gravel rides (GRAVEL PERFORMANCE HCS). Additionally, this pad with antistatic and bacteriostatic properties features perforated inserts to enhance breathability and moisture management.

The elastic straps and breathable mesh on the upper body optimise air flow and sweat management.

These cargo bibs are designed for long-haul adventures, and you shouldn't hesitate to bring them off-road and on multi-day adventures.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
features: Designed for road cycling shoes, compatible with all road cleat models
Built without zip for better comfort, durability and weather resistance
Crafted from a PU-coated polyester offering stretch and full waterproofness
Silicone edges under the sole seal the shoe cover tightly and minimise water penetration from road spray
Integrated reinforcement under the toe box specifically designed for the use of road cycling shoes
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are an evolution of the renowned GripGrab AquaShield, with a stronger construction and increased ease of use.

The zipperless design and anatomic cut offer a high level of comfort and waterproofing. The fabric's stretch allows you to adjust the shoe cover on your leg before putting on your shoes. The cuff should sit just underneath the calf muscle for optimal leg and sock protection. You can then put your shoes on and stretch the cover over them, securing them with the hook and loop closure under the sole.

The design of these road shoe covers combines PU-coated polyester and waterproof neoprene. The opening in the base is specifically developed for large road cleats. The edge of the neoprene has a new IntelliSeal silicone edge to create a seal around the base to stop water ingress. The toe area has a new rubber insert to protect from damage when stopping and walking.

The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are high-performance, close-fitting cycling shoe covers optimised for waterproofness and durability while remaining easy to use and comfortable. Pro tip: Remember to seal the ventilation holes included in the soles of many road cycling shoes to avoid getting wet feet from water penetrating from under the soles. You can do so by removing the inner sole of your shoes, tape the holes inside, and put the sole in place again. Don't let the weather stop you from cycling!

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Lite Padded Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: Offering light cushioning for added comfort and versatility
Offering high dexterity and a comfortable fit
Enhancing grip and control
Providing a secure, adjustable fit
Allowing easy, on-the-move device control
Adding extra durability and wear resistance
Ensuring a soft touch for wiping away moisture
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RIDE Lite Padded Full Finger Summer Gloves are crafted for cyclists who demand lightweight comfort and control on every ride. Designed with just the right amount of padding, they offer cushioning without bulk, ensuring a natural bar feel and enhanced responsiveness. The microsuede palm delivers high dexterity and a secure, comfortable grip, perfect for tackling trails or gravel rides.

Silicone-enhanced palm sections provide confident grip and precise control, while a hook-and-loop closure ensures a tailored, secure fit. Reinforced fingertips enhance durability for long-lasting use across varied terrain. Touchscreen compatibility allows for easy device access mid-ride, and a soft sweat wiper adds extra convenience. For mountain bikers, gravel riders, or any cyclist looking for a lightly padded glove at an affordable price, the RIDE Lite gloves strike the perfect balance between performance and value.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's Flow 2in1 Technical Cycling Shorts
features: Includes separate padded underwear shorts to wear for cycling
The outer shorts are crafted from reinforced 4-way stretch woven fabric and reinforced stitching
Define your most comfortable fit with the adjustment clips placed on the hips
Repels light rain and road spray with durable DWR treatment
Stores small items or phone securely and comfortably in a zipped leg pocket while cycling
en-GB.description_html:
The versatile GripGrab Flow 2in1 Technical Cycling Shorts come with separate padded underwear shorts, allowing you to use them for cycling but also off the bike. The outer shorts are constructed with reinforced 4-way stretch woven fabric and stitching, ensuring comfort, durability and resilience on rugged terrains.

Featuring waist adjustments, these shorts can easily be customised to find a secure and comfortable fit. The DWR treatment adds water repellency if meeting unstable weather conditions.

The padded underwear shorts are lightweight and stretch. Equipped with a quality cycling pad, they ensure a smooth and comfortable experience in the saddle.

While these 2in1 shorts offer a stylish and casual look, their high-quality fabric and stretch make them extremely versatile: hiking, urban exploring, off-road riding, these shorts perform impressively well in a multitude of terrains and situations.

en-GB.name: GripGrab FastStream Aero Shoe Covers
features: Reduces drag around road cycling shoes
Save up to 10 watts at high speeds
Designed to integrate smoothly with aero socks
Low-friction exterior promotes clean airflow over the shoe
Lightweight reinforcement offers essential durability
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab FastStream Aero Shoe Covers are engineered for high-speed road cycling, where marginal aerodynamic gains matter. By smoothing airflow around the cycling shoes in a highly turbulent area, they deliver measurable aerodynamic savings of up to 10 watts at 45 km/h in controlled testing.

The shoe covers are constructed from a stretch fabric with a smooth, PU-coated exterior. Fully sealed seams and a continuous outer surface help maintain clean, uninterrupted airflow across the shoe. An integrated tread pad under the toe improves durability and wear resistance when walking.

The low-cut construction extends slightly above the ankle and is designed to integrate cleanly with aero socks. A tight slip-on fit is combined with an adjustable hook-and-loop strap with cut-to-length capability, allowing the fit to be secured while minimising excess material.

The shoe covers form part of the FastStream aero concept, focused on reducing aerodynamic disruption around the shoe and lower leg. They are intended to be paired with the GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling Socks to create a clean, continuous aerodynamic interface. The shoe covers are compatible with road cycling shoes only and are designed to work with both lace and dial-based closure systems.

They provide wind protection and limited resistance to water and road spray over the covered areas. Due to the close, race-oriented construction, careful fitting is required.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Thermal Leg Warmers
features: Soft brushed thermal fabric offers insulation and protection from wind chill for cool spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural leg bend which reduces material bunching around your knees
Silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevent slippage down your legs
For visibility in traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Thermal Leg Warmers provide essential insulation and wind chill protection for cool-weather rides, made with soft brushed thermal fabric.

Lightweight and breathable, they wick moisture away from the skin, ensuring comfort during active use. The anatomical pre-shaped fit reduces bunching at the knees, while silicone elasticated grippers keep them securely in place.

Reflective details enhance visibility in low-light conditions, making these leg warmers a reliable choice for added warmth in transitional seasons.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Wool Liner Gloves
features: Added thermal insulation underneath your favourite winter gloves or wear them on their own off the bike in mild conditions
A blend of natural and synthetic fibres offers a super-soft, warm, stretchy, moisture wicking fabric
The slim profile, long cuffs and low bulk allow you to comfortably use them as liner gloves within your heavy duty winter gloves
Durable high-stretch material is wear- and wash-resistant, to offer many seasons of effective protection and insulation
Conductive copper threads on these fingertips allow you to answer calls and texts on the go
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Wool Liner Gloves are a versatile addition to any cyclist’s kit drawer. Used as liner gloves they can enhance the thermal rating of heavier duty winter gloves — to boost your warmth and comfort on the coldest days of winter.

These gloves are made from a premium merino wool blend: it mixes merino wool – a high-quality natural fabric that is super-soft and warm – with synthetic fibres, for improved moisture wicking and durability.

The index finger and thumb of these gloves have sewn-in conductive copper threads, to allow you to use touchscreens without taking the gloves off; this special touchscreen compatibility never washes out.

Slim and lightweight, but built to last — these liner gloves will offer you the added insulation, warmth and comfort you need to keep riding during the coldest winter days.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer
features: Ultralight open mesh fabric allows heat and moisture to escape from within, keeping you cool in hot summer conditions
Premium moisture wicking material transports sweat away from your body to keep you dry and comfortable
Polygiene® fabric treatment keeps you and your clothing smelling fresh for longer by reducing bacteria build-up
Superlight mesh fabric and low profile seams create a featherweight feel and a form-fitting cut
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer is your go-to base layer for summer cycling in sweltering heat. The featherweight open-weave mesh material allows your skin to breathe while quickly moving sweat away from your body to leave you dry and comfortable.

To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment (biocide: silver chloride). Its 'Wear More. Wash Less®' technology uses silver ions to reduce the build-up of odour-inducing bacteria. The treatment is entirely safe to wear against the skin and doesn’t wash out. Reduced bacteria build-up leads to reduced odour and therefore reduced washing frequency, meaning that Polygiene® can also significantly extend the life of a base layer.

The GripGrab Ultralight Mesh Sleeveless Base Layer offers you the comfort to keep riding in the hottest conditions. With minimum weight but maximum breathability, it has all the performance and functionality you need when working hard in the summer heat.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
features: Premium high-stretch waterproof and windproof fabric with taped seams protects your road cycling shoes from spray and dirt
The soft brushed lining traps heat within the shoe covers to keep your feet warm and comfortable in cool weather conditions

Lightweight low-bulk fabric is discrete to wear and transport. Aramid fibre wear reinforcements boost the longevity of the shoe covers
Reflective detailing on the outside and rear of the overshoes helps to enhance your presence on the road in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Road Shoe Covers offer practical protection against rain and road spray when training, racing or commuting in wet weather. Designed to shield your feet and shoes day-in-day-out, these shoe covers will keep you riding even in spring and autumn downpours.

The premium high-stretch waterproof and windproof fabric with taped seams will keep out spray and dirt. The soft brushed lining traps heat within the shoe covers to insulate and keep your feet warm and comfortable in cool weather conditions.

To put them on, there is a simple hook-and-loop closure on the rear of each shoe cover to allow you to quickly fit and remove them as conditions demand.

To enhance the durability, aramid fibre wear reinforcements are placed in high wear areas to protect the shoe covers. Reflective detailing on the outside and rear of the overshoes helps to enhance your presence on the road in low light conditions.

Choose the RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Road Shoe Covers for all weather protection on training rides and cycle commutes throughout the spring, autumn and early winter.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Lightweight Short Sleeve Jersey
features: Designed to be extremely lightweight and breathable
Elongated sleeves with raw cut edge for maximal comfort in high temperatures
Features a low collar to maximise refreshing airflow around the neck
Stays securely in place thanks to the silicone grippers integrated into the back bottom hem
en-GB.description_html:
This superlight and breathable jersey is made for intensive summer rides.

The GripGrab Lightweight PACR Short Sleeve Jersey features sleeves with a raw cut edge for maximum comfort and a low collar to promote airflow. It is constructed with a bottom hem elastic gripper at the back and bonded finishing at the front bottom hem for a secure fit. It includes three top entry pockets and a secured zip pocket, allowing for convenient storage. To enhance visibility, all logos are reflective.

With its amazing balance of lightweight, ventilation and sun protection, it will become your go-to jersey for high-performance cycling in hot conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Cycling Shorts
features: Crafted from high-quality fabrics offering a balanced level of stretch and support for enhanced comfort
Integrates a high-quality cycling pad from Elastic Interface (LIEGE HP) to deliver outstanding comfort during long rides

Stays comfortably in place during your rides thanks to the stretch waistband lined with moisture-wicking mesh
en-GB.description_html:
Crafted from high-quality stretch polyamide fabric offering UPF50+ sun protection, the GripGrab RIDE Cycling Shorts are an essential for riders, providing a gently supportive fit for optimal comfort.

Equipped with an Elastic Interface pad (LIEGE HP), they offer remarkable cushioning. For convenient access to your phone or snacks, a stretchy top-entry leg pocket is included. The wide elastics around the thighs, lined with silicone grippers and coupled with the comfortable elastic waistband, ensure a secure fit throughout your rides. Reflective details enhance visibility and safety in low-light conditions.

e recommend pairing these shorts with a GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey for a fully coordinated style and enhanced riding comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Windproof Spring-Autumn Socks
features: Windproof and breathable outer fabric shields your feet from windchill on cool spring-autumn days
Brushed fleece lining creates a plush next-to-skin feel and traps warmth within the socks for added comfort
Flatlock seams with pre-contoured foot-specific shape ensures comfort even in close-fitting cycling shoes
High cut ankle cuff insulates your ankles and maintains warm blood flow to your feet
Ideal for conditions when you typically wear toe covers and want a light protective layer to keep the chill at bay
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Windproof Socks are for riders aiming to keep the windchill off their feet but without the bulk of toe covers or overshoes.

The windproof and breathable outer fabric shields your feet from windchill on cool spring and autumn days meaning you can continue to ride in comfort even when the wind brings the first chill of winter.

The brushed fleece lining creates a plush next-to-skin feel and traps warm air within the socks for added comfort.

Comfort is key and the flatlock seams with pre-contoured foot-specific shape all combine to ensure comfort even in close-fitting cycling shoes.

The high cut ankle cuff insulates your ankles and maintains warm blood flow to your feet making it unnecessary to wear shoe covers on cool, dry and windy days.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Waterproof Winter Gloves
features: three-layer waterproof and windproof construction offers warmth, protection and against-skin comfort
DoctorGel® padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve to avoid numbness and discomfort in your hands
Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control
Microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to swipe sweat and nose drips away on those deep winter days
Enhances your visibility in low light conditions and helps make hand gestures more prominent in urban traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Waterproof Winter Gloves will keep your hands warm and dry when you venture out on the coldest and wettest days of winter.

These waterproof gloves feature a three-layer construction: a softshell outer, a waterproof and windproof membrane and soft fleece inner lining. They offer wet weather protection, insulation and against-skin comfort as you tick off the winter training kilometres or commute in the worst winter weather.

Strategically placed padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve in the palm – to avoid numbness and discomfort in your hands. Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control, so you never lose your grip.

A microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to wipe sweat and nose drips away on those deep winter days, while reflective detailing helps to enhance your visibility in low light conditions.

With the RIDE Waterproof Winter Gloves, you get wet weather protection, insulation and against-skin comfort for the coldest days on the bike – all at an affordable price tag.

Sizing tip: Winter gloves should be close-fitting but with enough room inside to allow for an insulating layer of air; if you are on the borderline between two sizes, then we recommend sizing up. If you want to wear liner gloves within these gloves, we also recommend sizing up.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Windproof Road Toe Covers
features: A lightweight layer of windproof protection and insulation for your toes on cool spring-autumn days
Water-resistant stretch fabric helps shield your toes from light wheel spray and mist
Aramid-fibre wear reinforcements on the underside help reduce scuffing and improve product lifespan
Reflective logo print helps to improve your road presence in low light conditions
Slip-on high-stretch design fits easily over road cycling shoes thanks to the pre-cut reinforced cleat hole
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Windproof Road Toe Covers are a versatile and multi-season piece of kit that can find a place in every cyclist’s kit drawer. Worn on their own over a pair of road cycling shoes, these toe covers offer windchill protection and a lightweight extra layer of insulation for your toes on those early morning rides, particularly on cool spring and autumn days.

Then, paired with overshoes in the winter, they offer an added layer of insulation to keep your toes warm in your cycling shoes as you log those long kilometres in the saddle during the colder months. Combined with a light pair of waterproof overshoes, toe covers can also offer a transitional level of warmth to your toes when it isn’t yet cold enough for full winter overshoes, but you are likely to encounter rain and wet roads.

The toe covers themselves have a level of water resistance and the stretch fabric helps shield your toes from light wheel spray and mist.

When attached to the front of your cycling shoes, the GripGrab Windproof Road Toe Covers are right in harm’s way; but the aramid-fibre wear reinforcements on the underside help reduce scuffing and improve product lifespan.

Autumn and winter rides are often done in low light conditions, so the reflective logo print helps to improve your road presence in low light and low visibility conditions.

These road cycling toe covers are easy to fit with their slip-on high-stretch design. They easily go over road cycling shoes thanks to the pre-cut reinforced cleat holes. Easy on before a ride, and easy off during – if your toes get too warm; they are a versatile accessory and small enough to stow in your jersey pocket.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Short Sleeve Jersey
feature_titles: Three top-entry pockets on the back
features: providing protection in rainy weather conditions.
ensuring comfort and effective temperature regulation
ensuring a snug, flexible fit that adapts to body movements

en-GB.description_html:
The AquaRepel Water-Resistant Short Sleeve Jersey is developed for riders who seek optimal performance and protection in rainy and foul weather conditions. This high-performance jersey is designed to meet the rigorous demands of competitive cycling.

Featuring an 8K waterproof rating, the AquaRepel Jersey provides robust protection against rain, ensuring you stay as dry as possible during wet rides. The 15K breathable fabric guarantees effective temperature regulation, keeping you comfortable throughout intense cycling sessions. Its stretchable three-layer fabric delivers a snug and flexible fit.

For enhanced water resistance, the jersey includes bonded seams in critical areas around the shoulders. The YKK 2-way AquaGuard zipper offers easy access from both ends. Three top-entry back pockets with drainage holes provide ample storage for your essentials.

The extended rear hem protects against road spray, while the silicone hem gripper ensures the jersey stays in place, maintaining a streamlined and aerodynamic appearance. Reflective details enhance your visibility in low-light conditions.

Designed for cyclists who push their limits, the AquaRepel Water-Resistant Short Sleeve Jersey combines style, functionality, and protection, making it the ultimate gear for challenging weather conditions. Pair it with the AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts and AquaRepel Water-Resistant Arm Warmers for the perfect wet-weather cycling kit.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Ponytail Windproof Winter Skull Cap
features: Keep the wind off your forehead
For long days in cold conditions
Hair does not need to be bunched up inside your cycle helmet
To help with temperature regulation when you work up a sweat
For comfort when cycling in cold conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Thermo Ponytail Windproof Winter Skull Cap is a soft, lightweight and insulating skull cap, with a windproof front panel. This version features a hole at the rear to allow you to wear the cap with a pony tail.

Ideal for cycling, running and other activities in cold winter condition.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Windproof Vest
features: Block cold wind across the chest for added comfort on cool rides
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Allows excess heat and moisture to escape when effort rises
Provides an athletic but comfortable cut for easy layering over a cycling jersey
Allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access to jersey pockets while riding
Help increase visibility in low-light riding conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The W’s RIDE Windproof Vest is built for women riding road and gravel who need simple core protection and easy temperature control on cool, changeable rides. Windproof front panels block cold wind across the chest, while a water-repellent finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric.

A breathable mesh back panel allows excess heat and moisture to escape when effort rises, helping balance wind protection and ventilation. The women-specific active fit provides an athletic but comfortable cut that layers easily over a cycling jersey.

The YKK Vislon 2-way zipper allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access to jersey pockets while riding. Reflective elements help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built for cool starts, descents, and changeable spring-to-autumn rides, this vest delivers lightweight core protection when a full jacket would be too much. It is not designed as a waterproof rain vest or as an insulated cold-weather layer.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Water-Resistant Bib Tights
features: highly breathable (15K), and stretchable, ensuring comprehensive protection for the front of the leg
improving pedaling efficiency and power transfer
for increased flexibility and comfort at the back of the leg
designed with advanced padding technology
for visibility in traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Water-Resistant Bib Tights are your trusted companion for battling wet and cold conditions.

Engineered for serious cyclists who brave the elements, these bib tights provide exceptional protection and comfort. Crafted with a 8K waterproof triple-layer fabric on the front, they offer comprehensive coverage that shields your legs from rain and road spray while maintaining excellent breathability (15K) to prevent overheating.

Experience the comfort of the luxurious Elastic Interface chamois (PARIS HCS), crafted with advanced padding technology to provide superior comfort and support during long rides.

The rear of the legs features stretchable fleece inserts that adapt to your movements, providing increased flexibility and a snug fit. Strategically placed reflective details enhance your visibility in low-light conditions.

Embrace the elements with the PACR Water-Resistant Bib Tights, and experience the perfect blend of style, functionality, and performance. Whether you're training for your next race or embarking on a long-distance ride, these bib tights will keep you comfortable and protected in foul weather conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights
features: Front, side and back panels use a three-layer softshell fabric construction with a fully waterproof and breathable membrane for maximum protection
The four-way stretch softshell fabric ensures a close and comfortable fit with maximum freedom of movement
Flatlock seams are pre-shaped and contoured to provide an optimised fit around the knees and through the leg motion
Removable padded liner shorts to wear beneath these unpadded bib tights, an Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP pad offers comfort for long distance rides
The underside of the thighs, back of the knees and the waist use a high-stretch fleece fabric for added insulation, breathability and comfort
en-GB.description_html:
To keep riding through autumn and winter you need apparel that will shield you from the elements and make you feel comfortable heading out in all conditions. The GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights are your leg wear solution – a versatile construction offering waterproof and windproof protection with great insulation against rough riding weather.

These bib tights utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your entire legs and lower back from the worst winter weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

In areas without the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the thighs, back of the knees and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added insulation and body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, like the other fabric panels, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs off rain showers and rear wheel spray.

The padding in the ThermaShell Bib Tights is unique – it comes in the form of a superior level seatpad fitted within removable GripGrab Ventilite Padded Liner Shorts – to wear underneath the unpadded outer bib tights.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The liner shorts themselves are made from a mix of high-stretch fabric and exceptionally breathable mesh, with a wide elastic waistband to minimise pressure points. Elastic grippers with silicone gripper dots on the hems keep the shorts firmly in place, even when worn underneath the tights.

When getting home, brush off the dirt off your tights while cleaning your bike – and they’re ready for the next ride. Meanwhile, you can keep the liner shorts on to complete your training with some core and stretch exercises indoor. The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the shorts without needing to wash the complete set of bib tights after each ride: this is better for the tights as they retain their waterproofing and performance for longer. This product construction will also allow you to ride during consecutive days without having to worry about washing and drying your bib tights, by simply rotating the inner shorts or Summer bibs that you wear under the long tights.

Further details include reflective elements that will help to enhance your road presence in low light conditions, as well as contoured flatlock seams that ensure a close comfortable fit, no matter how hard you are pedalling.

Designed in Denmark for the Scandinavian winters – these bib tights will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those long cold rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Blend Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: Merino wool traps warmth while allowing airflow
Soft, insulating, and built to last
Soft merino blend feels great against the skin
Ideal for multi-season cycling
en-GB.description_html: The unique 50/50 blend provides the well known benefits of merino wool – super soft, naturally insulating and with exceptional temperature regulation; yet it also combines it with the added durability, stretch properties and wrinkle-resistance found in polyester fibres. The outcome is that this base layer is incredibly comfortable to wear against your skin, but it also has great longevity and will cope exceptionally well with repeat use and frequent washing — the perfect combination for winter cycling wear.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Summer Seamless Short Sleeve Base Layer
features: Smooth, no-distraction fit under your race layers
Close fit accelerates moisture transfer in hot conditions
Open knit structure promotes airflow to keep your core cool when the pace goes up
Low-absorption yarn keeps moisture away from the skin to keep you feeling dry
Advanced odour control keeps the base layer fresh for longer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for high-intensity riding in warm conditions, the GripGrab PACR Summer Seamless Short Sleeve Base Layer provides a minimal, race-ready foundation under close-fitting jerseys. The ultralight construction prioritises breathability and unrestricted movement, making it well suited for racing and fast training sessions.

The seamless body construction creates a smooth, low-profile interface under the jersey or speed suit. Specialized knit structures are integrated directly through the knitting process, tailoring the fabric to different areas of the body. The low collar provides clean integration with modern race jerseys.

Made from a lightweight blend of polypropylene and polyamide, the fabric is inherently hydrophobic, keeping moisture away from the skin during hard efforts. A Polygiene anti-odour treatment maintains freshness over repeated rides.

Purpose-built for summer use, this base layer focuses on breathability, minimal weight, and clean layering without unnecessary features.

en-GB.name: GripGrab EXPLR High Cut Socks
features: Durable yarn construction increases abrasion resistance
Durable reinforcements enhance durability in high-wear areas
Moisture-wicking yarn keeps feet dry and comfortable
Dries quickly to enhance comfort during activity
Elastic zones stabilise the midfoot for a close-fitting feel
en-GB.description_html:
Built for long days beyond the tarmac, the GripGrab EXPLR High Cut Socks are designed to handle the realities of off-road riding, gravel adventures, and bikepacking. The focus is on dependable comfort and durability in environments where equipment is exposed to abrasion, dust, and day-long riding in demanding conditions.

Cordura®-reinforced yarns are integrated into the shaft, heel, and toe to improve resistance to wear in high-abrasion situations such as narrow off-road paths and overgrown hike-a-bike sections. Underfoot, a durable knit structure helps protect against friction in contact-heavy areas, supporting comfort over extended rides.

COOLMAX® yarns manage moisture efficiently, wicking sweat away from the skin and drying quickly to keep feet cool during warm-weather efforts. A stretch arch support stabilises the sock on the foot, while the seamless toe construction reduces the risk of irritation or rubbing during long hours in and out of the saddle.

Finished with a supportive, non-compressive cuff and a high-cut shaft (19 cm, size M), these socks deliver a secure, close fit without feeling tight, well suited to riders who prioritise resilience, practicality, and comfort when venturing off the beaten path.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Rebel Youngster Windproof Winter Gloves
features: Premium windproof fabric and soft fleece lining for comfort on cold winter days
DoctorGel® padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve to avoid numbness and discomfort in the hands
Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control
Microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to swipe sweat and nose drips away on those chilly winter days
Enhances your visibility in low light conditions and helps make hand gestures more prominent in urban traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Kids' Rebel Windproof Winter Gloves are comfortable, breathable and durable winter cycling gloves; made for enthusiastic children who refuse to stop riding in cold weather.

The soft fabric cuffs are extended in length to provide a good junction with kids' winter cycling jackets, and seal in the warmth. The windproof and breathable outer and the soft fleece lining offer windchill protection and cold weather insulation.

These gloves are not waterproof but they will withstand a short shower and road spray. The padding on the palm will help to enhance comfort on rough riding surfaces, while the thumb is touchscreen compatible to allow young riders to answer calls without taking the gloves off. Reflective details help to improve the visibility of hand signals in low light conditions.

If you are looking for a pair of cycling gloves for young riders, these are a great option. No matter what type of cycling – road, mountain, CX or gravel bike – the robust Kids' Rebel Windproof Winter Gloves offer great comfort and value-for-money for cycling in cold and windy conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab R.A.Y. Bottle - 600 ml
en-GB.description_html:
Stay hydrated with the GripGrab R.A.Y. Bottle – 600 ml. This bottle ensures no plastic aftertaste, keeping your drinks pure and fresh.

The R.A.Y. Bottle features a wide screw-top opening for easy refilling and cleaning. The big opening makes it easy to fill with your favorite energy drink. The tight-fitting lid guarantees no leaks, so you can avoid spills and stay focused on your ride. Equipped with a comfortable rubber spout, this bottle provides smooth sipping and ensures better water tightness. The discreetly branded ergonomic grip collar ensures a secure hold.

Pick your favorite color to match your individual taste and join our RIDE ALL YEAR mission, experiencing the perfect hydration companion. Don’t forget to scan the QR code for exclusive hydration tips.

Usage Recommendations:

- Wash it before you use it for the first time.

- It is for cold drinks (<40°C), not for coffee or tea.

- Don't leave liquids in it for more than 24 hours as this may adversely affect the taste of the content.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Bib Shorts
features: Crafted from high-quality fabrics, the shorts offer a comfortable balance of stretch and compression for enhanced comfort
Includes lightweight mesh in the upper body for improved airflow and sweat management
Integrates a high-quality cycling pad from Elastic Interface (LIEGE HP) to deliver outstanding comfort during long rides
Features a convenient stretchy pocket, lying flat against the leg for easy access to your phone or snacks throughout your ride
Ensure a secure fit on the legs with wide elastic hems and silicone grippers
en-GB.description_html:
Crafted from high-quality stretch polyamide fabric boasting UPF50+ sun protection, the GripGrab RIDE Bib Shorts stand as an essential piece for riders, providing an accommodating fit for optimal comfort.

The upper body incorporates wicking mesh, assuring excellent breathability and moisture management. Equipped with an Elastic Interface seatpad (LIEGE HP), it delivers remarkable cushioning for long rides. For easy access to your essentials, a convenient top-entry leg pocket is included. The wide elastic bottom leg, coupled with an inner silicone gripper, ensures a secure fit throughout your rides. Reflective details enhance visibility and safety in low-light conditions.

We recommend pairing these bibs with a GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey for a fully cohesive style and enhanced riding comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Vertical InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: GripGrab's award winning technology has silicone print on the inside of the palm for a second-skin fit
Lightweight mesh allows your hands to breathe in hot weather conditions
Silicone gripper print on the fingertips for extra control of levers and controls
For a close-fitting profile and low bulk around the cuffs of long sleeve jerseys or jackets
For the closest contact between your hands and the handlebars for maximum feel and control
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Vertical InsideGrip™ Full Finger Summer Gloves are designed for downhill mountain biking and freeride. Lightweight, breathable and un-padded – they offer maximum feel and control, as well as valuable protection for your hands.

The low-bulk design is enhanced by GripGrab's unique InsideGrip™ technology – a silicone print on the inside of the gloves to give a second-skin feel – providing exceptional grip and control over the handlebars and levers, even in the toughest off-road situations. Breathable mesh back fabrics offer comfort on hot and fast rides; so in the summer heat these are a top glove choice for mountain bike racing, cyclocross and gravel riding.

Mathieu van der Poel rode to the rainbow jersey at the Cyclocross World Championships wearing the GripGrab Vertical gloves in February 2020, and they are consistently one of the most popular gloves with GripGrab's own in-house testing team too. A lightweight but durable second skin – the GripGrab Vertical gloves protect your hands and give you the ultimate grip and control in challenging off-road riding situations.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Classic Low Cut Summer Socks 3-Pack
features: CoolMax® Mesh is highly breathable and allows heat and perspiration to escape through the fabric
Stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics create a light compression feel for a superb close-fitting cut
For maximum comfort in hot riding conditions and for minimal bulk within your summer cycling shoes
The ideal versatile and comfortable socks for all summer sports pursuits as well as for casual wear
Benefit from a better per-unit price in this three-pack
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Classic Low Cut Summer Socks will keep your feet cool and comfortable on warm summer rides. The CoolMax® Mesh fabric is highly breathable and allows heat and perspiration to escape, so your feet stay dry when you are pushing hard on the pedals.

The lightweight fabric has minimal bulk – optimised to fit inside cycling shoes; while the stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics create a light compression feel for a superb close-fitting cut.

With the GripGrab Classic Low Cut Summer Socks you look and feel great while riding in comfort.

Even better value in a three-pack

en-GB.name: GripGrab Lightweight Summer Sweatband
features: High-wicking material moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool and keep sweat out of your eyes
At 15 grams the super lightweight fabric offers maximum breathability and fast drying
Super low-profile and low bulk seams and material allow you to wear it comfortably underneath a cycling helmet
The high-stretch mesh material allows this sweatband to be one-size-fits-all without any pressure points
Machine washable and fast drying. A lot easier than washing your helmet padding after a sweltering ride
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Lightweight Summer Sweatband is a small and very light (15 grams) addition to your summer cycling kit, but it could make all the difference to warm weather riding. Despite their association with a bygone era, this sweatband is an up-to-date piece of cycling kit for the hottest cycling conditions.

The summer sweatband is constructed from a high-wicking material which moves moisture away from your brow to keep you cool and keep sweat out of your eyes. This lets you stay comfortable and focused in the hot weather. The 15-gram super lightweight fabric is fast drying and highly breathability to help prevent overheating.  

A high-stretch mesh allows the sweatband to be one-size-fits-all, without any pressure points on your head. Its super low-profile design allows you to wear it comfortably under your cycling helmet.

Then, once you have finished your ride, the sweatband is machine washable and fast drying; an far easier solution than washing your helmet padding after every sweltering ride. Adding the GripGrab Lightweight Summer Sweatband to your summer cycling outfit could make all the difference – you'll keep your vision clear for the road ahead.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Classic Thermal Arm Warmers
features: Soft brushed thermal fabric offers insulation and protection from wind chill for cool spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural elbow bend which reduces material bunching
Strong silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevents slippage down your arms
Easily stored in a pocket or pannier making them ideal for changeable weather and bikepacking tours
en-GB.description_html:
The Classic Thermal Arm Warmers could be the most versatile bit of kit you own; extending how far into the year you can wear your favourite short sleeve jersey. Once the temperature rises, or you push hard on a climb, the warmers can be rolled down or removed completely and easily stored in a jersey pocket.

Made from a soft brushed thermal fabric these arm warmers offer insulation and a barrier against wind chill for cooler weather rides. Thanks to their pre-contoured shape, material bunching around your elbows won’t be a problem and the gripper at the top will hold them in place so you can avoid the dreaded upper arm skin gap.

A pair of Classic Thermal Arm Warmers are a useful addition to any cyclist’s kit drawer, ready to keep the chill off on cold mornings before folding up small into a jersey pocket when no longer needed.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Knee Warmers
features: Delivering warmth and exceptional breathability for comfort during transitional rides
Delivering effective water repellency in wet conditions
Delivering a precise, anatomical fit that follows the natural contours of the legs
Keeping the knee warmers securely in place
Adding a touch of reflectivity
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Knee Warmers are crafted for cyclists who demand performance and adaptability during transitional seasons. Featuring light insulation, they provide essential warmth and exceptional breathability, ensuring comfort on cooler rides. A DWR coating adds effective water repellency, keeping you prepared for wet conditions.

The pre-shaped, anatomical fit follows the natural contours of your legs, offering freedom of movement and a sleek profile. Elasticated grippers ensure a secure hold, while reflective branding adds a touch of visibility for low-light conditions. These knee warmers are a versatile and functional choice for high-intensity rides in spring and autumn.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Classic Thermal Knee Warmers
features: Soft brushed thermal fabric offers insulation and protection from wind chill for cool spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural leg bend which reduces material bunching around your knees
Silicone elasticated grippers on the top and bottom of the warmers prevent slippage down your legs
Easily stored in a cycling jersey pocket or pannier, making them ideal for changeable weather conditions
en-GB.description_html:
Some riders won’t bother with knee warmers, exposing their vulnerable joints to the cold air – but you know better.

The Classic Thermal Knee Warmers are the perfect stopgap between full leg warmers and bare legs, on those days when the windchill factor lowers the ambient temperature but the breeze around your lower legs is a welcome way to regulate your temperature.

Pull on a pair of knee warmers for those chilly starts on early spring and autumn bike rides, then when the temperature rises, stow them in your jersey pocket or pannier for the rest of the ride. Versatile kit so you can conquer all conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Thermal Knee Warmers
features: keeping the knees warm in cool conditions, while breathability ensures excess heat and moisture are effectively released
designed to follow the natural contours of the knee
keeping the knee warmers securely in place
providing effective water repellency
providing visibility in traffic
en-GB.description_html:
Experience superior cycling comfort with the PACR Thermal Knee Warmers, designed for performance-oriented riders.

These knee warmers offer exceptional thermal insulation, ensuring your knees stay warm and protected in cold conditions while maintaining breathability to effectively release excess heat and moisture. The pre-shaped fit follows the natural contours of your knees, providing a comfortable and ergonomic feel.

Elasticated grippers ensure a secure hold, keeping the knee warmers firmly in place even during intense rides. The durable water repellent (DWR) treatment provides reliable water repellency, protecting you from unpredictable weather conditions. Reflective details add a touch of visibility in low-light conditions, enhancing your presence on the road.

Designed for versatility and flexibility, these knee warmers can be easily taken on and off as required, making them perfect for adjusting to changing weather conditions and varying ride intensities.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers
features: A lightweight layer of windproof protection and insulation for your toes on cool spring-autumn days
Water-resistant stretch fabric helps shield your toes from light wheel spray and mist
Aramid-fibre wear reinforcements on the underside help reduce scuffing and improve product lifespan
Reflective logo print helps to improve your road presence in low light conditions
Slip-on high-stretch design fits easily over road cycling shoes thanks to the pre-cut reinforced cleat hole
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers are a versatile and multi-season piece of kit that can find a place in every cyclist’s kit drawer. Worn on their own over a pair of road cycling shoes, these toe covers offer wind chill protection and a lightweight extra layer of insulation for your toes on those early morning rides, particularly on cool spring and autumn days.

Then, paired with overshoes in the winter, they offer an added layer of insulation to keep your toes warm in your cycling shoes as you log those long kilometres in the saddle during the colder months. Combined with a light pair of waterproof overshoes, toe covers can also offer a transitional level of warmth to your toes when it isn’t yet cold enough for full winter overshoes, but you are likely to encounter rain and wet roads.

The toe covers themselves have a level of water resistance and the stretch fabric helps shield your toes from light wheel spray and mist.

When attached to the front of your cycling shoes, the GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers are right in harm’s way; but the aramid-fibre wear reinforcements on the underside help reduce scuffing and improve product lifespan.

Autumn and winter rides are often done in low light conditions, so the reflective logo print helps to improve your road presence in low light and low visibility conditions.

These road cycling toe covers are easy to fit with their slip-on high-stretch design. They easily go over road cycling shoes thanks to the pre-cut reinforced cleat holes. Easy on before a ride and easy off during – if your toes get too warm; they are a versatile accessory and small enough to stow in your jersey pocket.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Raceday Bib Shorts
feature_titles: Inner silicone print at the leg ending
Minimal bib suspenders with embossed logo
features: Provide a supportive, race-focused fit that stays close to the body on intense rides
Creates a smooth transition on the leg for a cleaner look and less pressure than a traditional gripper band
Keeps the shorts securely in place without adding bulk
Reduce upper-body bulk and deliver a light, stripped-back race feel
Adds premium on-bike comfort and support for long hours in an aggressive riding position

en-GB.name: GripGrab Nordic 2 Windproof Deep Winter Lobster Gloves
features: Outer fabric is 100% windproof and highly breathable with a durable water-resistant coating
PrimaLoft® Gold insulation on the palm and back of the gloves gives extreme winter insulation and warmth
Durable synthetic suede palm with padding and silicone grip pattern for maximum comfort and control
The separation of the forefinger allows for easier braking and shifting on both road and MTB brake and gear levers
Reflective detailing helps to improve your road presence and signalling in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The Nordic 2 Windproof Deep Winter Lobster Gloves are for riders with no ‘off-season’. If there is snow on the side of the road or trails, and it is safe to go cycling, then these are the gloves to keep your hands warm and comfortable on deep winter adventures.

The lobster-style design has been evolved to have an optimised finger split: where the separation of the forefinger allows for easier braking and shifting on both road and MTB levers – so you have maximum dexterity and control.

The deep winter rating comes firstly from the 100% windproof outer fabric. This fabric has a high breathability rating of 15K (15,000 g/m²/24h), so your hands will remain comfortable even if you work up a sweat. A DWR (Durable Water Repellent) coating on the outside will shrug off light rain and spray.

Market-leading Primaloft® Gold insulation is used in the palm, which is low bulk and exceptionally insulating, even under compression. The back of the gloves then features Primaloft® Gold Active+ for an exceptionally high warmth-to-weight ratio.

Deep winter riding just got comfortable.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Lightweight Hi-Vis Running Visor
features: Lightweight fabrics so you barely feel like you are wearing the cap
Keeps the sun and sweat out of your eyes on warm summer runs
To help enhance your presence to other road users in low light conditions
The open top allows more heat to escape than an enclosed cap
Adjustable closure allows for an optimal fit for a range of head sizes
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Lightweight Hi-Vis Running Visor is a lightweight and super comfortable peaked visor cap, made with highly breathable and highly visible materials.

Ideal for keeping the sweat and sun out of your eyes, while letting your head breathe. The bold colour will help to enhance your visibility when running on the road.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Windproof Vest
features: Block cold wind across the chest for added comfort on cool rides
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Allows excess heat and moisture to escape when effort rises
Provides an athletic but comfortable cut for easy layering over a cycling jersey
Allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access to jersey pockets while riding
Help increase visibility in low-light riding conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Windproof Vest is built for road and gravel riders who need simple core protection and easy temperature control on cool, changeable rides. Windproof front panels block cold wind across the chest, while a water-repellent finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric.

A breathable mesh back panel allows excess heat and moisture to escape when effort rises, helping balance wind protection and ventilation. The active fit provides an athletic but comfortable cut that layers easily over a cycling jersey.

The YKK Vislon 2-way zipper allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access to jersey pockets while riding. Reflective elements help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built for cool starts, descents, and changeable spring-to-autumn rides, this vest delivers lightweight core protection when a full jacket would be too much. It is not designed as a waterproof rain vest or as an insulated cold-weather layer.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Winter Gloves
features: Three-layer waterproof and windproof construction offers warmth, protection and against-skin comfort
DoctorGel® padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve to avoid numbness and discomfort in your hands
Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control
Microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to swipe sweat and nose drips away on those deep winter days
Enhances your visibility in low light conditions and helps make hand gestures more prominent in urban traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Winter Gloves will keep your hands warm and dry when you venture out on the coldest and wettest days of winter.

These waterproof gloves feature a three-layer construction: a softshell outer, a waterproof and windproof membrane and soft fleece inner lining. They offer wet weather protection, insulation and against-skin comfort as you tick off the winter training kilometres or commute in the worst winter weather.

Strategically placed padding protects the vulnerable Ulnar nerve in the palm – to avoid numbness and discomfort in your hands. Silicone print gripper palms and fingertips create a secure hold on handlebars and levers for enhanced control, so you never lose your grip.

A microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to wipe sweat and nose drips away on those deep winter days, while reflective detailing helps to enhance your visibility in low light conditions.

With the RIDE Hi-Vis Waterproof Winter Gloves, you get wet weather protection, insulation and against-skin comfort for the coldest days on the bike – all at an affordable price tag.

Sizing tip: Winter gloves should be close-fitting but with enough room inside to allow for an insulating layer of air; if you are on the borderline between two sizes, then we recommend sizing up. If you want to wear liner gloves within these gloves, we also recommend sizing up.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Waterproof Knitted Winter Gloves
features: 100% waterproof and windproof membrane bonded between insulating and breathable thermal knit fabrics
Soft and stretchy knitted fabric offers a supportive and comfortable fit on the longest winter rides
Silicone grippers on the palm of the gloves create a secure hold on the handlebars in wet conditions
Machine washable at 30°C. Unique knitted fabric is robust and durable without the need for special treatments
Looks and feels like you are wearing classic knitted cycling gloves
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Waterproof Knitted Winter Gloves are your go-to companion to have dry and warm hands when cycling on chilly damp mornings.

These versatile gloves are made from an insulating knitted fabric with a breathable waterproof membrane; they provide a soft and insulating layer to keep windchill and precipitation from freezing your fingers.

With a simple gripper print on the palms, wear reinforcements, and subtle reflective details; they will help keep you in control and help your hand signals stand out in the dark. The ideal gloves for style and comfort in changeable weather conditions.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Raptor Raceday Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves
features: Protect your hands from windchill when riding in the changeable seasons of spring and autumn
Silicone grippers on the palm and unique InsideGrip™ on the inside of the gloves provide the ultimate grip and control
Thumb tip is touchscreen compatible to allow use of mobile phones and bicycle computers without removing the gloves
Breathable stretch fabrics allow moisture to escape from within to leave your hands dry and comfortable
Lightweight fabric, non-padded palms and a low profile slip-in cuff reduce bulk and maximise feel and control
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Raptor RaceDay Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves are designed for cycle races in cool winter conditions. The windproof and water-resistant material on the back panel of each gloves helps to shield your hands from mud and spray, whilst the breathable fabric allows your hands to stay dry even when you are working up a sweat.

InsideGrip™ technology, silicone palm grippers and the non-padded palm enhance your hold on the handlebars and improve your feel for the bike – to give you the confidence you need to perform at your best. The Slip In cuff design means they fit and feel like a second skin, with zero movement restriction.

These gloves were used by the winner of the 2018 and 2019 Men's Elite Cyclocross World Championships.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Women's Shark Padded Full Finger Summer Gloves
features: DoctorGel® padding protects your hands from vibrations and enhances your comfort on off-road rides
Lightweight mesh back panel lets your hands breathe as you perspire in hot conditions
Supple synthetic suede palm and silicone fingertips offer maximum control on the handlebars and levers
Hard-wearing fabrics with reinforcement patches on thumb and fingers offer enhanced product life
Lightweight high-stretch cuff reduces the bulk of the glove when worn underneath long sleeve jerseys
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Women's Shark Full Finger Gloves are the ideal summer cycling gloves for those looking to ride off-road, whether that’s mountain biking, cyclocross, or going on a gravel adventure. With an optimised fit for more slender female hands, these are the perfect gloves for those dry and dusty summer rides.

The gloves have shock absorbing DoctorGel® padding to protect your hands from vibrations when riding on gravel and singletrack, which will also help smooth out any road blemishes at the start and end of your ride when you are travelling to and from the trails.

Enhanced comfort means enhanced control, and this is increased by the supple synthetic suede of the palms and the silicone fingertips; these features ensure maximum control of the handlebars, brakes and shifters – so your gloves won’t be a concern when you want to push the limits off-road.

The lightweight mesh back panel of the GripGrab Shark gloves lets your hands breathe as you perspire in hot conditions or push hard on the trails, tracks and gravel lanes. Made from hard-wearing fabrics that are durable and long-lasting, these cycling gloves also feature reinforcement patches on the thumb and fingers to further boost product life.

The lightweight high-stretch cuffs reduce the bulk of these gloves thanks to the absence of a fastening tab; so when worn with long sleeve jerseys or arm warmers the cuff sits underneath for sleek look and comfortable feel. The ultimate gloves for those summer trails.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Windproof Winter Skull Cap
features: Flexible windproof front panel protects your head from windchill in deep winter conditions
Warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining offers insulation and comfort in cold weather
Low-bulk fleece fabric is highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio
Stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching allows a comfortable close fit under a cycling helmet
Reflective logos and detailing on front and rear help to improve visibility in low light winter conditions
en-GB.description_html:
It may be a myth that you lose more heat from your head than anywhere else, but the proportionate heat loss and discomfort of an exposed head and ears on a winter bike ride could see you heading home much earlier than planned.

This breathable thermal skull cap will keep your head warm and – thanks to its lightweight construction and flatlock stitching – it's a comfortable close fit under your cycling helmet for maximum comfort on long winter bike rides.

With a windproof front panel and a soft fleece lining, your brow is shielded from windchill and your head is insulated from the cold winter weather. Reflective logos and detailing on the front and rear of the hi-vis skullcap can also help to improve visibility in low light winter conditions and when commuting through urban areas.

This simple but effective piece of cycling headwear will keep your head warm and visible on the coldest winter days.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Hi-Vis Cycling Essentials Gift Box
feature_titles: All your accessories for cold weather cycling
features: Includes the GripGrab Ride Hi-Vis Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves, the GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer and the GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap
Wind-resistant outer on the gloves and insulating soft-brushed inner on both the gloves and skull cap offer spring, autumn and early winter cycling comfort
Touchscreen thumb tips allow you to answer calls without taking off your gloves
Reflective logo and accents on the gloves and skull cap can help to increase your visibility when cycling in low light conditions
Save money and create a great gift pack for any cyclist with this three-in-one multipack of essential cycling accessories
en-GB.description_html:
If you intend to cycle all year round, you will need the cycling kit to keep you comfortable and make it an enjoyable way to spend time. The GripGrab Hi-Vis Cycling Essentials Gift Box could be the difference between cycling in comfort when the temperature drops or leaving your bike untouched until summer rolls around again.

Containing all the accessories you need for spring, autumn and early winter cycling, the gift box features the GripGrab Ride Hi-Vis Windproof Spring-Autumn Gloves, the GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer and the GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap. The gloves utilise a protective wind-resistant outer material, while both the gloves and skull cap have an insulating soft-brushed inner material to provide cold weather cycling comfort.

The lightweight cycling gloves have touchscreen compatible thumb tips to allow you to answer calls or take photos without removing the gloves.

A further feature of the gloves, which is also found on the skull cap, is reflective detailing; reflective logos and accents on the gloves and skull cap can help to increase your visibility when cycling in low light conditions.

Buying this three-in-one gift pack – even for yourself, that’s fine! – is a great way to save money on these cycling accessories, compared to buying the three individual component pieces.

The glove size is what determines the size label of the bundle – consult the size guide for additional information. The GripGrab Multifunctional Neck Warmer comes in one size, the GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Skull Cap comes in the standard size of 57-60cm head circumference.

The GripGrab Hi-Vis Cycling Essentials is a great gift pack for any cyclist, to keep them riding in comfort throughout the chillier days of spring, autumn and early winter.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Belgian Style Thermal Windproof Winter Cycling Cap
features: Fleece-lined softshell fabric offers insulation against the coldest winter conditions
Keep the windchill off your head on the stormy days of autumn and winter
Breathable fabrics allow perspiration to escape from within to keep you comfortable and dry
Water-resistant outer softshell fabric shrugs off light drizzle and spray
Reflective brim and logo detailing help enhance visibility in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Belgian Style Thermal Windproof Winter Cycling Cap was inspired by hard riding in winter conditions.

The 'Belgian Style' cycling cap features a stiff peak to keep the wind and spray off your face, as well as ear flaps to provide complete coverage and maximum insulation. The fleece-lined softshell material offers light rain protection and luxurious insulation, while still being breathable and comfortable against the skin. This cap is the ultimate winter cycling headwear for protection against the elements.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Raceday Short Sleeve Jersey
feature_titles: Raglan aero sleeves with striped fabric and raw-cut sleeve ends
Bonded finishing at the front collar, front hem, and pocket edge
3 open back pockets plus 1 zipped pocket
features: Sit close to the body for a fast, performance-led feel with minimal excess fabric
Wrap the shoulders and arms smoothly for a more streamlined fit and unrestricted movement
Feels clean and unobtrusive around the neck, especially in an aggressive riding position
Reduces bulk and gives the jersey a cleaner, more premium finish
Offer practical storage for ride essentials, with added security for smaller valuables

en-GB.name: GripGrab Light Spring-Autumn Leg Warmers
features: Lightweight fabric offers insulation to take the edge off those cooler spring and autumn mornings
Lightweight fabric is highly breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural leg bend which reduces material bunching around the knees
Strong silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevent slippage down your legs
Easily stored in a pocket or pannier making them ideal for changeable weather and bikepacking tours
en-GB.description_html:
These lightweight leg warmers are for riders who like early starts in the spring and autumn – keep the chill off your legs until the temperature rises and then stow them away in your jersey pocket for the rest of the ride.

When the temperature does rise, or you expected it to be cooler when you set off, the lightweight fabric is highly breathable and moisture wicking so it will help to move perspiration away from your skin as you push on the pedals.

The leg warmers are shaped to avoid bunching and have a strong silicone gripper to keep them in place during your ride.

Grab a pair of these lightweight leg warmers to keep the chill off your legs on early morning rides and carry them with you in a jersey pocket or pannier for when you might encounter windchill on longer rides.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Waterproof Knitted Gloves
feature_titles: One glove to help keep your hands dry most of the season
Three-layer knitted construction with a membrane
features: Cool, wet rides often end with damp hands that slowly turn cold. A membrane inside this knitted glove helps keep your hands dry in rain, the lining adds warmth in damp cold, and you keep a natural feel for the bar
A membrane between the knitted outer and the warm knitted lining helps keep your hands dry in rain
A smoother surface that helps shed water, so less of it soaks into the knit and chills your hands
Adds friction against the bar and controls for secure grip
Use your bike computer or phone without taking the glove off

en-GB.name: GripGrab EXPLR Regular Cut Socks
features: Durable yarn construction increases abrasion resistance
Durable reinforcements enhance durability in high-wear areas
Moisture-wicking yarn keeps feet dry and comfortable
Dries quickly to enhance comfort during activity
Elastic zones stabilise the midfoot for a close-fitting feel
en-GB.description_html:
Built for long days beyond the tarmac, the GripGrab EXPLR Regular Cut Socks are designed to handle the realities of off-road riding, gravel adventures, and bikepacking. The focus is on dependable comfort and durability in environments where equipment is exposed to abrasion, dust, and day-long riding in demanding conditions.

Cordura®-reinforced yarns are integrated into the shaft, heel, and toe to improve resistance to wear in high-abrasion situations such as narrow off-road paths and overgrown hike-a-bike sections. Underfoot, a durable knit structure helps protect against friction in contact-heavy areas, supporting comfort over extended rides.

COOLMAX® yarns manage moisture efficiently, wicking sweat away from the skin and drying quickly to keep feet cool during warm-weather efforts. A stretch arch support stabilises the sock on the foot, while the seamless toe construction reduces the risk of irritation or rubbing during long hours in and out of the saddle.

Finished with a supportive, non-compressive cuff and a regular-cut shaft (15 cm, size M), these socks deliver a secure, close fit without feeling tight, well suited to riders who prioritise resilience, practicality, and comfort when venturing off the beaten path.

en-GB.name: GripGrab TrailBlazer Flat Pedal MTB Shoe Covers
feature_titles: Easy to apply, lightweight, and packable
features: snug fit around shape of shoe
preventing water from seeping in
providing a tough, wear-resistant layer on the sole of the shoe cover
providing wear-resistant protection
ready to use when needed
en-GB.description_html:
The TrailBlazer Flat Pedal MTB Shoe Covers are meticulously engineered for enthusiastic mountain bikers who seek top-tier performance and protection on the trails.

Tailored for flat-pedal MTB shoes, these covers offer a snug fit around the shape of your shoe. The fully waterproofed seams provide reliable protection against water seepage, keeping your feet dry and comfortable as you tackle challenging terrain, allowing you to enjoy the trail even in wet weather.

Equipped with an anti-abrasion tread pad, these shoe covers feature a durable, wear-resistant layer on the sole, offering enhanced grip and protection against abrasions. The aramid-reinforced toe box adds an extra layer of wear-resistant protection, ensuring durability and longevity in rugged mountain biking conditions.

Experience convenience and versatility with shoe covers that are easy to apply, lightweight, and packable, ready to use whenever needed. Embrace the perfect blend of performance, protection, and functionality with the TrailBlazer Flat Pedal MTB Shoe Covers.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Winter Jacket
features: Block cold wind while providing flexible weather protection for cold rides
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Add soft insulation and comfort with a warm inner surface
Helps release excess heat and moisture as effort levels change
Provides an athletic but comfortable cut shaped for cycling movement and easy layering
Allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding
Reflective elements help increase visibility in low-light riding conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Winter Jacket is built for road and gravel riders who want dependable warmth and wind protection for cold-weather rides without making layering complicated. Windproof softshell 3-layer panels block cold wind, while a water-repellent outer finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric.

Brushed fleece inserts add soft insulation and comfort where extra warmth is needed, while the breathable construction helps release excess heat and moisture as effort levels change. The active fit provides an athletic but comfortable cut shaped for cycling movement, making the jacket easy to wear over thermal base layers.

A YKK 2-way zipper allows quick ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding. Reflective details help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Wear it over the RIDE Thermal Long Sleeve Base Layer in cool conditions or the RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer when extra warmth is needed. Built as a straightforward winter riding jacket, it is suited to cold, windy, and changeable rides, but it is not designed as a fully waterproof rain jacket or a heavily insulated deep-winter jacket.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RIDE Thermal Arm Warmers
features: Soft brushed thermal fabric offers insulation and protection from wind chill for cool spring and autumn starts
Lightweight fabric is super breathable and moisture wicking to transport perspiration away from the skin
Anatomical contoured seams allow for a natural arm bend which reduces material bunching around your elbows
