Silicone elasticated grippers on top of the warmer sleeves prevent slippage down your arms
For visibility in traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The RIDE Thermal Arm Warmers deliver essential insulation and wind chill protection for cooler spring and autumn rides.

Made from soft brushed thermal fabric, they provide warmth while remaining lightweight, breathable, and moisture-wicking. The anatomical pre-shaped fit reduces bunching at the elbows, enhancing comfort and movement, while silicone elasticated grippers ensure a secure hold.

Reflective details improve visibility in low-light conditions, making these arm warmers a practical choice for added warmth in transitional weather.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Polaris 2 Waterproof Winter Gloves
features: Fully waterproof and breathable membrane keeps your hands dry in the wettest winter conditions
PrimaLoft® Gold insulation on the palm and back of the gloves gives extreme winter insulation and warmth
Durable synthetic suede palm with padding and silicone grip pattern for maximum comfort and control
Index finger and thumb are touchscreen friendly to allow use of your phone and bike computer without removing the gloves
Reflective detailing and little finger insert help improve your road presence and signalling in low light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The Polaris 2 Waterproof Winter Gloves will keep your hands dry, warm and comfortable – so you can keep cycling during the wettest and coldest days of winter.

With a fully waterproof and breathable membrane, these gloves are not just water resistant – they are 100% waterproof: with a 15K (15,000mm) waterproof rating and a 15K (15,000 g/m²/24h) breathability rating.

Insulation comes from award-winning PrimaLoft®: PrimaLoft® Gold is used on the palm to offer exceptional breathability and warmth, even under compression. Then on the back of the gloves, Primaloft® Gold Active+ is used for the best in class warmth-to-weight ratio.

The Polaris 2 are your gloves for the wettest and coldest winter days. These will keep your hands warm and functioning at their best so you can enjoy the ride, even when the weather conditions force others to stay indoors.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Cycling Shorts
features: Crafted from high-quality fabrics offering a balanced level of stretch and support for enhanced comfort
Integrates a high-quality cycling pad from Elastic Interface (LIEGE HP) to deliver outstanding comfort during long rides
Features a convenient stretchy pocket, lying flat against the leg for easy access to your phone or snacks throughout your ride
Ensure a secure fit on the legs with wide elastic hems and silicone grippers
Stays comfortably in place during your rides thanks to the stretch waistband lined with moisture-wicking mesh
en-GB.description_html:
Crafted from high-quality stretch polyamide fabric offering UPF50+ sun protection, the GripGrab RIDE Cycling Shorts are an essential for riders, providing a gently supportive fit for optimal comfort.

Equipped with an Elastic Interface pad (LIEGE HP), they offer remarkable cushioning. For convenient access to your phone or snacks, a stretchy top-entry leg pocket is included. The wide elastics around the thighs, lined with silicone grippers and coupled with the comfortable elastic waistband, ensure a secure fit throughout your rides. Reflective details enhance visibility and safety in low-light conditions.

e recommend pairing these shorts with a GripGrab RIDE Short Sleeve Jersey for a fully coordinated style and enhanced riding comfort.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Emergency Jacket
features: Folds down small enough to disappear into a jersey pocket for emergency rain protection
Fully waterproof closure allows quick ventilation adjustments and easy pocket access
Sealed seams prevent water ingress for dependable waterproof performance
Ultralight laminate construction delivers waterproof protection while remaining highly packable and flexible
Balances rain protection with effective moisture management
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Emergency Jacket exists for riders who prefer carrying certainty without carrying excess. The jacket is intended for use when conditions change unexpectedly during a ride. It provides temporary protection against wind and rain during descents, sudden showers, or extended stops, before being packed away once conditions stabilise.

Built from a single 2.5-layer polyamide shell with a PU-based membrane, the jacket prioritises low weight and minimal bulk. A 10,000 mm waterproof rating and a DWR finish are supported by fully taped seams and a YKK 2-way waterproof front zipper. A 10,000 g/m²/24h breathability rating supports moisture transfer.

The race fit delivers a close-fitting silhouette that limits excess material. Elasticated cuffs and a standard-height collar maintain a streamlined road-jacket profile. The 2-way front zipper enables access to jersey pockets underneath.

The jacket has no pockets or dedicated packing system. Instead, its 120 g weight (size Medium) allows it to be easily folded and stowed away in a jersey pocket.

Reflective elements on the shoulders and back increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Designed as an emergency layer, the jacket is not intended for heavy daily use. Prolonged storage in a folded state should be avoided to protect the material and taped seams.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Sleeveless Base Layer
features: providing excellent ventilation, allowing heat and moisture to escape rapidly
promoting rapid sweat evaporation
providing a comfortable feel
Extends the lifespan of the baselayer by reducing the accumulation of odor-causing bacteria
improving blood circulation and reducing muscle vibration
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Spring-Autumn Sleeveless Base Layer is meticulously crafted for performance-oriented riders who seek a balance of warmth and ventilation in their cycling apparel.

Designed to provide excellent thermal insulation for your core, this base layer ensures you stay warm during cool rides. The advanced open-mesh seamless construction effectively releases excess heat and allows optimal airflow when your jersey or jacket is zipped down, cooling your body and preventing overheating.

The compressive slim fit offers an aerodynamic feel while improving muscle support and making you ready to go all out.

Crafted from lightweight polypropylene fabric, this seamless base layer offers a soft and comfortable feel against your skin. Polypropylene is known for its excellent moisture-wicking properties, keeping you dry and comfortable by quickly moving sweat away from your body. The anti-odour treatment helps extend the lifespan of the base layer by reducing odour accumulation, allowing you to wash it less frequently.

Elevate your cycling experience with the PACR Spring-Autumn Sleeveless Base Layer, where performance and comfort come together seamlessly.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Summer Seamless Sleeveless Base Layer
features: Smooth, no-distraction fit under your race layers
Close fit accelerates moisture transfer in hot conditions
Open knit structure promotes airflow to keep your core cool when the pace goes up
Low-absorption yarn keeps moisture away from the skin to keep you feeling dry
Advanced odour control keeps the base layer fresh for longer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for high-intensity riding in warm conditions, the GripGrab PACR Summer Seamless Sleeveless Base Layer provides a minimal, race-ready foundation under close-fitting jerseys. The ultralight construction and sleeveless cut prioritise breathability and unrestricted movement, making it well suited for racing and fast training sessions.

The seamless body construction creates a smooth, low-profile interface under the jersey or speed suit. Specialized knit structures are integrated directly through the knitting process, tailoring the fabric to different areas of the body. The low collar provides clean integration with modern race jerseys.

Made from a lightweight blend of polypropylene and polyamide, the fabric is inherently hydrophobic, keeping moisture away from the skin during hard efforts. A Polygiene® anti-odour treatment maintains freshness over repeated rides.

Purpose-built for summer use, this base layer focuses on breathability, minimal weight, and clean layering without unnecessary features.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaSeal Waterproof Cycling Gaiter
features: forming an optimal fit around the ankle
preventing water from seeping in
keeps gaiter in place
for enhanced comfort
en-GB.description_html:
The AquaSeal Waterproof Cycling Gaiter is crafted for cyclists seeking superior protection in wet riding conditions. Designed to create an effective seal between your legs and waterproof cycling shoes, these gaiters help keep your feet dry and comfortable. They can also be used with shoe covers for an extra level of protection.

Constructed from stretchy waterproof material, the AquaSeal Gaiters form a snug fit around your ankles, preventing water ingress in rain or wet road conditions. Equipped with a silicone grip band, these gaiters stay securely in place.

Versatile in use, the AquaSeal Waterproof Cycling Gaiter is an essential addition to your cycling gear. It is designed to maximize the effectiveness of your waterproof cycling shoes while also providing additional protection when used with shoe covers. Combining functionality and comfort, the AquaSeal Waterproof Cycling Gaiter is designed to elevate your wet weather cycling gear.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Waterproof Gravel Shoe Covers
features: Made from PU-coated polyester for flexibility and complete waterproof protection
Endures the hard terrain of gravel riding
Adds a durable, wear-resistant layer to the sole of the shoe cover
Sturdy base fabric and resilient tread pads ensure long-lasting durability, season after season
The secure rear zipper allows easy slipping on and off gravel cycling shoes
A wide reflective strip at the heel enhances visibility when it matters most
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab PACR Waterproof Gravel Shoe Covers are precision-engineered for performance-driven cyclists who demand reliability on challenging terrain and in unpredictable weather. Crafted from stretchy PU-coated polyester, they deliver complete waterproof protection with a sleek, aerodynamic fit ideal for high-paced efforts. The reinforced toe cap is designed to endure the rigors of gravel riding, while the anti-abrasion tread pad and reinforced base ensure season-after-season durability, even on the toughest routes.

An easy-entry YKK rear zipper allows efficient transitions, and a wide reflective strip at the heel enhances visibility when it matters most. Designed for those who ride hard and fast in all conditions, these shoe covers provide the ultimate in protection and performance for gravel enthusiasts.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Reflective Helmet Cover
features: 100% waterproof and windproof fabric with taped seams offers complete weather protection
Highly reflective material with 360-degree visibility enhances your presence on the road
Pull cord elastic hemline securely tightens around all normal sized bicycle helmets
Performance fabrics are built to last even with daily use in all weather conditions
Folds up small so it can be easily tucked into your pocket or pannier for when you need it next
en-GB.description_html:
Suited to riders who want to keep the rain and wind out of the vents on their cycle helmet and increase their road presence in low light; the Reflective Helmet Cover is especially suited to anyone who commutes by bike all year round.

The key feature of this cycling accessory is its highly reflective material that provides 360-degree visibility, making you a ‘beacon’ in urban settings as it reflects the headlights and streetlights to highlight your position in traffic.

The 100% waterproof and windproof fabric with taped seams offers complete weather protection for year-round use on commutes and trips on busy roads.

The one-size-fits-all approach works thanks to the pull cord elastic hemline, which securely tightens around all normal sized bicycle helmets to keep the rain out.

The performance fabrics are built to last, even with daily use in all weather conditions, but when the rain stops and the temperature rises, the helmet cover folds up small so it can be easily tucked into your pocket or pannier.

Full circle reflectivity for enhanced visibility and a barrier against rain getting into your helmet, the Reflective Helmet Cover is an accessory all cycle commuters should have to hand.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Lightweight SL Regular Cut Summer Socks 3-Pack
features: CoolMax® fabric is highly breathable and allows heat and perspiration to escape from within
For maximum comfort in hot riding conditions and minimal bulk within your summer cycling shoes
Stretch arch support and elasticated fabrics create a light compression feel for a close-fitting cut
en-GB.description_html:
With the GripGrab Lightweight SL Summer Socks, as with most cycling socks, the key factor is the fabric. These cycling socks employ a highly breathable CoolMax® Mesh to ensure that on the hottest rides your feet will not overheat.

Thanks to its exceptional breathability, the CoolMax® Mesh allows heat and perspiration to escape through the fabric as the sun beats down and you push for the summit of the next climb.

The lightweight fast-dry wicking fabric and minimal fabric bulk mean that when the temperature hits those high summer figures, you will remain comfortable.

To ensure a good fit, the socks are shaped with stretch arch support and feature elasticated fabrics to create a light compression feel for a superb close-fitting cut.

The GripGrab Lightweight SL are the perfect socks for any summer cycling adventure – now even better value in this three-pack.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Running UltraLight Touchscreen Winter Gloves
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Running UltraLight Touchscreen Winter Gloves are super lightweight running gloves for high intensity training, race use, or when a thin layer is all you need to keep your hands comfortable.

Touchscreen compatible fingertips make it possible to tap out your texts or take photos without removing the gloves.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Windproof Winter Headband
features: Flexible windproof fabric protects your head from windchill in cool conditions
Warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining offers insulation in cold weather
Low-bulk fleece fabric is highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio
Stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching allows a comfortable close fit under a cycling helmet
Reflective logos and detailing on front and rear help to improve visibility in low light winter conditions
en-GB.description_html:
Keeping the wind off your head without making it too hot is a difficult balance when cycling in the winter months, but this is where the GripGrab Thermo Hi-Vis Windproof Winter Headband is the ideal choice for winter cycling headwear.

This headband protects your forehead from windchill in cool conditions — the flexible windproof fabric sits against the skin but leaves the top of your head uncovered to allow excess heat to escape when you are working hard on a climb or pushing to keep up with you cycling friends.

The warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining to the fabric offers insulation and comfort in colder weather – to keep your head and ears warm and allow you to concentrate on the road ahead rather than the windchill.

The headband is lightweight thanks to its low-bulk fleece fabric; it is also highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio, ideal for those cooler rides.

The comfortable under-helmet fit comes thanks to the stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching, which together allow a close fit under a cycling helmet.

Reflective logos and detailing on the front and rear help to improve your presence in low light winter conditions, when indeed you are most likely to be wearing the GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband.

For anyone who likes to run and hike in the winter, as well as cycle, this headband has wide multi-sport appeal as it keeps the windchill at bay regardless of the activity you choose.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Thermal Winter Balaclava
features: Stay warm and comfortable cycling in the most extreme winter conditions
High-wicking insulating fleece moves moisture away from your face to keep you dry
Anatomically shaped flat-lock seams and thin elastic fabric easily adapts to all face shapes
Convert from full face mask and gaiter to hood by pulling down the elastic pre-shaped front breathing panel
Versatile design means it can be worn underneath a helmet for cycling, skiing, hiking, climbing and trekking
en-GB.description_html:
The Thermal Winter Balaclava is a piece of deep winter kit for those riders who don’t know the term ‘off-season’. The balaclava provides effective insulation and windchill protection for your head and neck, with the option of pulling up the front panel over your mouth for greater coverage. The ultimate headwear to minimise how much skin is exposed to the harsh windchill of deep winter.

Low profile, lightweight and with flatlock seams, this balaclava will fit comfortably under your cycling helmet for winter riding. Its adaptable nature and lightweight breathable insulation also make it ideal for other outdoor activities such as hiking and running in the coldest conditions.

Your deep winter headwear solution.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Seamless Sleeveless Base Layer
features: Smooth, no-distraction fit under your race layers
Close fit optimises moisture transfer and thermoregulation in cooler conditions
Insulating construction keep your core warm during spring and autumn rides
Low-absorption yarn keeps moisture away from the skin to keep you feeling dry
Advanced odour control keeps the baselayer fresh for longer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for high-intensity riding in cool to cold conditions, the GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Seamless Sleeveless Base Layer delivers reliable thermoregulation and effective moisture management.

The second-skin, compression-like fit supports efficient moisture transfer. The knit-based thermal structure retains warmth, while polypropylene fibres dry quickly to maintain comfort.

The seamless body construction ensures a smooth, non-chafing interface under close-fitting race jerseys.

Finished with a Polygiene® anti-odour treatment throughout the entire garment, the base layer helps reduce odour build-up and maintain a fresh feel between washes.

Engineered to be worn under close-fitting jerseys, this base layer is a technically refined base layer for performance-oriented riding in transitional seasons.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: Smooth, no-distraction fit under your race layers
Close fit optimises moisture transfer and thermoregulation in cooler conditions
Insulating construction keep your core warm during spring and autumn rides
Speed Focused aero texturing designed to make you look and feel fast
Advanced odour control keeps the baselayer fresh for longer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for high-intensity riding in cool to cold conditions, the GripGrab PACR Spring-Autumn Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer delivers reliable thermoregulation and effective moisture management.

The second-skin, compression-like fit supports efficient moisture transfer. The knit-based thermal structure retains warmth, while polypropylene fibres dry quickly to maintain comfort.

The seamless body construction ensures a smooth, non-chafing interface under close-fitting race jerseys. The sleeves feature an integrated aero-striped knit surface structure. When worn under close-fitting jerseys, this knit pattern creates subtle striped impressions on the outer layer.

Finished with a Polygiene® anti-odour treatment throughout the entire garment, the base layer helps reduce odour build-up and maintain a fresh feel between washes.

Engineered to be worn under close-fitting jerseys, this base layer is a technically refined base layer for performance-oriented riding in transitional seasons.

en-GB.name: GripGrab AquaShield High Cut Road Shoe Covers
features: Water-resistant and windproof fabric with taped seams shields your feet and lower legs from road spray and downpours
High-stretch fabric and a close-fitting cut smooth the airflow around your road cycling shoes for potential aerodynamic gains
Zipperless cuff design reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to standard zip designs
Reflective tabs on the rear of the shoe covers helps improve your road presence on dark and wet days
Pre-cut cleat and heel holes make it easier to fit these to your road cycling shoes
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab AquaShield High Cut Road Shoe Covers take the concept of the wet weather cycling overshoes to a new level. As the name suggests, they go further up your calf compared to more conventional ankle height overshoes – offering the ultimate weather protection for riding and racing on wet roads.

The highly water-resistant and windproof fabric will keep out the worst weather and allow you to continue riding in comfort; while the high stretch fabric facilitates a super close-fitting profile to smooth the airflow (and water flow) over your road cycling shoes and lower legs. The inside of the PU-coated material is soft brushed so it feels great against your skin and reduces the chance of skin irritation.

A zipperless cuff design increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to standard zip designs; while durability is further enhanced by pre-cut cleat and heel holes that improve the fit over your road cycling shoes.

The ultimate wet weather road racing shoe covers – the GripGrab AquaShield High Cut will allow you to stay focussed on the road ahead, however tough the conditions become.

Tip: Always wear the shoe covers directly on your skin to minimise water running down your legs and into your shoes, especially when wearing bib tights or leg warmers.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Raceday Gloves
features: Helps block cold wind for added comfort on cool, fast rides
Reduces bulk between hand and bar for a more direct feel and precise control
Helps secure the hand inside the glove for a stable, connected grip
Close, streamlined fit reduces excess material and supports precise handling at pace
Printed silicone on the palm and fingers helps maintain secure contact with the handlebar and controls
Enables quick entry and a clean, low-bulk wrist fit without closures
Add practical ride usability without unnecessary bulk
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Windproof Raceday Gloves are built for performance road and gravel riders who want direct bar feel, secure grip, and low-bulk wind protection for cool, fast rides. Windproof softshell fabric helps block cold wind, while the close race fit and slip-in cuff keep the glove streamlined with minimal excess material.

The unpadded palm reduces bulk between hand and bar, supporting direct feel, precise feedback, and confident control at pace. InsideGrip™ technology helps secure the hand inside the glove, while printed silicone on the palm and fingers helps maintain stable contact with the handlebar, brake levers, and controls.

A soft sweat wiper and touchscreen-compatible fingertips add practical usability without adding unnecessary bulk. Built for race days and high-intensity training when a summer glove is not enough, these gloves deliver low-bulk wind protection, secure grip, and direct bar feel. Not designed for heavy rain, deep winter, or riders who prefer palm cushioning.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's Grinta Bib Shorts
feature_titles: Premium Elastic Interface EXPLORER HCS padding
features: Lightweight, supportive, and tough, ensuring long-term wear with excellent stretch and abrasion resistance
Enhancing muscle support to improve endurance and reduce fatigue
Featuring high-density foam for enhanced durability and comfort on long rides
Delivering a sleek, low-profile finish for a seamless transition from fabric to skin
To maximize comfort and a clean look
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Grinta Bib Shorts represent the pinnacle of performance for discerning cyclists who demand unmatched durability, support, and comfort on every ride. Precision-engineered from advanced woven fabric, these bib shorts strike the perfect balance between lightweight feel and robust resilience, with exceptional stretch and abrasion resistance for long-lasting performance mile after mile. The carefully calibrated compressive weave supports muscles, boosting endurance and reducing fatigue during even the most intense efforts.

At the core, premium Elastic Interface EXPLORER HCS padding delivers a transformative ride experience, with high-density foam engineered for unparalleled comfort and support on extended journeys. Laser-cut leg openings ensure an impeccably sleek, aerodynamic profile, while an integrated, silicone-free gripper system provides a secure fit that maintains absolute comfort without sacrificing a clean, sophisticated finish. For those who demand the very best in cycling refinement and uncompromising functionality, the Grinta Bib Shorts redefine what is possible in every pedal stroke.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Midweight Merino Beanie
features: 100% merino wool offers natural softness, warmth and comfort
Merino wool provides natural insulation for your head in cold weather conditions, both on and off the bike
Naturally breathable fabric allows moisture to escape when you work up a sweat
Offers you the versatility for it to be worn on and off the bike
Stow it in a jersey pocket or pannier until it's needed again
en-GB.description_html:
This 100% merino wool beanie is a luxury piece of headwear for all your outdoor winter activities. Wear it around town, at home, or to climb a mountain – wherever your outdoor pursuits take you.

The merino wool is super soft, moisture wicking and highly breathable – so you are kept warm and comfortable in all winter weather conditions. So good you might never take it off.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Gloves
features: Helps block cold wind and retain warmth on cold winter rides
Adds soft, insulating warmth for cold-weather comfort
Helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric
Combines comfortable handlebar feel with added wear support and pressure distribution
Helps retain warmth around the wrist and creates a close fit with jacket sleeves
Help maintain secure contact with the handlebar and controls
Allow use of cycling computers and smartphones without removing the gloves
Help wipe away sweat or clean eyewear lenses while adding visibility in low-light conditions
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Windproof Winter Gloves are built for performance road and gravel riders who need windproof warmth, palm comfort, and confident control on cold winter rides. Windproof softshell fabric helps block cold wind, while a lofty lining and close-fitting fleece cuff add insulating warmth around the hand and wrist. A water-repellent finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the outer fabric.

The padded microsuede palm combines comfortable handlebar feel with added wear support. Padding helps reduce handlebar vibration and distribute pressure on longer cold rides, while silicone-enhanced palm sections help maintain secure contact with the handlebar and controls.

Touchscreen-compatible fingertips allow use of cycling computers and smartphones without removing the gloves. A soft sweat wiper helps wipe away sweat and clean eyewear lenses, while reflective details help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built for winter training and cold-weather road or gravel rides, these gloves deliver windproof warmth and padded palm comfort when spring-autumn gloves are no longer enough. Choose a waterproof glove for prolonged rain, or a deeper-insulated glove for extreme cold.

en-GB.name: GripGrab PACR Winter Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: Engineered with mapped knit structures that balance insulation, breathability, stretch, and next-to-skin comfort across the garment
Three-dimensional knit structure helps trap a thin layer of air close to the skin to support thermal insulation
Tighter, smoother knit construction reduces bulk and creates a clean interface under close-fitting outer layers
Supports efficient moisture transport during high-intensity winter riding
Helps limit odour build-up during repeated use
Close-fitting profile with rib-knit cuffs and hem helps maintain position and support stable layering comfort
en-GB.description_html:
The PACR Winter Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer is designed for high-intensity cycling in cold winter conditions, where warmth must work together with moisture management and a smooth fit under close-fitting outer layers. As part of the PACR seamless base layer range, it uses seamless circular-knit body construction with multi-zone knit architecture, placing different knit structures where they are needed across the garment.

Across the core body panels, a raised micro-textured knit structure helps trap a thin layer of warm air close to the skin, supporting thermal insulation while maintaining breathability as effort levels change. The shoulders and sleeves use a tighter, smoother knit construction to reduce bulk, support stretch recovery, and create a clean interface under race-fit jerseys and winter jackets.

Seamless zone transitions help create a uniform next-to-skin feel, reducing friction and pressure points during prolonged rides. Integrated rib-knit cuffs and hem help keep the garment in position and reduce cold air entry without added elastic components. A moisture-wicking, fast-drying fibre blend supports efficient moisture transport during high-intensity riding, while the Polygiene® treatment helps limit odour build-up during repeated use.

With its close second-skin profile and standard base-layer length, this is the primary interface layer for cold rides under the PACR Winter Jacket. In very cold conditions, it can be combined with the PACR Insulated Mid-Layer Vest for additional insulation.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Seamless Skull Cap
feature_titles: Warmth under your helmet that you can keep on through every interval
features: Hard winter intervals heat you up fast, and a thick hat soon turns wet and cold. This thin seamless cap sits close under your helmet, keeps your head and ears warm and moves sweat away, so you can leave it on from warm-up to cool-down
It moves sweat away instead of soaking it up, so the cap stays comfortable through hard efforts
It has no more material than it needs, so there is less to fit under your helmet
It folds small into a jersey pocket if the day warms up

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer
features: for enhanced insulation
ensuring superior comfort
providing excellent ventilation
Extends the lifespan of the baselayer by reducing the accumulation of odor-causing bacteria
en-GB.description_html:
The Women's RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer is designed for riders seeking exceptional value without compromising on quality.

Experience the ideal combination of warmth and comfort with the interior waffle-knit pattern, providing enhanced insulation to keep you cozy during cold rides. The ultra-soft thermal fabric ensures superior comfort, making this base layer essential for chilly cycling adventures.

Stay dry and comfortable with the highly breathable design that offers excellent ventilation, allowing heat and moisture to escape and keeping you feeling fresh throughout your ride. The anti-odour treatment helps extend the lifespan of the base layer by reducing odour accumulation, allowing you to wash it less frequently.

Embrace the balance of affordability and quality with the Women's RIDE Winter Long Sleeve Base Layer, where comfort and durability come together to enhance your cycling experience without breaking the bank.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Merino Regular Cut Socks 3-Pack
features: Merino wool blend provides comfort and light warmth
Keeps feet dry and fresh in all conditions
Ensures a snug, secure fit with no bunching
Long-lasting fabric with no special treatment needed
Ideal for cycling in all seasons
en-GB.description_html:
The GripGrab Merino Regular Cut Socks are made from 50% merino wool, to create a luxurious active sports sock.

The summer weight fabric provides exceptional breathability, temperature regulation and has that well known super-soft merino wool feel.

The perfect socks for riding in spring, summer, autumn and winter (combined with overshoes on the coldest days). Thanks to their lighter weight construction, you can comfortably wear these socks in your summer cycling shoes.

Merino wool has insulating and cooling properties – keeping your feet warm in winter.

No matter what type of cycling you do – road, gravel or MTB – the GripGrab Merino Regular Cut socks fit any occasion.

Three pairs of the GripGrab Merino Regular Cut Summer Socks – pure luxury! Experience the softness, breathability and superb temperature regulation of merino wool, and never risk running out of comfort with this great value three-pack.

en-GB.name: GripGrab Insulator 2 Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Gloves
features: Insulating and exceptionally breathable fabric offers protection and insulation on cool to mild spring and autumn days
Flexible fabric and silicone print gripper palms and fingertips allow for a secure hold on handlebars and levers
Microfibre fleece wiper on the thumb allows you to swipe away sweat and nose drips on cool days
Index finger and thumb are touchscreen friendly to allow use of your phone and bike computer without removing the gloves
Enhances your visibility in low light conditions and helps make hand gestures more prominent in urban traffic
en-GB.description_html:
The Insulator 2 Hi-Vis Spring-Autumn Gloves are versatile lightweight gloves that will keep the chill off your hands on spring and autumn days.

In the changeable conditions of the transition seasons, the stretchy highly breathable material ensures a close and comfortable fit. The combination of the flexible material and silicone gripper pattern also ensures a secure grip on the handlebars and levers, with zero loss of feel or control.

These are a lightweight and versatile spring-autumn layer, which will keep your hands at a comfortable temperature as the weather cools.

en-GB.name: GripGrab RaceAero Hi-Vis Lightweight Road Shoe Covers
features: The lightweight high-stretch material stretches over your road cycling shoes to create a smoother airflow
Super lightweight low-bulk fabric means you barely feel that you are wearing shoe covers
Fabric allows heat and perspiration to escape from within to keep your feet cool and comfortable
Super high-stretch fabric prevents fabric clumping or folding even with the one-size-fits-all sizing
Pre-cut cleat and heel holes. Rear YKK® zips make it easier to fit these to your road cycling shoes
en-GB.description_html:
Time-trialling is not necessarily which rider is the most powerful, but often which rider is the most aerodynamically efficient. Low and narrow positions, the latest deep sections wheels, wind tunnel tested riding positions; but your kit also has a huge influence on how fast you can go.

The smoother the wind going past you as you chase that new time-trial personal best, the more likely you are to achieve it, and that’s where the RaceAero Lightweight Shoe Covers can earn you some speed.

The lightweight high-stretch material of these overshoes stretches over your road cycling shoes to create a smoother airflow as you turn the pedals – reducing the loss of watts sacrificed to drag.

What’s more, the race fit of that super high-stretch breathable fabric prevents clumping or folding even with the one-size-fits-all.

But cycling shoe covers like these aren’t just about aero gains: they look great too. The range of colours means that there is a shade available to suit every style and complete every summer cycling outfit. If you look good, you’ll feel good – and you might even ride a bit faster.

Despite their aero qualities, these shoe covers are easy to fit and come with pre-cut cleat and heel holes to enhance durability – the rear YKK® zips also helps to make them easier to fit these to your road cycling shoes.

These cycling shoes covers are for dry summer road rides, not for off-roading or wet conditions – get aero and stylish on the warmest summer days.

en-GB.name: GripGrab W's PACR Padded Liner Shorts
features: Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP pad offers superior comfort during long distance rides
The high-stretch material, stitched with flatlock seams, allows for a close and comfortable fit with maximum freedom of movement
Mesh inserts ensure maximum breathability and minimal added insulation from the liner shorts
A wide elastic waistband and silicone gripper hems keep the shorts firmly in place even when worn beneath bib tights or baggy shorts
Ideal for wearing underneath the GripGrab ThermaShell unpadded bib tights, but also under baggy MTB shorts or on the indoor trainer
en-GB.description_html:
Designed for versatility the GripGrab PACR Padded Liner Shorts are made to be worn underneath unpadded bib tights, such as the GripGrab ThermaShell Bib Tights; these liner shorts feature an Elastic Interface seatpad for pressure relief, and highly breathable fabrics for the best temperature regulation. The padded waist shorts are also perfect for your indoor training sessions or even underneath baggy shorts.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The fabric of these liner shorts is a mix of high-stretch material and an open mesh material that provides maximum breathability. This combination means the shorts fit like a second skin and allow heat and perspiration to easily escape from within.

A wide elastic waistband and silicone leg grippers keep the liner shorts firmly in place, even when they are worn underneath close-fitting bib tights or baggy shorts.

The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the liner shorts without needing to wash your bib tights after each ride: this is better for the bib tights. These liner shorts are also perfect for use with baggy shorts or for indoor trainer use – they offer the same functionality as a normal pair of cycling shorts, but with enhanced breathability.

Versatile padded liner shorts that will offer you the comfort you need for long distance rides.
